chapters.title: Chapter 69 - Can I Be Greedy This Tim
paragraphs: “So, is our company going to give up?”
“That’s not true. President Qin hopes that we can complete the mission. After all, this is a good opportunity for us to connect with the federation and deepen our cooperation.”

“President Qin promised that as long as we can complete the mission, the company will not draw any commission from the reward given by the federation. The task team will be able to distribute the reward among themselves. At the end of the month, there will be additional company bonuses and performance bonuses.”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
Could he still be greedy this time around?
“It’s too difficult. Our team has analyzed it internally. The Tier 4 zombie is too strong. It’s impossible to complete the mission.”
Shen Qing sighed and explained, “It’s not just us. No team in the game can do it now.”
“It’s mainly a matter of time. The tranquilliser used by the federation only has an effective period of about 18 hours. Theoretically, the mutated zombie will wake up by noon tomorrow.”
“Right now, the players in the game haven’t even reached Level 5, so their abilities aren’t even equally matched. Large-scale player teams don’t have the time to travel to Hope Town.”
Fang Heng rubbed his chin, thinking about how he should take advantage of this opportunity.
He didn’t consider capturing Alex at all.
Fang Heng still had research reports about Alex in his backpack.
After Alex was placed into a low-temperature environment, it would take 30 minutes for him to gradually enter a dormant state.
In other words, even if he were to find an extremely rare refrigeration machine, it would take a full 30 minutes for Alex to enter a dormant state.
It would be strange if he wasn’t beaten to death by Alex after such a long time!
But if he were to directly kill Alex...
Was this impossible?
500 King of Gods’ points were too tempting!
If he could kill Alex, then what would he get?
First, the reward of 500 King of Gods’ points from the federation!
Wasn’t he troubled about moving the flower pots with the corpse vines?
500 King of Gods’ points could be used to exchange for a large truck!
There was even some surplus left!
The large truck would be very useful when he returned to prison.
After all, the zombie clones could help him collect a large number of materials.
When that time came, whether it was moving ores or materials to exchange for points, it would be very useful!
Secondly, aside from the main mission of collecting the T-virus serum, there was also side mission 3 which was to collect Alex’s samples.
Currently, he had already achieved 100% of the mission completion rate. If he could kill Alex, the mission completion rate could be further increased! The rewards will accumulate again!
Yes!
There was still a third point!
The advanced evolution crystal and first-kill reward!
Fang Heng was fully aware that Alex was the first Tier 4 mutated zombie to appear in District 8.
As long as he was killed, there was a 100% chance that the advanced evolution crystal would drop!
And the first-kill reward!
Fang Heng had heard from a player in his memory that players who had the first-kill of Tier 3 or above zombies would receive the system reward.
If it was a Tier 4 zombie, it would at least be a B-level skill book reward!
It was too tempting!
Fang Heng thought about it carefully.
It seemed that he could be greedy this time.
A plan was quickly constructed and perfected in Fang Heng’s mind.
He felt that it was possible.
The success rate was about 70%.
If he could find a reliable helper, the success rate could continue to increase!
Shen Qing looked at Fang Heng who was deep in thought.
“You seem to be very interested in this mission.”
“Huh?”
Fang Heng realized that he was lost in thought and smiled embarrassedly.
“I’m thinking about something. Sorry, what did you say just now?”
“Hey, it’s nothing. Oh right, President Qin came back yesterday. When she looked for you earlier, you were still in the game.”
“Did she say anything?”
“Yeah, from what she said, she seems to want you to build a gaming department, Task Team 12, by yourself.”
Shen Qing scratched his head.
He felt that this was very strange.
He was stunned when he heard President Qin mention it.
To let a newbie take charge of a newly established task team?
What kind of trust was this!
The back door was a little too wide!
But on second thought, it didn’t seem right.
There hadn’t been any personnel changes recently, and President Qin didn’t even send a single person to this newly established department?
When that time came, there would only be five newbie players, who had just joined the company, in Team 12.
What was the difference between this and a single commander?
“President Qin said that you can also choose a few people to bring to Team 12, but you need to obtain their consent.”
Fang Heng was also dumbfounded when he heard that.
Promoted?
Did he become the leader of the team all of a sudden?
Xia Xi had such a big reputation?
Or was Jimmy a hidden big shot client? Was it all for Jimmy’s sake?
Wait, did he get a raise?
Fang Heng looked up and asked, “Is President Qin here?”
“Her flight this afternoon should have landed by now. You can try calling her. I’ll give you her cell phone number.”
Shen Qing took out his cell phone as he spoke.
“Also, the office on the fifth floor for Team 12 has been cleared out this morning. You can move there anytime.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng shrugged and took down Qin Shuran’s cell phone number.
“Thank you.”
“Oh right, wait a moment.”
Shen Qing gestured for Fang Heng to wait a little longer and then made a landline call.
Soon, Pei Anan, the cute intern he had encountered not long ago, walked in.
“Team leader, you are looking for me?”
“Come, let me introduce you. This is Fang Heng, the team leader of Team 12.”
“This is Pei Anan, an intern from our department. She has been here for a month.”
“She is already very familiar with the company’s environment. President Qin has appointed her as your temporary assistant.”

Shen Qing introduced her enthusiastically, “Haha, this young lady is very serious in her work. She has helped me a lot during this period. To be honest, if President Qin hadn’t asked, I wouldn’t have been willing to let her go.”
Fang Heng nodded and greeted Pei Anan.
“Hello, we’ve met before.”
“Hello, team leader Fang Heng.”
Pei Anan greeted him obediently.
She looked at Fang Heng curiously.
A few days ago, when they met in the lounge, he had claimed to be an intern. So he was the new team leader.
“Tomorrow, the five new people assigned to you will report at nine o’clock. Pei Anan has the details of the personnel list.”
“That’s about it. If you have any other questions, you can directly consult President Qin.”
Shen Qing turned to look at Pei Anan. “Pei Anan, bring him to Team 12’s office first.”
“Thank you, Brother Shen, for your help during this time.”
“Hai, this is nothing. Come to our Team 3 often in the future.”
Shen Qing stood up and sent Fang Heng out of the office.
Fang Heng still felt that something was strange about being sent into the elevator all the time.
Did President Qin’s trust in him come from Xia Xi?
But to directly let him manage a team?
He didn’t know how to do that at all!
In a few days, he would think of a way to resign.
Ever since he had made great progress in the game, Fang Heng didn’t care about this job at all.
After all, in the game, he could easily sell some materials to the federation and earn a large sum of money. In reality, he was doing very well.
He could leave at any time.

Fang Heng continued to stay in the company for two reasons. The first reason was that he didn’t feel any pressure at all staying here. His life was very comfortable. The other reason was because of Xia Xi.
In this unfamiliar world, Fang Heng was very grateful to Xia Xi.
Of course, there was another very important point.
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company’s S-level talent enhancement plan!
Seeing that he was about to level up to Level 10 in the game, Fang Heng’s need for the talent enhancement plan became more and more urgent.
He needed to think of a way to get it as soon as possible.
Stop thinking about it!
There were more important things to deal with right now..

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - Sewer Map
paragraphs: Fang Heng lowered his head as he pondered.
His brain was rapidly perfecting the plan to kill Alex.
Alex’s life recovery ability was extremely strong.
His biggest weakness was fire.
The best way to kill Alex was to continuously attack it with fire.
Burn him to death!
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly.
“Fire...”
To complete the plan, a large amount of combustible material was needed.
Gasoline.
And explosives.
He had already used up all the explosives, but there was still one barrel of gasoline left.
However, one barrel of gasoline was far from enough.
If he were to go to the apocalypse merchant to buy it now, there would be insufficient time.
Currently, the only way to quickly obtain equipment and materials was to purchase them from the federation.
However, under normal circumstances, the federation’s materials would not be sold to the public, right?
Furthermore, he didn’t have enough points on him right now.
However, since it was a mission issued by the federation, could he borrow some from the federation in advance?
“Team leader Fang, we’re here.”
Pei Anan opened the door of Team 12’s office and switched on the lights.
The light illuminated the entire large office.
The office environment of each team in Phoenix Sound Gaming Company was similar.
There were rows of cubicle work areas and rows of gaming cabins placed against the wall.
As there was no one around, the office looked exceptionally empty.
Fang Heng raised his head.
“Pei Anan?”
“Eh?”
“You know about the mission regarding the federation’s Tier 4 zombie today, right?”
“Yes, I do. I prepared the materials for the meeting just now.”
“That’s great.” Fang Heng asked, “Do you know the process of accepting a mission from the federation in the name of the company?”
“Ah?”
Pei Anan opened her mouth and said in surprise, “Team leader Fang, you want to accept this mission?”
Fang Heng nodded his head vigorously.
“Yes.”
Pei Anan looked at Fang Heng. She felt that this handsome team leader was probably not awake yet.
“But team leader Fang, our Team 12 currently has no one other than you.”
“That’s fine. I can do it alone.”

Fang Heng rubbed his chin. “But time is too tight right now. I need to borrow some equipment from the federation. If I borrow it from the federation in the name of the company, will the federation give it to me?”
“This...”
Pei Anan thought for a moment and gave an affirmative response.

“Yes, it’s possible. The time for this mission is tight, so the federation will be more lenient in this aspect. However, if this concerns the company, you will need to go through the approval of the leaders.”
“Is the approval procedure very troublesome?”
“Yes, it’s quite troublesome. Under normal circumstances, if everything goes smoothly, it will take at least a day.”
A day? Alex could use this time to tear down the federation warehouse!
“Forget it then.”
Fang Heng felt that it was troublesome, so he directly dialed President Qin’s number.
“Beep Beep Beep...”
“Hello, is this President Qin? I’m Fang Heng.”
“I’m Qin Shuran.”
“I’m very interested in the mission in Hope Town.”
Qin Shuran had just gotten off the plane and checked into the hotel. She had just put on a face mask.
At first, she thought that Fang Heng was asking about him being deployed as team leader, but when she heard the introduction, she could not help but be surprised.
“You want to accept this mission?”
“Yes, that’s right. Coincidentally, I’m in Hope Town right now. In order to complete the mission, I want to advance some weapons and equipment.”
“Have you thought about it? The company’s internal evaluation deemed this mission as impossible to complete.”
“Yes, I have a way.”
Qin Shuran lay on the sofa and thought for a moment before asking, “How many weapons and equipment do you need?”
“About ten barrels of gasoline, ten small explosive packs...”
“How confident are you?”
Fang Heng looked at Pei Anan and answered confidently, “Very confident.”
On the other end of the phone, Qin Shuran hesitated for a moment.

“I’ll contact them. In an hour, you’ll go directly to the federation warehouse resource point to look for the person in charge of the warehouse. They will try their best to satisfy your needs within a certain range.”
Fang Heng didn’t expect to be able to convince Qin Shuran so easily. He was stunned for a moment.
After all, his identity still had a lot of dirt on him.
He had thought that if Qin Shuran did not agree, he would have to think of another way to obtain the weapons.
For a moment, the words that Fang Heng had prepared were useless.
“Uh... Thank you.”
“Don’t let Xia Xi down.”
Du du du...
The call ended.
Fang Heng’s face darkened.
What did she mean by not letting Xia Xi down...
“Team leader Fang, what did President Qin say?”
“President Qin agreed.”
“Ah?”
Pei Anan covered her mouth.
President Qin agreed just like that?
“Pei Anan, let’s add each other as friends first. That’s all for today. Go back and rest. If there’s anything else, we’ll talk about it tomorrow.”
“Ah?”
“I told you to go back and rest early. Help me deal with those newcomers tomorrow morning, make them feel welcome. I don’t have time.”
“I believe you. You can do it!”
Fang Heng waved his hand, turned around and entered the gaming cabin.
[Hint: During the time you are offline, one of your zombie clones has died.]

[Hint: During the time you are offline, your zombie clones have killed a Tier 1 mutated zombie*2, a normal zombie*566. You have gained 1,289 survival points, 110 evolution crystal fragments and a complete evolution crystal*1.]

[Hint: During the time you are offline, your zombie clones have completed a portion of the sewer exploration. You have obtained a sewer area map A*1, a bottle filled with sewage water*21, expired instant noodles*3, a sewer area map C*1, decaying debris*12, contaminated rags*42, damp firewood*6...]
There were even casualties?
It was most likely due to bad luck. The ordinary zombie clone first encountered the mutated zombie and was then killed.
Eh? A map of the sewer area!
Good stuff!
Fang Heng opened the map and roughly scanned it.
The entire sewer area of Hope Town was roughly divided into four areas.
Got it!
He could leave Hope Town by following this path!
With the sewer map, the plan to kill Alex could be further improved.
“I’m lucky. This saves me a lot of trouble.”
Fang Heng put away the sewer map and immediately summoned the zombie clones that stayed outside the villa to retreat and let them all enter the sewer to explore.
Killing Alex was not that simple. He needed to prepare a plan in advance and find a few reliable teammates.
Fang Heng turned on the survival radio and sent a message to Hao Zhou.
From their cooperation, Fang Heng felt that Hao Zhou’s group could be trusted.
And they should still be in the warehouse.
Fang Heng: “You guys haven’t left the warehouse yet, right?”
It was still early, and Hao Zhou happened to be in the game. He immediately replied after receiving Fang Heng’s message.

Hao Zhou: “Well, not yet. The people of the federation are very inflexible. They will only confirm that Old Black can not be contacted at noon tomorrow. When that time comes, they will give us the reward. How are you? Are you still safe? Do you need our help?”
Fang Heng: “I’m fine. It’s like this. I want to kill Alex, and I need your help when the time comes. You and Sister Li are together, right? Are you interested?”
Hao Zhou: “???”
Fang Heng: “Don’t worry, I have a plan. Even if the plan fails, I can guarantee your safety. If you’re interested, go offline and rest first.. We’ll meet at the federation warehouse at 2:00 tonight.”

They will only confirm that Old Black can not be contacted at noon tomorrow.
When that time comes, they will give us the reward.
How are you?
Are you still safe?
Do you need our help?”
Fang Heng: “I’m fine.
It’s like this.
I want to kill Alex, and I need your help when the time comes.
You and Sister Li are together, right?
Are you interested?”
Hao Zhou: “???”
Fang Heng: “Don’t worry, I have a plan.
Even if the plan fails, I can guarantee your safety.
If you’re interested, go offline and rest first..
We’ll meet at the federation warehouse at 2:00 tonight.”

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - A Plan
paragraphs: In the federation gaming warehouse, after receiving a message from Fang Heng, Hao Zhou’s face was filled with doubt.
Was he crazy?
Did he want to kill Alex?
Was he talking nonsense?
Or was he not awake?
“He shouldn’t be joking, right?”
Hao Zhou showed everyone the message from the radio and asked, “What do you think?”
Everyone had entered the Community Hospital before and they knew about the Tier 4 mutated zombie, Alex.
The moment they thought of that terrifying parasitic monster, they felt a chill run down their spines.

“Stop fooling around, that’s a Tier 4 creature. Didn’t you guys see it this afternoon? The federation sent out so many people, and they even used rocket launchers, but they still couldn’t get rid of him.”
Kun Ba shook his head repeatedly. He didn’t think anyone could kill Alex.
“That’s a Tier 4 mutated zombie. It’s impossible.”
Everyone felt that Kun Ba was right.
No matter who it was, the result would be the same, let alone Fang Heng.

After hesitating for a while, Kun Ta couldn’t help but say, “But, brother, he’s Fang Heng. He could escape from a ghost town like Hope Town by himself... at that time, we also thought that he couldn’t do it, right?”
Everyone fell silent for a while.
Indeed, that fellow had created a miracle.
At that time, no one thought that Fang Heng could survive in a ghost town that was surrounded by zombies.
From what he said, he seemed to be living a comfortable life in the hospital...
Now that they thought about it, Fang Heng’s strength was still very terrifying.
Kun Ta paused for a while, then added, “Moreover, he has very good equipment.”
Thinking of the good equipment that Fang Heng kept taking out from his backpack during the mission, everyone fell silent again.
After a long while, Hao Zhou looked at everyone and suggested, “Why don’t we wait and see? Since we have nothing to do, let’s listen to his plan first.”
Kun Ta and his brother looked at each other and felt that this suggestion was not bad.
“We are alright with this.”
Sister Li also nodded. “Sure.”
Hao Zhou immediately made a decision.
“Alright, then we’ll wait and see what Fang Heng says. If his plan is feasible, we’ll join him.”
For some reason, Hao Zhou was a little excited.
His logic told him that it was impossible to kill Alex, but Hao Zhou was just like the others.
They were looking forward to this impossible task.
“Hey, tell me, if we have the chance to kill Alex, will we still get the King of God’s first-kill team reward...”

“Yes, I heard from my friend that for the first-kill of a high-level mutated zombie in the server, we will get the King of God’s space skill book reward. The reward will be distributed according to the King of God’s team contribution points.”
“It’s said that even if you’re just a bystander in the team, you’ll still be able to get at least a D+ level skill book.”
“Cough, cough.” Haozhou coughed lightly, interrupting everyone’s intense discussion.
“Don’t think about it anymore. We will listen to what Fang Heng has to say. Rest well first. We’ll be online at 1:50.”
Morning, 1:30 am.
A modified motorcycle drove over from afar and steadily stopped outside the federation warehouse resource point.
A young man wearing a black face mask dismounted from the motorcycle.
Inside the warehouse, the two federation players in charge of keeping watch were shocked.
There was someone outside who wasn’t afraid of death at such a late hour?
Could he have been infected long ago?
They immediately stretched out their hands to stop this extremely suspicious fellow.
“Who? Where did you come from!”
Fang Heng took off his face mask.
“I’m Fang Heng from the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. I’m here to receive the mission.”
The two of them looked at Fang Heng up and down with a strange gaze.
They had indeed heard that there would be people from the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company coming over, but they did not expect them to rush over in the middle of the night.
There was someone who was not afraid of death!
“Come with us.”
After verifying Fang Heng’s identity, the two federation players brought Fang Heng to the counter in the hall.
“Hello, the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company has contacted our superiors. This is the gasoline you need. Please sign for it.”
The pretty lady behind the counter placed twelve barrels of gasoline (4 litres) on the counter.

“In addition, to ensure that the mission can be completed according to the rules, we need you to activate the video recording mode while you kill the Tier 4 mutated zombie and submit the video after the mission is completed.”
“Alright, I got it.”
Fang Heng put the gasoline barrels into his backpack one by one.
“What about the small explosive packs and the fuel for the flamethrower?”
“I’m sorry, Mr Fang Heng. After receiving the news from our superiors, we have already sent out the information to the various resource points at the first possible moment.”
“However, as it is already nighttime, it is estimated that these two materials will be delivered within an hour of dawn tomorrow. You can come and collect them from me at that time.”
“Okay, thank you.”
Fang Heng nodded to show his understanding.
After all, the small explosive packs in the game were high-level materials, so it was normal that there were no reserves in the warehouse resource point.
Fang Heng found a corner in the warehouse and sat down. He lit a bonfire and opened the game log.
The zombies sent out had already completed more than 60% of the cleaning work of the sewer.
A passage connecting the sewer inside and outside of Hope Town had been formed. By then, he could bring Hao Zhou and the others directly into the town through the sewer.
The biggest challenge in the plan had been resolved.
Soon, Hao Zhou and the rest came online.
Everyone sat in front of the bonfire.
Kun Ta could not help but ask first.
“Fang Heng, have you considered it thoroughly? Alex is a Tier 4 mutated zombie. He’s strong, and normal weapons can’t harm him.”
“Of course, I have a plan.”
Hao Zhou looked serious as he said, “Fang Heng, we’re willing to trust you, but we won’t risk our lives. So, we hope you can tell us your plan honestly.”
“Alright, I happened to get a few sewer maps...”
Fang Heng told them his plan in detail.
He talked for almost ten minutes.
After that, Hao Zhou and the others lowered their heads at the same time and fell into deep thought.
What a guy!
He thought of a way to kill Alex!
And it sounded very feasible!
From the initial consensus that Fang Heng couldn’t do it to gradually believing that he actually could pull this off...
Until now, after listening to Fang Heng’s explanation, everyone had begun to think about the success rate in accomplishing this mission.
In Kun Ba’s opinion, as long as there was a 30% success rate, he was willing to take a gamble.
Fang Heng felt a little thirsty. He silently took out a can of coffee from his backpack.
After finishing the coffee, Fang Heng raised his head and looked at everyone.
“This is the plan. You only need to complete the part that you are responsible for, then killing Alex won’t be a problem.”
Fang Heng’s tone was filled with confidence. As he spoke, he looked at the time again.
“There’s still three and a half hours before daybreak. If you have any questions, bring them up as soon as possible.. We’ll complete the plan together.”

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - Fatal Flaw
paragraphs: Kun Ba frowned and said in a deep voice, “Isn’t it too dangerous to anger Alex by force? Alex is surrounded by a large number of small zombies. At that time, we have to take into account the timing of the explosion. It’s extremely dangerous.”
“You’re right. This is the most dangerous part of the plan, so we need your help. Sister Li’s perception barrier can be of great help.”
Sister Li nodded. “There’s no problem with this part of mine.”
Fang Heng looked at Hao Zhou, who had been deep in thought.
“What about the explosive part?”
Hao Zhou nodded and said, “The problem with the explosive part is the explosives. According to what you said, we need at least eight sets of small explosives.”
“I’ve already applied to the federation for this. The explosives and gasoline for the ignition are already prepared. We’ll be able to get them by dawn today.”
Everyone’s minds became active as they thought about the possibilities.
It seemed like they could really kill Alex according to Fang Heng’s plan.
“Alright, Fang Heng, Your plan has indeed exceeded my expectations.”
Hao Zhou sighed in his heart, shook his head and said, “But your plan has a fatal flaw.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“Flaw?”
“Yes, the problem lies in the sewers.”
Hao Zhou continued, “When I accepted Old Black’s mission, I also considered invading Hope Town through the sewers, but later I realized that it was impossible.”
Kun Ta asked first, “Why?”
“Because the sewers and the outside are more dangerous. The sewers are also filled with zombies, including many Tier 1 pus zombies.”
“There’s also the smell of the sewers”
“The stench that pervades the sewers will cause players to sustain negative statuses”
“Ordinary players are simply unable to stay in the sewers for more than 10 minutes.”
Hao Zhou shook his head and smiled bitterly.
“Previously, I’ve asked a friend for an assessment. Invading Hope Town from the sewers is much more difficult than invading from the surface.”
The Kun brothers’ hearts sank when they heard that.
Fang Heng patted Hao Zhou on the shoulder.
“Don’t worry about the sewer. I’ve taken care of it.”
What?
Hao Zhou turned his head and looked at Fang Heng in surprise as if he didn’t hear him.
“What did you say? It’s taken care of?”
“Yes, I’ve completely cleaned the sewer. I’ll bring you to take a look at the scene later. You’ll know when the time comes.”
Hao Zhou opened his mouth in surprise.
He wanted to ask Fang Heng how he did it, but he stopped himself.
This was Fang Heng’s secret. If he rashly asked about it, not only would he not get an answer, but he would also make Fang Heng unhappy.
“Okay, okay...”
Kun Ba was excited. “So, we have no problem?”
“If the sewer is safe...”
Hao Zhou was still doubtful.
He really couldn’t figure out how Fang Heng could solve the zombie crowd in the sewer.
But judging from Fang Heng’s confident look, he didn’t seem to be lying.
Hao Zhou said, “I have no problem with the general plan for the time being.”
“Okay! Let’s continue to perfect the details and do our jobs.”
The group spent another two hours thoroughly revising the plan over and over again.
There was at least a 70% success rate!
Two hours later, Fang Heng had drawn up all the details of the plan. He rubbed his neck and handed a small jar of honey to Hao Zhou.
“Come, follow me to the sewer. I’ll take you to observe the terrain.”
“Now?”
“Yes, drink this. Also, put this on...”
Fang Heng wore a black face mask with an extremely ugly design on his face and handed one to Haozhou.
Item: Small jar of honey.
Type: Food.
Description: A gift from nature. After eating the honey, it can restore satiety, relieve thirst and reduce the risk of infection to a certain extent in a short period.
Item: A fragrant black wet face mask.
Type: Costume.
Description: Make a rough face mask, soaked in the liquid mixed with perfume. Hmm... if you don’t find it ugly, you can try it on.
The next day, the sun rose.
Fang Heng brought Hao Zhou back to the federation resource point warehouse.
“How is it?”
Kun Ba and the others were burning with anxiety, and they quickly surrounded him.
Hao Zhou was convinced this time.
He saw with his own eyes that the city’s underground sewer was clean, and not even the shadow of a zombie could be seen!
If he had not seen it with his own eyes, he would never have believed that such a thing had happened.
Only God knew how Fang Heng, this little monster, had done it!
He did not want to think about it anymore!
No matter what, the clean sewer meant that their plan could be carried out!
Facing the expectant gazes of the two brothers, Hao Zhou nodded his head.
A smile appeared on his face.
“I’ve verified it with my own eyes. There are no problems with the sewers or the explosion.”
“Alright!!”
Kun Ba clenched his fists in excitement, and a faint trace of joy flashed across Sister Li’s eyes.
Hao Zhou had always been a calm person when it came to doing things.
When he said there were no problems, he meant it.
With his words, the success rate of this plan would be guaranteed.
They were now certain that Fang Heng could achieve the first-kill of Alex!
Everything was going according to plan, except for the last item, the explosives.
“Let’s go and ask the federation for the explosives.”
Fang Heng brought Hao Zhou and the others to the counter.
“Hello, I’m Fang Heng from Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. I’m here to collect the equipment and materials.”
“Please wait a moment.”
The young lady behind the counter placed twelve small explosive packs and five bottles of flamethrower fuel on the counter.
“According to the agreement, these are the small explosive packs and flamethrower fuel that you requested. Please sign here to receive them.”
Fang Heng signed the receipt and was about to reach out to take it.
“Wait a moment.”
A hand was placed in front of Fang Heng.
“Hello, Mr Fang Heng. I am the person in charge of the federation’s external recruitment mission, Li Weiyu.”
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at the middle-aged man in the uniform of a federal officer in front of him.
“Is there a problem?”
“I understand that your Phoenix Sound Gaming Company has exchanged for a large number of small explosive packs.”
“Yes, that’s right.”
“I want to remind you that if you want to use explosives to directly blow up Alex... then you’d better give up on this plan.”
“Thank you for your kindness. I understand your intentions but we have a plan.”
Li Weiyu frowned and blocked Fang Heng’s way.
He didn’t have a good feeling about this young man.
Fang Heng asked, “Is there anything else? We don’t have a lot of time.”
“The large number of explosives that you exchanged might anger Alex. What’s worse, the explosion will cause a huge sound wave that will cause a zombie crowd in Hope Town.”
“Yeah, so?”
“For safety reasons, we will send people to participate in this mission and assess the condition of the mutated zombie Alex throughout the mission.”
“If we think that your operation can’t kill Alex and might cause a larger-scale zombie riot, we will immediately terminate this mission.”
Li Weiyu’s words made Sister Li and the others feel very unhappy.
Kun Ta muttered softly, “Tsk, terminate this mission, who does he think he is?”
For mercenaries, the most annoying thing when they were carrying out a mission was having a self-righteous boss bossing them around.
However, when Fang Heng heard this, not only did he not feel offended, but his eyes lit up instead.
His originally furrowed brows relaxed.
Federation elites!
Participating in the entire operation?
Good heavens! Wasn’t this the toolman that was given to him for free!?

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - Welcome Gift
paragraphs: Fang Heng pondered for a moment before asking tentatively, “Can we have more...”
Li Weiyu interrupted him expressionlessly.
“No, you can’t refuse. This is the prerequisite for cooperating with the federation. It’s also to ensure the safety of the temporary resource point. I hope you can understand.”
“We will minimize the impact on your team as much as possible. We will only send one person to your team. Under normal circumstances, he will not affect your actions...”
“No, no, no, you have misunderstood. I completely understand your worries.”
Fang Heng waved his hand repeatedly.
Li Weiyu was stunned.
What did he want to say?

“Our Phoenix Sound Gaming Company has always adhered to the concept of customer first. We are willing to serve the people and have a lot of trust in the federation. What I mean is, is it too few to have just one guy to join our team?”
“For safety reasons, you can send a team to join our team.”
What did this brat mean?
In almost all of the previous missions, when other player teams heard that the federation wanted to join their team, they were extremely uncooperative.
Why did this completely change when it came to him?
For a moment, Li Weiyu even felt that Fang Heng was mocking him.
“We truly need the guidance and supervision of the federation. Thank you!”
Looking at the sincere face of Fang Heng, Li Weiyu was completely confused.
“You’ve helped us a lot. After all, I don’t feel at ease with so many small explosives in my hands. If we run into a zombie horde during the process of breaking into Hope Town, we’ll be in trouble!”
Li Weiyu began to ponder.
It turned out that Fang Heng treated their federation’s elite team as ‘coolies’.
This was the first time he had encountered such a situation.
For a moment, Li Weiyu was rather speechless.
After giving it some thought, Li Weiyu agreed.

In any case, it was good as long as they could achieve their goal of monitoring. By sending more people over, they would be able to better control the gaming company’s team, preventing any accidents from happening beyond their control.
After all, out of so many player guilds and gaming companies, only Phoenix Sound Gaming Company dared to accept the mission and was even willing to pay compensation after the mission failed.
This was the reason why the superiors were willing to trust Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
Of course, the federation had already considered the situation of the mission failing and had already prepared a backup evacuation plan.
“Alright, the 17th elite team of the federation will accompany all of you to complete this mission. Remember, we have the right to terminate the mission at the critical moment.”
As Li Weiyu spoke, he waved at a young man who was standing not far away.
“Reporting for duty, I am the captain of the 17th elite team, Chen Yu.”
Chen Yu brought five other players over and bowed to Li Weiyu before turning to face Fang Heng in unison.
“Mr Fang Heng, we will cooperate with you to complete this mission!”
“Done! I got it!” Fang Heng thought to himself.
The most troublesome part of the killing plan was that they needed to set up the explosives and lure Alex into the trap under the siege of zombies.
With the help of the federation’s toolmen, the success rate had been greatly increased!
Fang Heng: “Happy cooperation!”
Hope Town was occupied by the zombie hordes.
Fang Heng and the others arrived at the east side of the town and were preparing to invade through the main entrance.
Before they left, Fang Heng, Hao Zhou and the others tacitly took out black wet face masks and place them on their faces, covering their noses and mouths.
This scene baffled Chen Yu and his team.
What were they trying to do...
Their outfit looked a little like the bank robbers in the movies.
Fang Heng also gave Chen Yu and his elite team a black face mask.
“Come, come, come, one for each of you. It’s a welcome gift.”
The face mask was a very basic item in the game. It could be easily made with a few pieces of rags.
Fang Heng added a special step and soaked it with mineral water mixed with perfume.
Item: Fragrant black face mask.
Type: Outfit.
Description: Make a rough face mask and soak it with perfume. Hmm... if you don’t think it’s ugly, you can try it on.
“Should I say thank you?”
Chen Yu held the wet mask in his hand and didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
What could this thing do?
“Hey, it’s nothing. You’re welcome.”
While speaking, Fang Heng’s face turned serious. He glanced at the scattered zombies in Hope Town.
“Are you ready? It’s time to start.”
The elite team led by Chen Yu was extremely powerful. Their weapons were all iron long knives, and each of them was equipped with a pistol.
However, they had limited bullets in their pistols, so they wouldn’t use them unless it was an emergency.
The group quickly entered Hope Town and slaughtered their way in.
After moving forward for a while, Chen Yu noticed that Fang Heng, who was leading the group, had deviated from his original position.
He frowned and asked, “Where are we going? Alex is not in that direction!”
“Of course not. Alex is surrounded by zombies. We need to find another place to plant the bomb in advance.”
Hearing that, Chen Yu sighed again in his heart.
After all this time, he still wanted to use explosives to kill Alex.
It was useless to do that!
The federation had already obtained some information about Alex last night.
Unless the explosives were placed inside Alex’s body and detonated from the inside, the impact of the explosion would at most cause some injuries to Alex!
Seeing how stubborn Fang Heng was, Chen Yu did not continue to persuade him.
After all, this was an agreement between the superiors and Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
If the mission failed, Phoenix Sound Gaming Company would double compensate the federation for the loss of this batch of equipment and materials.
All he had to do was follow the instructions of his superiors.
As long as the impact of the explosion did not affect the warehouse outside of Hope Town, everything would be done by Fang Heng.
The group quickly cleared the zombies along the way and arrived at the planned location.
At the empty intersection, a few black cross-shaped stars had already been drawn on the ground.
Fang Heng nodded at Hao Zhou, who immediately went to set up a small explosive pack.
The zombies around the town smelled the scent of living people and gathered around.
Among them, there were some Tier 1 mutated zombies.
It was time for the toolman to appear!
Fang Heng waved at Chen Yu.
“Brother, do me a favour and help me protect him.”
Chen Yu was helpless. He signalled his team to pick up the long iron knives and help Kun Ta and the others protect Hao Zhou who was setting up the explosive packs.
Hao Zhou was a veteran in this field. In just five minutes, he had finished installing the explosive packs.
“It’s done!”
“Okay, let’s go!”
Fang Heng waved his hand and everyone turned around and ran toward Alex again.
Before long, they arrived at the centre of the town, which was surrounded by zombies.
Hiding in the distance, Fang Heng could see that Alex was still unconscious.
The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta, were a little nervous.
This was the most critical and dangerous step in the mission.
Fang Heng licked his lips and asked.
“Chen Yu, how’s your marksmanship?”
“Are you trying to lure them into the explosives zone?”
Chen Yu had already seen through Fang Heng’s plan.
All he had to do was to lure Alex into the explosives zone and use the explosives to kill it.
Sigh! This guy wouldn’t listen to reason.
“You guessed right. Can you do it?”
“Yes.”
Chen Yu took out his pistol and pointed it at Alex.
“Bang!”
A gunshot was heard.

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - A hole
paragraphs: The bullet hit Alex’s brow bone!
“Good marksmanship!”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows and gave a compliment.
The unconscious Alex ended up with a white mark on his forehead.
After being shot, Alex immediately showed signs of waking up.
The vines on his body squirmed rapidly.
“Bang!”
Chen Yu raised his hand and pulled the trigger.
The bullet hit Alex on the cheek.
Alex had completely woken up.
He supported himself with one hand and slowly stood up. Then, he slowly turned his head and looked at Fang Heng and the others.
At the same time, Sister Li activated her perception barrier at once, blocking the senses of the ordinary zombies around her.
Alex was a Tier 4 mutated zombie, so he wasn’t affected by the perception barrier.
He locked his eyes on Fang Heng and the others, then quickly chased after Chen Yu.
“Run!”
Fang Heng shouted and everyone turned around to run!
Alex continued to chase until he was led to the central intersection that Fang Heng had planned out beforehand.
Hao Zhou stared at the position where Alex was moving.
“He’s coming!”
Hao Zhou pressed the detonation button for the small explosives.
“Boom!!!”
The twelve small explosives that had been installed at the central intersection exploded at the same time!
The timing was just right.
The explosion point was triggered perfectly!
Fang Heng was also staring at Alex.
He was glad to have met Hao Zhou, a genius in explosives!
In an instant, a huge explosion resounded throughout Hope Town.
The ground shook violently.
Almost all the zombies in the town turned to look in the direction of the explosion at the same time.
They hesitated for about half a second.
Then, they turned around and staggered toward the direction of the explosion.
Although they were prepared, the loud explosion still made Chen Yu’s ears ring for a short while.
He felt his feet shake, and he couldn’t help but stagger.
When he regained his balance, he saw yellow dust in front of him.
His vision was blocked, so he couldn’t see clearly what was happening inside the dust, let alone confirm Alex’s condition.
Chen Yu raised his vigilance.
He also noticed that the explosion was perfect, it was better than he had expected!
However, it was impossible to kill Alex with the explosion alone!
At most, it would only injure Alex.
His ears were filled with the whimpering sounds of zombies.
Chen Yu turned his head again and saw the zombies rushing toward him from all directions.
“Not good!”
The explosion was too successful, but it caused the zombies to gather here frantically.
If they didn’t run now, they would be surrounded by the zombies!
“Run! If we don’t run now, it would be too...”
While speaking, Chen Yu saw the blurry scene in the smoke, and the second half of his sentence was stuck in his throat.
Eh? Where’s Alex?
Where is he?
Chen Yu was still in a daze when he saw Fang Heng shouting.
“Chen Yu! Quick! Bring your men and follow me!”
Chen Yu turned his head and saw Fang Heng take the lead to rush into the smoke.
In the blink of an eye, Fang Heng and Hao Zhou’s group disappeared into the smoke.
Where were they going?
What was going on?
Chen Yu followed them and took two quick steps forward. He couldn’t help but be stunned.
It was a hole!!
The ground in the middle of the intersection had been blasted into a huge hole by the explosives.
Alex had fallen into the deep hole because the ground had collapsed from the explosion.
It was pitch black below and it was hard to see what was there.
“Quick!! Don’t just stand there! Come over together!”
Chen Yu turned his head and saw that the manhole cover of a sewer not far away had been lifted.
Hao Zhou stuck half of his head out of the sewer and waved at them.
Chen Yu suddenly understood.
That’s right, the hole was part of their plan!
The explosion itself was not to kill Alex but to create a hole in the ground.
But what happened next? What should he do next?
“Captain? What should we do?”
“Quick! Let’s go into the sewer together!”
Seeing that the surrounding zombies were about to gather over, Chen Yu didn’t have time to think about these things.
He commanded his team members to quickly follow him and hide in the sewer.
Chen Yu was in charge of the rear. He was the last one to climb into the sewer and close the manhole cover.
Just as he climbed down the ladder and landed on the ground, an indescribable stench assaulted his nostrils.
Seeing the black face masks on the faces of Fang Heng and his team, Chen Yu suddenly understood something.
So the face masks were used at this time!
However, Chen Yu was not in the mood to take the face mask from his backpack.
His gaze quickly moved away from Fang Heng and the others to look for Alex in the sewer.
Where was Alex?
What was that?!
Another hole!?
Why was there such a big hole in the ground of the sewer?!
Chen Yu could not help but raise his head.
The hole in the ground that collapsed earlier was right above this hole.
After the explosion, Alex, who was supposed to be at the centre of the intersection, would have fallen straight into the deep hole in the sewer!
All of this was Fang Heng’s plan?
Chen Yu was a little dumbfounded.
He walked quickly to the hole and looked down.
The hole was at least seven to eight meters deep!
“Roar!!!”
Alex, who had fallen into the deep hole, let out an angry roar.
“Be careful!”
While he was distracted, Chen Yu heard a loud shout.
Fang Heng pulled Chen Yu away from the hole.
“Chi Chi Chi!!!”
Looking down, a few vines shot out from the hole and stabbed into the spot where Chen Yu was standing.
More vines came out from the hole.
The vines stuck into the crack.
Alex was using the vines that extended from his body to find a point of leverage!
He was trying to escape!
“You still want to run?”
Kun Ta and Kun Ba each carried a barrel of gasoline and poured it on the vines. Then, they threw the remaining barrels into the hole and smashed them on Alex’s body.
“Roar!!!”
Alex let out another roar. The vines that extended from his body contracted rapidly, and his body was pulled towards the top of the hole.
“Get out of the way! I’ll do it!”
Fang Heng took out the focused flamethrower, took half a step forward and pressed the trigger as he aimed at the vines on the ground.
“Boom!!!”
Thin blue tongues of flames spat out.
The vines were flammable, to begin with, not to mention that there was a layer of gasoline attached to them!
The flames burned along the vines and spread to Alex’s body in the blink of an eye.
“Roar!!!”
Alex, who was using the contraction of the vines to stay in mid-air, was covered in flames. He let out a howl and fell into the hole once again!
This...
So this was Fang Heng’s plan. He was using the hole in the sewer to create a fire pit and burn the Tier 4 mutated zombie Alex to death!
From the explosion to the deep hole to the fire pit...
All of this was orchestrated by them!
It was too shocking!
This huge hole was dug by his team?
What the hell!
How long would it take to dig such a huge hole?
It had only been half a day since the federation issued the mission to the outside world?
How did they do it?
Even if they didn’t eat or drink, they couldn’t dig such a huge hole continuously!
Could it be that one of their talent skills was an excavator?
Chen Yu turned around and looked at Fang Heng in shock.
He noticed that Fang Heng was looking up, and a smile of success appeared on his face.
What was that guy looking at?
With doubt, Chen Yu subconsciously looked up and followed Fang Heng’s gaze to the sky..

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - Strengthen the body
paragraphs: A huge hole was created in the ceiling of the sewer and the road surface due to the explosion.
Many zombies were surrounding the hole.
They were all attracted by the sound of the explosion.
The densely packed zombies were pushing and shoving one another.
Soon.
“Plop!”
A sound.
A zombie fell from the sky and fell into the fire pit.
This sound seemed to have triggered a chain reaction.
“Plop! Plop...”
One sound after another was heard.
The zombies fell from the hole in the road one after another like dumplings, then steadily fell into the burning fire pit in the sewers!
The flames in the deep hole quickly devoured the zombies...
“This...”
Was he killing zombies??
Chen Yu was deeply shocked by the scene in front of him.
He turned around and looked at Fang Heng with a hint of fear in his eyes.
“Is this part of your plan?”
“There are so many zombies in the outside world. How many points can he earn from this?”
“The efficiency is too terrifying!”
[Hint: You have killed an ordinary zombie. You have gained 2 survival points.]
[Hint: You have killed an ordinary zombie. You have gained 2 survival points.]
[Hint: You have killed an ordinary zombie. You have gained 2 survival points.]
[Hint: You have killed an ordinary zombie...]
“Hehe, the plan is a success.”
Fang Heng glanced at the game log that was flooded with messages and muttered to himself.
“Hmm... the version 3.5 of the fully automatic zombie pit that is circulating on the internet is really something...”
Looking at the burning pit, Hao Zhou and the others were extremely excited!
They stood by the fire pit and looked at Alex struggling in the fire pit.
His HP was decreasing bit by bit.
Soon, the negative effect of staying in the sewer appeared. Everyone received the warning from the game log.
Hao Zhou covered his mouth and nose and looked at Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, we can’t hold on much longer. If we stay here any longer, we’ll lose HP.”
Fang Heng replied, “You guys go first. Evacuate from route A. I’ll kill a few more zombies.”
Everyone looked at Fang Heng silently.
Kill a few more zombies?
Was that human language?
Chen Yu frowned and asked, “Then what are you going to do?”
“I have my own ways. Hurry up!”
The location where Hao Zhou had set up the small explosives was too perfect!
Almost all the zombies in the town were attracted by the violent explosion.
The number of zombies falling from the sky was much more than Fang Heng had expected.
In this way, Fang Heng didn’t have enough fuel and gasoline on hand.
Fang Heng thought for a moment and added, “By the way, think of a way to get some gasoline for me when you go back.”
“Okay!”
Hao Zhou trusted Fang Heng very much. He agreed, turned around and left with his team.
Although they all wanted to stay and watch Alex die, they knew the risks.
What if Alex’s HP was too high and 12 barrels of gasoline weren’t enough to burn him?
The plan had already reached this stage. It was about to succeed, so they couldn’t make such a stupid mistake.
Chen Yu’s team members had already put on their black masks and looked at each other.
They wanted to stay, but because of the negative effect of the sewage stench, they had no choice but to leave with Hao Zhou and the others.
After watching Hao Zhou and the others leave, Fang Heng changed into another black face mask and continued to watch the zombies falling into the zombie pit.
No matter if they were ordinary zombies or mutated zombies, as long as they fell into the zombie pit, there would be no survivors!
The 3.5 optimized version of the fully automatic zombie pit was simply too brilliant!
There was nothing to do actually, he just need to stand there.
A vast amount of survival points went to Fang Heng.
This kind of collection speed was simply explosive!
In just a mere five minutes, Fang Heng had already collected 10,000 survival points!
The only drawback was that other than the evolution crystals, all the items dropped by the zombies were also burned into ashes in the fire pit.
[Hint: Your HP is dropping rapidly. Please leave the sewer as soon as possible.]
[Hint: You are at risk of being infected.]
“I can’t hold on any longer.”
Another five minutes passed. Seeing that his HP was dropping, Fang Heng frowned and quickly walked toward the other direction of the sewer.
In the garden of the villa, Fang Heng stuck his head out of the sewer and breathed heavily.
The back garden had been completely occupied by the zombie clones.
Any zombie that accidentally broke into the back garden would be killed by the clones!
Fang Heng took out a bottle of first aid spray from his backpack and sprayed it on his nose.
[Hint: You have used a healing spray. Your HP is recovering rapidly.]
His HP was increasing rapidly.
After waiting for three minutes, the stench in his nose had completely disappeared. Fang Heng returned to the sewer once again.
Alex, who was burned by the flames, lasted for a full hour. In the end, he was burnt to a black mass.
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 4 mutated zombie-Alex.]
[Hint: You have obtained a Tier 3 evolution crystal.]
[Hint: As the first player in this world to kill a Tier 4 mutated zombie, you will receive the highest reward according to your contribution points: a random A-level skill book.]
[Hint: Drawing in progress...]
[Hint: You have obtained a skill book: strengthen the body.]
Skill-strengthen the body.

Skill description: After learning this skill, you will receive an additional 2 points in your basic physique, 2 points in your basic strength and a small increase in your poison resistance. (For every 1 level increase of this skill, you will gain an additional 0.5 physique and 0.5 strength. The maximum increase of this skill is 30.]
Skill description: Automatically releases this skill, immediately consumes 60% of your maximum vitality and immediately restores 80% of your maximum HP (Cooldown: 6 hours).
“This is good stuff!”
Fang Heng quickly scanned through the skill and immediately determined the value of this skill book.
It was a powerful skill book that could increase basic attributes and it also came with an instant health recovery skill!
It could recover up to 80% of the maximum HP!
Most importantly, his zombie clones could also inherit the effect of this skill!
Since zombies did not have stamina, this meant that casting this skill did not consume any energy.
It was equivalent to the zombie gaining half of its HP...
Fang Heng patted the skill book on his head. As for the Tier 3 evolution crystal, he temporarily kept it in his backpack.
[Hint: Player learns skill-strengthen the body.]
[Hint: You have acquired skill: strengthen the body (Level 1).]
“Eh?”
Fang Heng suddenly realized that after learning the skill to strengthen the body, the dizziness brought by the stench in the sewer seemed to have slightly weakened.
The smell was also not as bad as before...
“This should be the effect of a small increase in poison resistance.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself in a low voice.
At the same time, Hao Zhou and the others who were buying gasoline from the federation in the federation warehouse also received the game notification.
Everyone stopped what they were doing at the same time and excitedly opened the game log to check.
Other than Hao Zhou who had obtained a B-level skill book, everyone else had obtained a C+ level skill book.
Raising their heads, everyone saw the joy on the other party’s face.
It was a success!
Completing the mission with the relative of the apocalypse merchant was indeed profitable!
This wave of rewards was aplenty!

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - Talent Enhancement Plan
paragraphs: The fire pit burned for more than ten hours.
When the sun began to set, Fang Heng threw the last barrel of gasoline into the fire pit.
He raised his head.
Many zombies were still gathering around the hole in the ground, falling into the fire pit one after another.
The fire had already started to die out.
After this battle, Fang Heng had killed at least three-quarters of the zombies in Hope Town!
Fang Heng counted his earnings. In one day’s time, he had gained a total of 11,000 survival points!
It was about time to consider leaving Hope Town early.
If he continued to stay here, the efficiency of killing zombies would be much slower.
Moreover, as the number of zombies in Hope Town decreased significantly, the small player teams and federation players outside the town would gradually enter the town to search for materials.
At that time, his zombie clones would meet the players and easily get into trouble.
Fang Heng felt that this wave of greed had been enough and there was not enough profit to be made in the town.
It was better to go back as soon as possible.
In addition, Fang Heng was also a little worried about the situation in the prison shelter.
Before leaving the prison, Fang Heng asked Liao Bufan to keep a close eye on the Dawn gaming company, Prisoner Snake and his gang.
Once he discovered that they were making a move, Jimmy would immediately find him in the real world.
Jimmy had not contacted him, which meant that the prison shelter was still safe for the time being.
Let’s go!
Let’s go to the federation first! Let’s get the large truck!
Fang Heng raised his hand.
The thick layer of evolution crystals that had been deposited in the underground pit turned into a ray of red light and was absorbed into Fang Heng’s palm.
[Hint: You have obtained evolution crystal fragment*9017, complete evolution crystal*56.]
Not bad!
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
The complete evolution crystals exploded in Fang Heng’s palm one after another.
Clusters of red mist were absorbed by Fang Heng’s palm.
After absorbing more than 30 complete evolution crystals, Fang Heng’s level finally rose to Level 10.
[Hint: Your level has been upgraded to Level 10.]
[Hint: Due to your talent skill, you have gained an additional 10 zombie clones.]
[Hint: You have reached Level 10. You can look for an individual talent enhancement plan in the game and complete the talent enhancement.]
[Hint: Only when the player is at Level 10 can the talent enhancement be completed.]
“It’s coming, talent enhancement!”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
The special settings of the King of Gods’ game!
In the game, all players who reached Level 10 would receive their first talent enhancement!
If they wanted to enhance themselves, they had to first find an enhancement plan.
The talent enhancement plan was aimed at each player’s talent, and it was also divided into different levels according to the intensity.
The higher the level of the enhancement plan, the higher the enhancement range.
As for the enhancement plan, the player had to trigger a mission in each game world and rely on himself to explore and obtain it.
Only for the Zombie Apocalypse game.
The average player only needed to increase the apocalypse merchant’s favorability to a certain level to be able to receive the D to C+ level talent enhancement plan from him.
The difficulty of obtaining a B-level or higher-level talent enhancement plan became very high.

Since the start of the game, the majority of the players were only able to find a D to C-level talent enhancement plan. Only super large organizations like the federation had the opportunity to look for an A-level talent enhancement plan, or even an S-level talent enhancement plan.
According to the data released by the federation every year, the number of players who actually completed a Tier 1 S-level talent enhancement plan each year was less than 10.
The original owner of Fang Heng’s body received a B+ level enhanced transformation plan.

The specific additional attributes allowed the zombie clones to receive additional attribute enhancements and a reduction in regeneration time, as well as a slight increase in the movement speed of the zombie clones.
In addition, players could only awaken and complete the first talent enhancement when they were at Level 10.
Once a player was over Level 10 and had not completed the enhancement, the first opportunity to enhance would be wasted.
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.

Talent enhancement was definitely necessary! The matter of leveling up could be slowed down. After all, another level up would only add 11 more zombie clones. It would not be able to cause a qualitative change.
The problem was where to find the enhancement plan.
Got it!
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company!

As a large-scale gaming company, Phoenix Sound Gaming Company had established a super-large-scale shelter in the server of Zombie Apocalypse District 6. It was ranked fourth among the top ten forces in District 6!
The original owner of the body had once found a report on the internet. Phoenix Sound Gaming Company had completed two S-level talent enhancement projects within eight years!
This meant that Phoenix Sound Gaming Company should have information on the S-level talent enhancement projects!
“Looks like I have to think of a way from within the company to see how I can get my hands on the projects.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
Other than that, there was also the Dark Knights.
The Dark Knights were part of the main storyline of the Zombie Apocalypse world.
Similarly, they were also one of the most mysterious and top-tier NPC forces in the game.
They definitely had a top-tier talent enhancement and transformation plan in their hands!
The rewards from the T-virus mission should be enough for him to join the Dark Knights.
It all depended on whether he could get the enhancement plan from them.
“If I start from both sides at the same time, I’ll always be able to find a talent enhancement plan.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself as he turned around and left the sewer.
In any case, he would first go back to the federation to exchange for a large transport vehicle before returning to the prison.
“I’m too tired. I really want to have a good sleep.”
He had been busy the whole of last night, and today, he was in high spirits as he watched an entire day of killing monsters in the automatic zombie pit...
Fang Heng had not slept the entire time. He had only been able to hold on until now by pouring himself a cup of coffee.
Now that the coffee had stopped, the negative effects of ‘sleepiness’ started to appear.
Soon, Fang Heng left the Hope Town sewer.
He yawned as he went to the federal warehouse and submitted a portion of the video recording of killing Alex to the female federal officer.
“Thank you for your help to the federation. We will follow up with an investigation on Alex and verify your video recording.”
“The person-in-charge of this mission, officer Li Weiyu, is very satisfied with your operation.”
“He has approved that we can pay the reward for this mission in advance. If there are any problems in the future, we will contact the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company directly.”
Fang Heng recalled the federal military officer he had seen not long ago.
That person always had a straight face. Who would have thought that he was a good person?
In reality, the federation had always adopted a soft-hearted policy towards the ordinary people.
This was especially true for talented players like Fang Heng.
The federation had always taken a soft approach to recruiting.
Even if the other party was unwilling to accept the offer, the federation would not force him.
What they wanted more were peace and cooperation.
The federation needed to put more effort into the higher tier King of Gods’ games.
The competition there was more brutal!
For them, that was the main battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - The Reward Was Obtained
paragraphs: Regarding the Zombie Apocalypse, the Vampire Apocalypse and the Wasteland Apocalypse...
These three basic game worlds added up to more than 30 mirror servers.
The federation really couldn’t handle it.
What they had to do was to try their best to ensure the stability of these low-level games and maintain the stability of the entire society.

If someone was able to establish a large force in the Zombie Apocalypse to provide the players with a place to live, the federation would only be happy, and they would even provide some help for free.
The prerequisite was that this person’s identity was innocent and could not destroy the stability of the game world.
As for whether or not they could become the boss of the server, the federation did not care.
Their annual investment in the game was far greater than their output.
Of course, there was one thing that the federation would choose to do their best to fight for.
The ‘end’ of the game world.
The end meant ownership.
“Thank you.”

“You’re welcome. In addition, according to the agreement, the reward will be 500 King of Gods’ points. Because of the game’s trading limit, we can trade with you over a few months. You can also use the method of physical exchange.”
“I need to exchange for physical items. A Ural-790 military off-road transport vehicle, the one that cost 465 King of Gods’ points, and also King of Gods’ space item number GY529128.”
Fang Heng was already prepared.
This afternoon, while looking at the automatic zombie pit, he was browsing through the King of Gods’ space’s transport vehicles.
The young lady behind the counter looked at Fang Heng in surprise.
A large military transport vehicle?
Why would he want that kind of thing?
“Alright, we will arrange it as soon as possible. It is expected to arrive tomorrow afternoon. You still have 35 King of Gods’ points left. Do you need to collect them now?”
“Help me collect them. Thank you.”
[Hint: You have obtained 35 King of Gods’ points.]
The federation reward had been obtained!
Including the mission that Old Black had requested to blow up the generator, Fang Heng now had 95 King of Gods’ points.
Previously, Fang Heng had originally wanted to share some of the rewards with Hao Zhou and the others as payment for this mission.
However, Hao Zhou and the others resolutely declined. They said that the skill books they had obtained were already enough, so they were embarrassed to take more.
However, in the future, they could continue to cooperate on such missions.
Therefore, Fang Heng could only give them some food and materials as compensation.
After all, Fang Heng didn’t lack food at the moment, and a large portion of the food would go bad if left untouched.
He was so sleepy that he simply found a clean spot in the warehouse, threw down a simple bed on the spot and went offline.
“Team 12 doesn’t even have a lounge or a recliner... I still have to go back to the villa to sleep.”
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
Morning meeting.
There was a weekly meeting. Other than the higher-ups of the gaming company, all the team leaders of the gaming department participated in it.
Fang Heng didn’t know about this matter, so he was naturally absent.
“Which team received the federation’s mission to kill Alex? Why did they accept it without my approval?”
In front of the conference table, everyone looked at each other.
Alex’s mission? No one received it right?
In the silence, the female assistant said timidly, “Sister Ru, this mission was personally approved by President Qin.”
“President Qin again? What’s wrong with her? Ever since she came, the company has been in a mess!”
“For all the trouble she had caused in the past, we were the ones to clean up the mess behind her back!”
“Stop stirring trouble if you can’t make any contributions!”
Li Ru flew into a rage on the spot.
The anger that stemmed from jealousy was 30% real and 70% fake.
Li Ru had been eyeing the position of the company’s president for a long time!
She was almost certain of it, but she didn’t expect Qin Shuran to suddenly appear out of nowhere and become the company’s executive vice president overnight.
She was on the same level as her!
How long did it take her to get to this position?
That rookie who had just graduated not long ago could be on the same level as her?
Now, she had even become her biggest competitor for the position of President!
On what basis?
From that day onwards, Li Ru had been secretly targeting her.
“The federation has always been a very important client of ours. If this mission fails, will she be able to shoulder this responsibility!?”
Many people present knew that President Li and President Qin were not on good terms. Most of them were quietly being spectators as they watched Li Ru’s performance.
There were also quite some people who had been fooled by Li Ru and were similarly filled with righteous indignation.
Li Ru was trying to stir up everyone’s emotions, trying to seek greater benefits for herself.
Suddenly, a weak voice interrupted her words.
“But... President Li, the federation’s mission has been completed.”
Li Ru’s expression changed several times in an instant.
For a moment, she stood awkwardly on the spot.
“Pfft!”
In the silence, Gu Yijie could not help but cover his mouth and laugh out loud.
Li Ru glared at Gu Yijie.
“What are you laughing at?”
“No, no.” Gu Yijie waved his hand with an innocent expression. “I just suddenly thought of a joke.”
Li Ru turned her head and vented her anger on the little assistant. She said sternly, “Speak clearly! What exactly is going on!”

“I just received a reply message from the federation this morning. They said that they have reviewed the mission video submitted last night and confirmed that the mission has been completed. They are very grateful to our Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.”
“Also they are especially grateful to Mr Fang Heng, who has completed the mission, for his assistance to the federation.”
The little assistant lowered her head while making the report, not daring to look at Li Ru.
When she received the news this morning, she was similarly in disbelief.
“The federation is very satisfied with this operation. They said that they will strengthen their cooperation with us in the future.”
Li Ru’s face was terrifyingly gloomy.
She felt as though she had eaten sh*t!
Li Ru had already inquired about this mission from many aspects. It was impossible to complete this mission related to Alex!
Why did it end like this?!
Were all these people useless?
The team leaders of the Zombie Apocalypse game looked at each other.
Then, they lowered their heads and started to whisper.
They all knew the difficulty of this mission.
The difficulty was the time limit.
As the game had just started, the overall strength of the players was still very low.
Even if they switched servers, the highest level of the players was only Level 4, and they didn’t have any combat power.
For a behemoth like the federation, they couldn’t even get rid of Alex with two rocket launchers.
What could they do?
Therefore, after discussion, all the teams came to the same conclusion.
This was an impossible mission!
But now...
Fang Heng?
Who was he?
What ability did he have to complete that mission?
Most of the people present had never heard of the name ‘Fang Heng’.
“President Li, Team 12 has achieved such results in such a short time. I think President Qin’s leadership is pretty good.”
Gu Yijie stood up casually and even stretched.
“Sigh, I’m tired, I’m so tired. Let’s call it a day. I’ll leave first, you guys continue.”
Li Ru gritted her teeth so hard that they were about to break. She stared at Gu Yijie.
“Oh right, also, didn’t you apply for the permission to obtain the S-level talent enhancement program a few days ago?”
“I think we should let President Qin discuss this matter together.. After all, there is only one slot left for this mission. We have to be more cautious, right?”

These three basic game worlds added up to more than 30 mirror servers.
The federation really couldn’t handle it.
What they had to do was to try their best to ensure the stability of these low-level games and maintain the stability of the entire society.

If someone was able to establish a large force in the Zombie Apocalypse to provide the players with a place to live, the federation would only be happy, and they would even provide some help for free.
The prerequisite was that this person’s identity was innocent and could not destroy the stability of the game world.
As for whether or not they could become the boss of the server, the federation did not care.
Their annual investment in the game was far greater than their output.
Of course, there was one thing that the federation would choose to do their best to fight for.
The ‘end’ of the game world.
The end meant ownership.
“Thank you.”
“You’re welcome.
In addition, according to the agreement, the reward will be 500 King of Gods’ points.

You can also use the method of physical exchange.”
“I need to exchange for physical items.

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - Military Off-road Transport Vehicle
paragraphs: On the second day, Fang Heng slept until noon.
Thinking that he could get his hands on the off-road transport vehicle when he went online, Fang Heng simply did not return to the company.
He hurriedly went downstairs to grab a few mouthfuls of rice and directly logged into the game cabin in the villa.
In the warehouse, the military transport vehicle had already arrived and was quietly parked behind the warehouse of the federation’s temporary resource point.
Chen Yu brought Fang Heng to look at the vehicle together.
Item: URAL-790 military off-road transport vehicle.

Description: Full-time all-wheel-drive, with an independent suspension system and a central tire inflating system. It can carry people. In the wild, it can carry a payload of 4.5 tons. On hard roads, it can carry a payload of 6 tons, the vehicle can operate in climates ranging from negative 50 degrees Celsius to 50 degrees Celsius.
“Fang Heng, not bad, right? This big guy can’t fit into your backpack. We’ll fill it up for you and you can drive it away at any time.”
Compared to the last time they met, Chen Yu was much more enthusiastic.
He had received instructions from his superior to try his best to rope in Fang Heng. It would be best if he could recruit him to work for the federation.
“You’re welcome. If there’s anything else you need, just let me know. I’ll try my best to help you.”
“That’s enough! I’m very satisfied!”
The various attributes of the transport vehicle could be said to be luxurious.
Fang Heng rubbed his wrist. He couldn’t wait to go up and try it out.
With it, he hoped that the corpse vines in town could be packed up and taken away!
In the future, using it to deliver goods would also be more convenient!
The federation was also very reliable. They even helped to fill up the truck with fuel.
“Hahaha, it’s good that you’re satisfied. Also, I’ll ask you privately on behalf of Officer Li, are you interested in joining our federation?”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows in surprise.
“Huh? What?”
Join the federation? He had so much dark history, and the federation wanted to recruit him?
This was the first time Chen Yu had done such a job as a pimp.
He scratched his hair in embarrassment.
“Um... I mean, if you’re interested in joining the federation, we can help you apply and join the core team of the federation.”
“Yeah, well, our benefits are quite good, the food is good, and if you perform well, you can even get a girlfriend...”
Chen Yu stopped talking.
“Heh... in short, the benefits are pretty good.”
A simple and honest smile appeared on Chen Yu’s face.
He felt that someone like Fang Heng would not have such concerns.
“Thank you, I’ll consider it.”
“Alright, our federation welcomes capable players like you at any time. If you have any intentions, you can come and look for me.”
“Let’s add each other as friends. We’ll keep in touch in the future. If you need anything, you can contact us as well.”
After the battle with Alex yesterday, Chen Yu and Fang Heng were completely convinced.
Yesterday, after the federation team finished analyzing the video provided by Chen Yu and Fang Heng, they gave a very high evaluation to Fang Heng’s team.
The idea of a zombie pit wasn’t that amazing.
However, it was really too difficult to complete this plan!
Ordinary people simply couldn’t do it!
Even the federation couldn’t do it.
After repeated rounds, there were still two problems that plagued the federation team.
First, in order for the explosion to collapse the road surface at the intersection, most of the durability of the ceiling of the sewer had already been knocked off with a stone hammer.
This resulted in the ground being blown off by more than a dozen small explosives...
How long would it take to manually knock off a layer of durability?
And how long would it take to dig a deep hole in the sewer?
How did Fang Heng’s team manage to take care of these two things in such a short time?
The second question was also the one that puzzled the federation the most.
How did the zombie horde in the sewer disappear?
What the hell!
However, the federation no longer had the energy to investigate how Fang Heng’s team had completed their mission.
Now, the federation had even bigger problems.
Previously, the federation had spent a lot of effort and even offered a high reward to kill Alex. Their main goal was to obtain the corpse that was left behind after Alex’s death.
The corpse had already been burned into a pile of charcoal.

They needed to spend even more effort and spend a large amount of King of Gods’ points to exchange for high-level items from the King of Gods’ space. They also needed to obtain a small portion of the research samples from Alex’s corpse.
There was nothing they could do. This was a part of the main mission of the Zombie Apocalypse and was closely related to the ‘ending’.
No matter what price they had to pay, the federation had to finish the main mission as soon as possible!
“We’ll continue to work together next time.”
“Of course! I’ll treat you to a drink next time!”
After adding him as a friend, Chen Yu waved at Fang Heng and watched as he drove off in his truck.
“Eh?”
Chen Yu suddenly felt that something was wrong.
“That’s weird.”
“Isn’t that the direction to Hope Town?”
“Why did he drive the truck to Hope Town?”
Soon, Fang Heng parked the truck at the east gate of Hope Town.
The news of the drastic decrease in the number of zombies in Hope Town quickly spread out.
Fang Heng noticed that there were a few player teams outside the entrance of the town trying to find out the situation from afar.
Fang Heng was worried that the truck would be destroyed by passersby, so he had to spend a little more time.
He controlled his zombie clones to come to the entrance of the town to greet them.
Before long, the players outside the town saw an amazing scene.
A group of zombie clones gathered at the entrance of the town.
They lined up in a row and slowly moved forward.
Behind them, a large military truck was following closely, slowly driving into Hope Town.
“Start counting the profits!”
Returning to the temporary residence, Fang Heng rubbed his hands excitedly and opened his character panel to count.
Yesterday, he had accumulated close to 12,000 survival points and over 9,000 evolution crystal fragments.
It was enough for 40 zombie clones to complete the transformation of the corpse vine parasite!
Good!
The transformation of the corpse vine parasite could quickly convert all the points into combat strength!
Fang Heng controlled the zombie clones to approach the modified corpse vine one by one, completing the transformation of the corpse vine parasite.
[Hint: You have spent 12,000 survival points, 4,000 evolution crystal fragments and completed the parasitism of 40 zombies.]
After the players reached Level 10, Fang Heng now had a total of 55 zombie clones. Among them, 43 had completed the transformation of the corpse vine, and the remaining 12 were still unmodified.
After the modification, the strength of the single zombie clone had increased tremendously! One-on-one fighting against a Tier 1 mutated zombie was not a big problem.
With these 43 vine zombies, Fang Heng felt like he was invincible again.
Without considering other players creating a disturbance, he could even send these vine zombies to clean up the entire Hope Town!
Also, apart from ‘hacking’ to collect materials to clean up the wandering zombies, the zombie clones could also help defend the prison.
At this stage, who could pass through the defensive net made up of these vine zombies?
Just those five scums from the Dawn Guild?
What was the difference between them coming over and delivering vegetables?
Fang Heng controlled the vine zombie clones and had them carry ten pots of corpse vines into the back of the truck.
Finally, he forced seven more vine zombies into the back of the truck.
Another one was stuffed into the driver’s cab...
In order to save time, Fang Heng finally let all the remaining zombies stab each other to death on the spot!
Done! Go home!
