chapters.title: Chapter 79 - Mission Completion
paragraphs: Four hours later, Fang Heng arrived outside the apocalypse camp.
“Before I go back to the prison, I might as well submit the T-virus mission on the way.”

Fang Heng muttered to himself. He stopped the truck and got a few vine zombies to go down, then left them on the side of the road. After that, he continued driving the truck into the apocalypse merchant camp.
Seeing that Fang Heng’s truck had arrived, the NPC unloading workers in the merchant camp all thought that it was a new job.
They instinctively surrounded it and prepared to unload the goods from the truck.
“No, no, there are no materials in the truck! Disperse!”
Fang Heng smiled bitterly and quickly waved his hand to disperse the NPC workers.
The truck was filled with corpse vines. What if they were accidentally infected?
“We’re not here to deliver materials! The back of the truck is filled with dangerous infectious agents. Don’t get too close.”
After shouting for a long time, the NPC unloading workers finally dispersed.
Vettel heard the commotion outside and walked out of the small wooden cabin.
His eyes lit up when he saw the military truck parked in the open space.
“My friend! Is this your new car? Hahaha! I haven’t seen you for a few days. Looks like you’ve made some money outside. Come in and have a drink. It’s on me!”
“Hahahahaha, you guessed it right. I went to Hope Town and got a lot of good stuff.”
Fang Heng was in a good mood. He laughed and entered the cabin with Vettel.
“Come and have a taste of the new wine I’ve received in the past two days.”
After entering the cabin, Vettel took out an old bottle of wine from under the counter and started bragging.
“It’s rare to get such good wine on such a lousy day.”
“There’s no hurry to drink. Help me pay for this mission first.”
Fang Heng was afraid that Vettel would pass out from drinking.
He took out two bottles of T-virus serum from his pocket and placed them on the counter.
“Oh! You got it so quickly!”
Seeing the T-virus serum that Fang Heng casually took out, Vettel let out a cry of surprise.
Vettel’s expression was very surprised, and even very excited.
He carefully picked up the T-virus serum and placed it in his palm to observe.
“You managed to get two sets?!”
“To be honest, Fang Heng, you’re really beyond my expectations!!”
“That’s too surprising! Believe me, these two sets of T-virus serum will definitely make the Dark Knights look at you in a whole new light!”
“Look at me in a whole new light?”
“Just based on this mission reward, I’m prepared to empty their entire camp!”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
“Vettel, don’t be anxious. Look at these again.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng took out the corpse vine samples, the corpse vine parasite samples and Alex’s samples from his backpack one by one and placed them neatly on the counter.
Vettel looked at these samples with a little doubt.
“Hmm? Fang Heng, what are these things?”
“It’s troublesome to explain. You’ll know once you look at this.”
Fang Heng also handed over the researcher’s notebook that he had brought out from the hospital’s secret research room.
The game log began to sputter with messages.
[Hint: Mission completion...]
[Mission name: Find the T-virus serum.]
[Difficulty: SSS]
[Basic mission requirement: Find the T-virus serum.]
[Current basic mission completion rate: 200%.]
[Optional side mission 1: Collect the corpse vine sample (additional 1.5 times basic reward).]
[Optional side mission 1 completion rate: 100%.]
[Optional side mission 2: Collect the corpse vine parasite sample (additional 2 times basic reward).]
[Optional side mission 2 completion rate: 507%.]
[Optional side mission 3: Find Alex’s main body or sample (additional 4 times basic reward).]
[Optional side mission 3 completion rate: 200%.]
“Damn!”
“41 times the reward!”
“So I’m so greedy!”
Looking at the row of messages in the game log, Fang Heng was also surprised.
This calculation formula was somewhat different from what he had expected, but it was still shocking enough.
Vettel quickly flipped through the experimental notebook that Fang Heng handed over.
The more he read, the more excited he became. That big face full of whiskers turned red from excitement.
“Fang Heng! Amazing! I never thought that you could do this!”
“Corpse vine! That mutated plant really exists!”
“Unbelievable!!!”
“Oh my god! It’s a high-level experimental subject! Alex? You killed it! And even got a live sample of it!?”
“Do you know! With these samples, the progress of the Dark Knights’ research project will be greatly improved. Maybe we can find a way to restore peace to this world!”
Vettel had never been so incoherent before.
Because he was too excited, he stared at Fang Heng with a burning gaze, and his voice became louder uncontrollably.
“Fang Heng! Your discovery and the samples you brought back are too valuable!”
“Do you know! You might be able to change this world!”
Was there a need to be so excited?
Not to the extent that it was not necessary.
“Cough, cough.”
Fang Heng coughed lightly.
“Okay, I got it, Vettel Don’t be so excited, just calm down.”
“Excited? No! This isn’t considered excited! When the Dark Knights find out about your samples, they’ll be even crazier than me!”
Vettel tried hard to calm himself down. He carefully took over the various samples on the counter.
“Fang Heng, I could have settled the reward for you directly, but I’m sorry, your mission completion rate has far exceeded the range of the rewards I can provide.”
“I’ll contact my friend from the Dark Knights now. He’ll come to see you personally and settle the reward for you. What do you think?”
“Of course, Vettel.”
“Hahaha, I’m proud to have a friend like you. You can stay here tonight. We’ll drink until we’re drunk. I’ll call my friend right now!”
“Believe me, he’ll definitely rush over after hearing the news! I bet 50 cents that you’ll see him at dawn tomorrow!”
[Hint: You’ve completed the mission with flying colours. Your friendship with Vettel has greatly improved.]
“Vettel, forget about tonight. We’ll celebrate next time. I still have things to do, so I need to return to the prison shelter as soon as possible.”
Fang Heng pointed at the large truck outside.
“I brought back some ‘specialities’ from Hope Town. It’s not safe for them to stay here for the night.”
Vettel turned to look at the truck outside.
“Alright then. I’ll save this bottle of good wine for tomorrow’s celebration.”
“Are you free to come here tomorrow morning? My friend from the Dark Knights wants to see you as soon as possible.”
“Of course. By the way, I have another question to ask you. It’s about the talent enhancement plan. Do you know about it?”
“Oh? So soon?! Your special talent has also awakened?”
Vettel looked at Fang Heng and nodded.
“Indeed. Many people have awakened their special talents since the Zombie Apocalypse.. With your ability, it’s reasonable for you to awaken your special talent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - A-level Talent Enhancement Plan
paragraphs: “Then you’ve come to the right person. I have quite a lot of information on the plans to improve your talent and ability.”
“Hehe, with our friendship, I can give you the best one for free. Don’t tell anyone.”
Vettel turned around and took out a rolled-up paper list from a box behind the counter.
“Take this. This is my private collection.”
[Hint: You have obtained an individual talent enhancement plan (unappraised) (Level: A -)*1.]
[Hint: You can use 300 survival points to appraise this plan.]
[Description: After appraising, the King of Gods will create a talent evolution plan that is suitable for the current player’s talent.]
[Description: After the appraisal is completed, the talent evolution plan will bind the soul.]
It’s an A- level talent enhancement plan?

It was said that the highest level talent enhancement plan that could be exchanged in the apocalypse merchant camp was a B- level talent enhancement plan. Who would have thought that Vettel would give an A- level talent enhancement plan?
Fang Heng thought that this could indeed be considered Vettel’s most precious treasure.
Even though his current goal was an S-level talent enhancement plan.
“Thank you, Vettel. I can feel the deep friendship between us.”
“Of course. I have always been forthright with my friends. That’s what people outside say.”
[Hint: You have completed the appraisal after deducting 300 survival points. You have obtained an individual talent enhancement transformation plan-zombie clone physique enhancement.]
Individual talent enhancement plan-zombie clone physique enhancement.
Level: A-
Enhancement description: Collect relevant materials to complete talent enhancement.

Enhancement effect description: Your zombie clone can inherit an additional 300% HP bonus from the main body. You will also receive additional weight-bearing. You will receive an additional 30% bonus when determining your physique attribute.
Fang Heng read the enhancement description in detail.
He was very dissatisfied!
His current zombie clone had more than 1,000 HP, which was more than enough for him.
It was more than enough to deal with ordinary zombies.
If he encountered a higher level mutated zombie, even if his zombie clone’s HP doubled, it would be useless!
Continuing to enhance his zombie clone’s physique attribute was very weak for Fang Heng.
This enhancement plan was completely useless!
“How is it? Are you not satisfied?”
Vetter saw something from Fang Heng’s expression.
He spread his hands and said helplessly, “I can’t help it. This is the best transformation plan I can find.”
“I think the Dark Knights must have a better plan. You can try asking them. They have always been very generous to their people.”
“Thank you, Vettel. You have always helped me. I will come back tomorrow morning.”

“You don’t have to be so polite. We are all helping each other. This month, our apocalypse camp’s performance is at the top-tier. Oh right, our camp is about to be upgraded and we are still in urgent need of some materials. Take a look...”
Fang Heng threw the A- level enhancement plan that he got from the apocalypse merchant camp for free into his backpack.
The attributes were very poor, so he did not need the plan.
After leaving the apocalypse merchant camp, Fang Heng drove the truck back to the prison.
“Good guy!”
“Boss, you even have a military transport vehicle after going out for a few days!”
During the time that Fang Heng was not around, Liao Bufan had already completed all the repairs to the prison.
The prison’s main gate had also been repaired.
Due to the lack of electricity, Liao Bufan had no choice but to personally run over to help open the prison’s main gate.
Looking at the large truck slowly entering the prison, Liao Bufan’s face was filled with envy.
“This truck is worth a lot of money! Big Brother, where did you buy this from?”
Fang Heng parked the truck outside the entrance of the prison’s Building No. 3 and jumped out of the truck.
“Hope Town, I got it from the federation.”
Liao Bufan swallowed his saliva.
The federation?
What on earth did Big Brother go out for?
The federation actually sent such high-level goods like military trucks to him?
“Let’s go, let’s talk inside.”
Fang Heng and Liao Bufan walked into Building No. 3 together.
Within a few days, Liao Bufan and the others had reinforced and tidied up parts of Building No. 3 other than the basement.
The interior of Building No. 3 had also been carefully cleaned by the NPCs. It was much cleaner than before.
“Did Prisoner Snake’s group make any movements? Did anyone come to investigate the prison?”
“They don’t have the time to deal with us now.”
“Huh? What do you mean?”
Liao Bufan shook his head with a troubled look on his face.
“Sigh! They were lucky to find an abandoned iron mine in the forest.”
Iron mine!
They were so lucky?
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows and immediately became interested.
In the game, iron ores were the most widely used basic mineral materials!
“What happened? Tell me in detail.”
Liao Bufan told Fang Heng in detail what had happened during this period.
Generally speaking, Prisoner Snake and his group did want to seize the prison and take revenge at the beginning.

After Prisoner Snake reported the information about the prison to the Dawn Gaming Guild, the guild immediately gave strong support and prepared to send people to join the game after the game server transfer function was activated.
During that period, Prisoner Snake had sent people to secretly scout around the prison more than once.
But he didn’t expect that just a few days ago, Prisoner Snake and his group of people unexpectedly found an abandoned iron mine in the forest!
When the Dawn Guild heard this news, they were ecstatic!
On the day the server changed, the Dawn Guild sent a large number of new players to District 8, occupying the abandoned iron mine resource point immediately.
The iron mine resource point and the sturdy prison shelter.
They were the best combination ever!
In the past two days, the Dawn Guild had been wantonly purchasing smelting furnaces and other refining equipment, starting to build around the iron mine resource point.
They were so busy that they did not have the time to come to the prison.
“That’s the gist of the situation. According to my judgment, the prison is their next target. Sooner or later, they will come and look for us.”
“Earlier today, I saw them using the survival radio to threaten the players who live nearby to leave as soon as possible and don’t block their way.”
Fang Heng shrugged.
“As expected of their style.”
Liao Bufan sighed worriedly.
“Sigh, I’ve been observing them secretly. There are more than 40 players from the Dawn Guild who have entered the game.”
“I reckon that they’ll soon be able to make iron rods and knives with stronger combat abilities with the iron ores. When the time comes, they might just start with us.”
Liao Bufan was unusually serious.
“Fang Heng, we need to make preparations.”
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
He felt that Liao Bufan’s words made a lot of sense!
Rather than passively defending, it was better to attack and finish them off once and for all while they were still accumulating strength!
The most important point was...
Iron ore!
That was iron ore!
Whether it was the upgrading and expansion of the shelter or the production of basic production items, iron ore was a basic consumable.
If they did not go and snatch it, would they be able to sleep well at night?

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - Snatch One Wave
paragraphs: Fang Heng did not feel the slightest bit of psychological burden when it came to snatching items from Prisoner Snake and his gang.
In fact, when the prison was attacked by Prisoner Snake and his gang, Fang Heng had also thought of getting rid of them once and for all.
However, he was still not strong enough at that time.
Prisoner Snake and his gang were all players with combat-type talent abilities!
If he forced them into a corner and if they might retaliate by fighting with their lives on the line, he may end up losing a mercenary...
By that time, Fang Heng would have to pay a large sum of the deposit and his heart would ache for a long time.
Now, the situation was completely different.
After the trip to Hope Town, his zombie clones had been super enhanced!
He had slept for the whole morning, so he didn’t feel sleepy at all.
He had decided!
Tonight, he would rob that mine!
Fang Heng made up his mind and raised his head.
“You’re right. We need to make preparations early. Tonight, I’m going to look for them and completely solve this problem.”
“What? Big Brother, what did you say?”
Liao Bufan was stunned.
He blinked his eyes and looked baffled.
He thought to himself, “What did I say? What did I say?”
“I just told you to prepare for defense. Are you going to look for them to fight?”
“Fang Heng? You want to fight tonight? Calm down, let’s...”
Fang Heng looked like he had everything under control.
“Don’t worry, I have a plan.”
Liao Bufan shut up.
The words ‘I have a plan’ left a deep impression in Liao Bufan’s mind.
He remembered that Fang Heng had said the same thing last time.
At first, he didn’t believe it either.
Later on, Fang Heng took out a focused flamethrower and taught the spider zombie in the underground passage a lesson.
“I’ll keep watch tonight. You should go rest. It’s been hard on you lately.”
“Alright, I’ll sleep first... call me if you need anything.”
Liao Bufan soon figured it out.
“Why do I have to worry so much?”
“Whatever Big Brother says, he’ll do. He’ll hit whoever he wants!”
He didn’t care. He just needed to cling to his legs!
When Liao Bufan went offline, Fang Heng walked out of Building No. 3.
He controlled the vine zombies on the military truck to go back and forth a few times and moved all the corpse vines into the new super-large shelter in the basement.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng personally made a ‘Do Not Enter’ wooden sign and stuck it at the entrance of the shelter in the basement.
If anyone dared to break in, he would be considered unlucky...
After doing all this, Fang Heng gave the eight vine zombies the order to go to the abandoned iron mine area.
He returned to the newly cleaned private lounge on the first floor.
Fang Heng lit a bonfire.
He set up a barbecue grill.
He fiddled with the skewers on the grill while thinking.
After leveling up, the vine zombies had an 80-20 chance of winning against a Tier 1 mutated zombie one-on-one.
So, what was the actual combat effect of using them to deal with players?
At this stage of the game, very few players had reached Level 5.
At most, they could only fight against ordinary zombies.
The vine zombies should be able to crush them, right?
After all, his vine zombie clones had a total of 1,000 HP, which was at least six or seven times the HP of an ordinary player.
They also had 30% physical damage reduction and 80% HP instant recovery skills!
Right, they could also use vine entanglement skills in close combat.
If he were to face such a large group of vine zombies...
Just thinking about it would be terrifying!
Fang Heng unconsciously rubbed his hands together.
He couldn’t wait any longer.
It was a good idea to use the people from the Dawn Gaming Guild, Prisoner Snake and gang, as the vine zombies’ damage testing machine!
“I can also get an iron mine!”
Fang Heng was in a good mood. He opened the game log and checked the situation of the vine zombies.
At first, the Dawn Gaming Guild didn’t believe what Prisoner Snake said.
A certain player had conquered the entire prison and completed the construction of a large-scale shelter by himself within a few days of the game opening?
Was that possible?
This must be a joke!
This wasn’t the end.
That player had even recruited several high-level NPCs and owned guns..
Even if he was lying, he had to be more sincere!
But the truth was beyond the gaming company’s expectations.
Prisoner Snake wasn’t lying!
After several rounds of confirmation, the guild immediately made a decision.
They immediately gathered the players and prepared to move into District 8. Their goal was to occupy the prison, and then with the prison as the center, they would develop rapidly in the game!
But soon, things changed again.
In the forest near the prison, they actually found an abandoned iron mine cave!
This time, District 8 of the Zombie Apocalypse instantly became the top priority out of the Dawn Guild’s important projects!
There was an iron mine with rich resources, as well as a powerful shelter.
What kind of fantasy was this?!
After some discussion, the higher-ups of the Dawn Guild unanimously agreed to invest the largest amount of resources in District 8!
A total of 200 King of Gods’ points!
This year, almost all of the Guild’s budget was invested in District 8!
At night, in a temporary hut built inside the abandoned mine.
Prisoner Snake and a few other players were sitting in front of the bonfire.
In his hand was an iron knife that had just come out of the furnace not long ago.
Looking at the human face that shone from the blade, Prisoner Snake’s face revealed a hint of ferocity.
As the advanced players in the Dawn Guild had long surpassed Level 5, they were unable to enter the game.
Therefore, after careful consideration, Prisoner Snake was assigned as the team leader in the game.
Prisoner Snake knew that the people living in the prison had guns in their hands. If they fought head-on, the casualties would be too great.
Thus, this time, he was prepared to develop honestly.
For the sake of revenge, Prisoner Snake worked hard with all his might.
These few days, he spent a lot of effort to construct the abandoned mine.
Modules, furnaces, shovels..
The 200 King of Gods’ points that he had obtained from the gaming union were all invested in the construction of the abandoned mine!
Fortunately, it was all worth it.
The newly forged iron knife in his hands was the best proof!

The iron mine had officially started operating. In another two or three days, all members of his party would be equipped with iron knives, and the explosives provided by the guild would also be delivered.
At that time, his combat power would greatly increase. He could go and fight those people in the prison with all his might!
Bear with it for a little longer! Let them have a few more days of fun!
The day of revenge would soon come!
He would redeem himself and take over the prison!
He would be able to stand firmly in the game! He would be able to rise to the top!
Just as Prisoner Snake was thinking excitedly, two new players rushed over from the temporary residence.
“Brother Snake! It’s bad! We’ve encountered a zombie attack!”
“Trash! We can’t even deal with a few zombies!”
Prisoner Snake cursed.
He didn’t care too much about it.
The mine had always been unsafe. There were often wandering zombies coming to harass them from the outside.
Especially at night. Sometimes, there would even be a few waves of zombies.
“Let’s go and take a look.”
Prisoner Snake pulled out the iron knife in his hand and brought more than ten players back to the entrance of the cave to support them.
He hurried to the entrance of the cave and saw a few players retreating.
These people were only using bows and arrows to attack the zombies from afar.
They were retreating and shooting at the same time.
There were only eight zombies! Why were they so weak?
Prisoner Snake frowned.
The strength of the new members of the union was getting worse and worse!
“F*ck! Just these few zombies, how can you all be so afraid?”
Prisoner Snake sneered and strode Fforward, heading straight for the nearest zombie that was swaying!
It was a good time to try the newly obtained iron knife!

In fact, when the prison was attacked by Prisoner Snake and his gang, Fang Heng had also thought of getting rid of them once and for all.
However, he was still not strong enough at that time.
Prisoner Snake and his gang were all players with combat-type talent abilities!
If he forced them into a corner and if they might retaliate by fighting with their lives on the line, he may end up losing a mercenary...
By that time, Fang Heng would have to pay a large sum of the deposit and his heart would ache for a long time.
Now, the situation was completely different.
After the trip to Hope Town, his zombie clones had been super enhanced!
He had slept for the whole morning, so he didn’t feel sleepy at all.
He had decided!
Tonight, he would rob that mine!
Fang Heng made up his mind and raised his head.
“You’re right.
We need to make preparations early.
Tonight, I’m going to look for them and completely solve this problem.”
“What?
Big Brother, what did you say?”
Liao Bufan was stunned.
He blinked his eyes and looked baffled.
He thought to himself, “What did I say?
What did I say?”
“I just told you to prepare for defense.
Are you going to look for them to fight?”
“Fang Heng?
You want to fight tonight?
Calm down, let’s...”
Fang Heng looked like he had everything under control.
“Don’t worry, I have a plan.”
Liao Bufan shut up.
The words ‘I have a plan’ left a deep impression in Liao Bufan’s mind.
He remembered that Fang Heng had said the same thing last time.
At first, he didn’t believe it either.
Later on, Fang Heng took out a focused flamethrower and taught the spider zombie in the underground passage a lesson.
“I’ll keep watch tonight.
You should go rest.
It’s been hard on you lately.”
“Alright, I’ll sleep first... call me if you need anything.”
Liao Bufan soon figured it out.
“Why do I have to worry so much?”
“Whatever Big Brother says, he’ll do.
He’ll hit whoever he wants!”
He didn’t care.
He just needed to cling to his legs!
When Liao Bufan went offline, Fang Heng walked out of Building No.
He controlled the vine zombies on the military truck to go back and forth a few times and moved all the corpse vines into the new super-large shelter in the basement.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng personally made a ‘Do Not Enter’ wooden sign and stuck it at the entrance of the shelter in the basement.
If anyone dared to break in, he would be considered unlucky...

He returned to the newly cleaned private lounge on the first floor.
Fang Heng lit a bonfire.
He set up a barbecue grill.
He fiddled with the skewers on the grill while thinking.

So, what was the actual combat effect of using them to deal with players?
At this stage of the game, very few players had reached Level 5.
At most, they could only fight against ordinary zombies.
The vine zombies should be able to crush them, right?
After all, his vine zombie clones had a total of 1,000 HP, which was at least six or seven times the HP of an ordinary player.
They also had 30% physical damage reduction and 80% HP instant recovery skills!
Right, they could also use vine entanglement skills in close combat.
If he were to face such a large group of vine zombies...
Just thinking about it would be terrifying!
Fang Heng unconsciously rubbed his hands together.
He couldn’t wait any longer.
It was a good idea to use the people from the Dawn Gaming Guild, Prisoner Snake and gang, as the vine zombies’ damage testing machine!

Fang Heng was in a good mood.
He opened the game log and checked the situation of the vine zombies.

Was that possible?
This must be a joke!
This wasn’t the end.
That player had even recruited several high-level NPCs and owned guns..
Even if he was lying, he had to be more sincere!

Prisoner Snake wasn’t lying!

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - The Powerful Zombies
paragraphs: Holding the iron knife in his hand, Prisoner Snake strode forward and charged at the swaying zombie in front of him!
“Brother Snake! Don’t go over there!”
“Be careful!”
Seeing Prisoner Snake’s actions, the players who had retreated with their wooden bows shouted one after another.
Prisoner Snake turned a deaf ear to them.
He was very confident and raised his iron knife to slash at the zombie’s neck.
He thought that this slash was perfect!
He had grasped the angle and strength perfectly!
This slash had a chance to chop off the zombie’s head!
“Crack!”
The confident Prisoner Snake’s expression changed.
The large knife was actually stuck on the neck of the zombie.
Prisoner Snake was stunned.
The knife couldn’t chop it off?
Was the iron knife a low-quality product?
“Chi! Chi Chi!”
In the next moment, several vines shot out from the wound on the neck of the zombie that had been cut open by the iron knife!
The vines quickly spread along the iron knife and grabbed at Prisoner Snake’s hand!
“F*ck! What the hell is this!”
Prisoner Snake was so scared that he immediately let go of the handle of the iron knife and quickly stepped back.
It was better to stay as far away from the strange zombie as possible.
“Brother Snake, that’s a mutated zombie! The two brothers just died in its hands.”
“Don’t get close to it for close combat, use long-range attacks!”
“Stay far away! Don’t let them get close!”
The new players started to explain to the new reinforcements.
“Damn it! Why didn’t you say so earlier!”
Prisoner Snake gritted his teeth and retreated into the crowd.
He had never seen this type of mutated zombie that could actually grow vines from its body.
He almost fell for it!
Since he couldn’t fight at close range, he would use a long-range bow and arrow to kill it!
Prisoner Snake also took out a wooden longbow from his backpack. As he retreated, he aimed at the mutated zombie and shot.
As a long-range weapon in the early stages of the game, the wooden bow was quite troublesome to use. It required constant reloading and aiming.
In addition, the wooden bow’s accuracy wasn’t good. At least two or three out of ten arrows missed.
Prisoner Snake led the others to shoot while retreating.
Soon, he realized that something was wrong.
Why...
Why were these zombies so fleshy!
More than ten players were shooting with their arrows at the eight zombies for more than ten minutes.
Almost every mutated zombie had 20 or 30 arrows inserted into their bodies.
However, they were still alive and kicking.
There was no injury on their bodies. They were still staggering forward as before.
It was as if these arrows couldn’t harm them at all!
“Damn it! Where did these mutated zombies come from!”
Cold sweat broke out on Prisoner Snake’s head.
What was going on?
It had only been a few days since the server opened!
Why did so many high-level mutated zombies appear?
And so many of them at once!?
This didn’t fit the game setting at all!
What made Prisoner Snake feel the most despair was...
There weren’t many wooden arrows left in their hands!
They couldn’t hold on any longer!
The long-range wooden arrows posed too little of a threat to these zombies!
After careful observation, Prisoner Snake made a frightening discovery.
These zombies’ damaged skin seemed to be covered with a layer of solid “armour” made of tree branches and vines!
Arrows couldn’t penetrate this layer of armour at all!
“How come these zombies are so hard!”
“God! I don’t have any more bows and arrows! Someone give me some quickly!”
“Brother Snake! We can’t retreat anymore. We’re going to be forced into a dead end!”
Prisoner Snake felt a chill run down his spine.
If this continued, forget about going to the prison for revenge in a few days, his life would probably end here!
Prisoner Snake raised the iron knife in his hand.
“Brothers! Let’s go! Let’s break out of here together!”
Inside the prison.
“It’s so delicious... after upgrading to Level 2 cooking, the taste of the food has indeed improved...”
Fang Heng took a bite of the big skewer that he had just finished roasting, feeling satisfied.
He opened the game log.
Rows of messages refreshed.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has been hit by a long-range arrow. Your zombie clone has received damage +5.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has been hit by a long-range arrow. Your zombie clone has received damage +9.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has been hit by a long-range arrow. Your zombie clone has received damage +6. Your skill-strengthen the body experience point +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has been hit by a long-range arrow. Your zombie clone has received damage +5.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has received an automatic HP recovery +12 per second.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has been hit by a long-range arrow. Your zombie clone has received damage +7. Your skill-basic physique training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has been hit by a long-range arrow...]
“Are Prisoner Snake and his gang capable or not? Most of them haven’t learned the bow and arrow skill yet. This kind of damage isn’t enough...”
Fang Heng was a little distressed.
“If this carries on, the effect of the strength test will not be achieved at all...”
As expected, within a few minutes, a new message appeared in the game log.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has caused damage to a certain player. Your skill-basic strength training experience point +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has received an automatic HP recovery +12 per second.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has caused damage to a certain player. Your skill-basic strength training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has received a close-combat attack!]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has attempted to dodge an attack (but failed). Received damage +19. Your skill-basic agility training experience +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has caused damage to a certain player. Your skill-basic strength training experience point +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has received an automatic HP recovery +12 per second.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has caused damage to a certain player. Your skill-basic strength training experience point +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has released a skill-vine entanglement on a player. The skill has been judged and successfully released.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has inflicted 20 damage to the player through the skill and has recovered 20 HP.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has inflicted 20 damage to the player through the skill and has recovered 20 HP.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a certain player...]
Fang Heng shook his head silently.
“Ugh, this won’t do. These people can’t hold on any longer...”
After a while, the notifications that appeared in the log gradually decreased.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has occupied the mine.]
“Eh? Did they escape?”
Fang Heng frowned.
This was meaningless. After all, they were a big guild. Where had their ruthlessness gone to?
Although there was a risk of infection if they escaped at night, they would definitely be wiped out if they stayed in the mine.
Fang Heng was a little disappointed. He still wanted to solve this problem tonight.
He flipped through the records again and counted the casualties.
There were no casualties on his side in this battle. They killed seven enemies and seriously injured four enemies.
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought.
If Prisoner Snake and his gang kept running away and fighting in guerrilla warfare, it wouldn’t be easy. After all, the speed of the vine zombies was too slow. This was very annoying.
Got it!
Demolish their houses!
As long as they demolished all the shelters and residences of the Dawn Gaming Guild, these people would die under the negative effects of the “dark fear” at night.
Thinking of this, Fang Heng directly gave the zombie clones the order to demolish their houses.
First, demolish the temporary residence that the Dawn Gaming Guild had built in the mine!
After the zombies who had committed suicide during the day were resurrected tomorrow, they would go and demolish their entire residence!
After losing their residences in the Zombie Apocalypse world, this group of people would definitely not be able to survive!

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - Elite Soldiers of the Dark Knights
paragraphs: [Hint: During the period when you are offline, your zombies have dismantled the temporary shelter. You have obtained firewood*6782, nails*45, rags*23, scrap metal*56, scrap plastic*7, clay*21... through dismantling, you have obtained skill-strengthen the body experience points 3253, obtained skill-basic physique training experience points 28192.]
[Hint: Your skill-strengthen the body has been upgraded to Level 3.]
[Hint: Your skill-basic physique training has been upgraded to Level 10, it has reached the current upper limit.]
[Hint: Your zombie clones have obtained iron ore*122, stone pickaxe*5, iron pickaxe*1, module*5.]
[Hint: Your zombie clones have discovered the furnace*5.]
In just one night, the temporary residence that the Dawn Guild spent two days building was completely demolished by Fang Heng.
Fang Heng let the zombie clones guard the iron mine first, then began digging for iron ore.
Meanwhile, he drove the truck alone to the apocalypse merchant camp.
Before leaving, Fang Heng specifically told Liao Bufan to pay attention to the defense and be careful of Prisoner Snake and his gang in case they attack the prison in desperation.
“Fang Heng! You’re finally here. Let me introduce you to Mr David from the Dark Knights. He’s been waiting for you for a long time.”
David did not look strong. He wore a black hat and had two strands of black beard.
“Hello, Fang Heng. I’ve heard a lot of stories about you from Vettel.”
“Let me introduce myself. I’m one of the contact persons of the Dark Knights, David. We’ve been looking for partners who share the same interests as us in this apocalypse.”
“The purpose of our organization is to save this world that has been invaded by zombies.”
“After a series of tests, I believe that your strength has far exceeded our expectations. On behalf of the Dark Knights, I would like to invite you to join us!”
[Hint: Do you accept David’s invitation to join the Dark Knights?]
Of course!
After going through so much, he finally joined the Dark Knights!
Fang Heng chose to confirm.
[Hint: You have chosen to join the Dark Knights. Your honor level in the Dark Knights is Level 1 (private).]
[Hint: Delaying the completion of the mission...]
[Hint: Due to your outstanding completion of the mission-search for the T-virus serum, you have obtained 1000*41.28 Dark Knights’ honor points.]
[Hint: Your Dark Knights’ honor level has been upgraded to Level 7 (second lieutenant).]
“That’s great! With your participation, we will definitely find a way to solve the zombie virus and rebuild this world.”
David patted Fang Heng’s shoulder enthusiastically.
“I heard that you have established your own shelter and have your own base?”
“Yes, it’s in the prison.”
“Well, according to your Dark Knights’ honor level, we can provide you two top soldiers from the Dark Knights for free to provide security and protection for your shelter.”
“Of course, during this period, you must be responsible for providing the necessary survival materials for the soldiers.”
“If they have an accident, you also need to pay an additional pension to the Dark Knights.”
“Fang Heng, do you need the protection of the soldiers?”
Two high-level elite soldiers for free??
Was that even a question?
Fang Heng immediately nodded.
“Of course!”
“Okay, they will report to your shelter soon.”
[Hint: You have obtained Dark Knights’ elite soldier*2. They will arrive outside your shelter in 5 hours. Please be prepared to receive them (click to see more details of the soldier’s attributes).]
Fang Heng immediately opened the game log to see the details.
[Mercenary: Elite soldiers of the Dark Knights]
Level: 25
Strength: 12
Agility: 8
Physique: 12
Will: 7
Perception: 6
Intelligence: 6

Skills: Gun mastery (Level 15), close combat (Level 15), close combat weapon mastery (Level 12), investigation techniques (Level 7), piloting (Level 7), heavy combat (Level 5), field stealth skills (Level 5), team tactical cooperation (Level 7), elite soldier special training (Level 20), learning talent (Level 10).
What a guy!
The row of skills made Fang Heng feel a little dizzy.
Level 15 gun mastery!
Up to 12 strength points!
This meant that the Dark Knights’ elite soldiers could easily control the sniper rifle!
There was also the ‘learning talent’ skill.
With this skill, the NPC mercenaries could learn much faster!
Their levels, attributes and skills still had room for improvement!
As expected of the top NPC mercenaries in the Zombie Apocalypse game!
Fang Heng was secretly speechless.
The strength of the Dark Knights’ elite soldiers was much higher than he had expected.
In comparison, the Level 5 top mercenaries provided by the apocalypse merchant camp were nothing!
Fang Heng closed the game log and raised his head to ask.
“David, can I recruit more elite soldiers?”

“Of course you can. Based on your current rank of honor, you can currently recruit up to 20 Dark Knights’ elite soldiers to join your team. A single soldier can be bought off for 60,000 survival points.”
Expensive!
The most expensive mercenary in apocalypse camp only cost 6,000 points, while the Dark Knights’ elite mercenaries’ cost increased by 10 times!
Fang Heng shook his head in his heart.
The gap in survival points was too big.
At the moment, his survival points were insufficient!
He still had a batch of zombies waiting for survival points to complete the enhancement. He did not have that much money to continue recruiting mercenaries.
Vettel curled his lips and tried to assist him.
“Hey, buddy, Fang Heng is an old friend of mine. Make it easy for him! At most, I’ll treat you to a drink tonight.”
“This is already the lowest price. It’s very difficult for us to train an elite soldier, especially in this kind of environment.”
David paused and looked at Fang Heng.
“But considering that you have completed the mission perfectly this time, we can give you a batch of elite soldiers as a reward for free. The number is 15.”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up when he heard that.
“You mean ‘for free’?”
“Yes, free. But you have to think carefully. After all, before I came here, I heard Vettel mention something.”
“The talent skill you awakened in the apocalypse seems to have hit a bottleneck recently, and you want our help.”
As David spoke, he took out a rolled up black scroll from his backpack and handed it to Fang Heng.
“The Dark Knights indeed have a high-level talent enhancement information. We originally planned to give it to you as a reward for the mission.”
“This scroll is very precious. We spent a long time to get it. With your outstanding performance in this mission, it’s understandable to give it to you as a reward.”
David looked at Fang Heng, waiting for him to make a choice.
“But I’m sorry, you can only choose one of the two rewards.”
Fang Heng opened his mouth.
This choice was really a pain in the a*s!

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - Start with S-level
paragraphs: “Then Fang Heng, do you want to choose elite soldiers or the talent reward?”
Fang Heng asked, “I want to know the level of the talent enhancement plan.”
“It’s S-level.”
“As far as I know, the level of the talent enhancement plan is the same as the level of the talent. The highest level is S-level.”
Hmm?
Something didn’t seem right?
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered to himself, “Isn’t my talent level SSS-level after evolving?”
“Right, I’m a bug.”
Fang Heng quickly made a decision.
He decided to choose the enhancement plan!
The Dark Knight’s NPC mercenaries are quite strong! But he didn’t need them right now.
Two mercenaries guarding the prison was enough.
After all, he only had three sniper rifles on hand.
In addition, there were also vine zombies guarding the prison. Even if 10,000 more Prison Snakes came, they would all die!
Fang Heng believed that the security of the prison was already guaranteed.
Now that he had successfully joined the Dark Knights, he could slowly think of ways to accumulate survival points in the future.
As long as he spent some time, he could exchange the points for mercenaries.
However, the enhancement plan was different. If he missed this opportunity, it would be difficult to obtain it from other channels.
Fang Heng believed that he could not stay stagnant at Level 10 forever and not level up. Moreover, he had been waiting to get hold of the enhancement plan.
The sooner he completed the talent enhancement and levelled up, the sooner he could widen the gap between him and the other players...
“I choose the enhancement plan.”
A smile appeared on David’s face. He turned to look at Vettel and said, “I told you, he will choose the enhancement plan.”
“Tsk, you were lucky. You’ve won. My treat tonight, let’s get drunk.”
David handed over to Fang Heng the black scroll in his hand.
“This is the reward you deserve. You did a good job. In addition, these survival points are additional rewards given by the Dark Knights.”
[Hint: Delayed mission reward completion.]
[Hint: You have obtained an individual talent enhancement plan (unappraised) (Level S)*1.]
[Hint: You can use 1,000 survival points to appraise this plan.]
[Hint: You have obtained an additional 19,299 survival points as compensation (system mission balance compensation).]
An additional 190,000 survival points could be used to transform a few more vine zombies!
Fang Heng’s attention was quickly attracted by the S-level enhancement plan.
S-level!
The highest level talent enhancement plan in the game!
Let’s see what the attributes were!
When the plan was in his hands, Fang Heng immediately used up some points to appraise it.
[Hint: You have completed the appraisal by deducting 1,000 survival points. You have obtained an individual talent enhancement plan-zombie clone summoning.]
Individual talent enhancement plan-zombie clone summoning.
Enhancement plan level: S.
Enhancement description: You can complete the talent enhancement by gathering relevant materials.

Enhancement effect description: You can use the summoning ability to forcefully summon your zombie clones (the maximum number of summons depends on the individual’s basic attributes) to your side (cooldown time: 30 minutes).
Fang Heng frowned slightly.
“This...”
The effect of the skill seemed to be very trashy.
But thinking about it carefully, this skill had quite a lot of room for manipulation.
For example, the simplest kind would be to get the zombies to transport goods which would save a lot of time.
In terms of combat, if Fang Heng wanted to attack the enemy’s base, he could also sneak into the enemy’s rear alone.
Then.
“Pa!”
He snapped his fingers.
A group of zombies instantly teleported into the enemy’s base!
But in the end...
He was still not satisfied!!!

“Alright, Fang Heng, the mission reward has been given. I need to hurry up and rush back to the Dark Knights. Your findings in Hope Town are very useful for our team’s internal research. Everyone is waiting for me to return.”
“Hey, David, why are you in such a hurry? Didn’t we agree to have a drink tonight?”
“Next time! Next time!”
David got on his motorcycle and suddenly thought of something. He took out a map from his backpack and handed it to Fang Heng.
“I almost forgot. These are the locations of our Dark Knights’ strongholds nearby. You can contact us at any of these places at any time.”
“Usually, we will also issue missions to the Dark Knights’ members there.”
“Of course, if we encounter special trouble, we will also contact you through the apocalypse merchant camp.”
“We will meet again soon, friend! To save this world!”
After saying that, David waved his hand and drove away on his motorcycle.
“Most of the Dark Knights are like him. To save the world, they have been working hard.”
Vettel came over with two bottles of beer and handed one to Fang Heng.
“In my opinion, even in the apocalypse, you have to learn to balance work and life, right?”
“Balancing work and life did not mean that you had to drink beer early in the morning!” Fang Heng thought to himself.
Fang Heng took the beer and clinked it with Vettel’s.
“You’re right, Vettel!”
Vettel gulped down a mouthful of beer. “By the way, Fang Heng, someone came to look for you last night.”
“Huh? Who?”
“Mr Qiu, the scientist with a weird temper. The one who asked you to deliver the goods last time.”
Qiu Yaokang!
The guy who seemed to have a problem with his brain.
Fang Heng nodded and asked, “What did he say?”
“He asked me to tell you that the potion you asked for has been prepared, and when you are free, to go and collect it. He also wanted you to take the goods you promised him along with you.”
Vettel was a little curious.
“Mr Qiu rarely calls in person. What did you promise him?”
“The evolution crystal fragments for research.”
Fang Heng pondered.
It seemed that the potion that he asked Qiu Yaokang to make had been completed.
Taking advantage of the fact that the zombies hadn’t resurrected yet, he might as well go and look for Qiu Yaokang to get the potion first and increase his basic attributes.
At the same time, he would also pass the second biggest reward of his trip to Hope Town, the life sample of Alex, to Qiu Yaokang.
He would see if he could obtain some treasures from him!
No matter what, he was still a high-level scientist in the game. What if he also had an S-level talent enhancement plan?
Or a higher level gene enhancer would not be too bad either!
Fang Heng’s heart was burning with passion.
“Vettel, I’ll go look for him now. Do you need me to send some materials over on the way?”
“Of course, you’ve done me another big favour, Fang Heng!”
After more than three hours, Fang Heng delivered a batch of survival materials to the villa where Qiu Yaokang lived.
After getting out of the truck, Fang Heng skillfully sneaked into the back garden through the passage behind the bushes.
Qiu Yaokang had already seen Fang Heng from the camera installed at the front door of the villa.
In the back garden of the villa, Qiu Yaokang opened a small crack at the entrance of the basement passage, revealing half of his head from inside.
“You’re finally here.”
Qiu Yaokang’s expression was cold.
“Have you brought the goods?”
“Goods? Evolution crystal fragments? I’ve brought them.”
Qiu Yaokang nodded his head in satisfaction and completely opened the door to the basement.
He walked out of the basement and looked at Fang Heng from top to bottom.
“Help me move the materials in first. Thank you.”
“I’ll do it alone.”
“Okay.”
During this period, Fang Heng’s strength and vitality attributes had greatly increased. He could easily move a few heavy boxes by himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - Fusion
paragraphs: After spending ten minutes moving all the materials into the basement, Fang Heng went to the changing room and changed into a protective suit before entering Qiu Yaokang’s laboratory.
[Hint: Your behaviour has received a slight increase in Qiu Yaokang’s favorability.]
“All the materials are in the corridor.”
“Okay.”
Qiu Yaokang stood at the side and looked at Fang Heng coldly as usual.
He noticed that Fang Heng’s physical attributes had improved a little compared to the last time they met.
“Thank you for your help. You are more reliable than the other delivery people. Where are my goods?”
“I’ll give them to you now.”
Fang Heng waved his hand and took out more than 300 evolution crystal fragments from his backpack and piled them on the experimental table.
Soon, the evolution crystal fragments piled up on the experimental table into a shiny hill.
A look of surprise flashed across Qiu Yaokang’s face, but he quickly hid it away.
“Is it enough?”
“For the time being, it’s enough. I would need more in the future.”
Qiu Yaokang pointed at a refrigerator in the corner of the laboratory.
“According to our agreement, the potions you need are all in the freezer. You can take them away at any time.”
“Alright.”
Fang Heng walked to the corner of the laboratory happily and opened the freezer.
There were 10 bottles for each of the three gene enhancement potions neatly placed in the medicine box.
[Hint: You have obtained the gene enhancement potion*30. Your friendship with Qiu Yaokang has slightly improved.]
[Hint: You have consumed 55 evolution crystal fragments. Your unstable gene condition has been cleared.]
[Hint: You have used the modified zombie strength enhanced gene potion. You have not received any attribute enhancement.]
[Hint: The effect will gradually decrease after multiple doses of this gene potion.]
[Hint: You have obtained the gene chaotic state.]
[Hint: Your gene chaotic state has increased to 13%.]
[Hint: You have used the modified zombie strength enhanced gene potion...]
Fang Heng injected himself with the potion while trying to strike up a conversation with Qiu Yaokang.
“Do you know where I’ve been these past few days?”
“I don’t know, and I’m not interested.”
“I went to Hope Town.”
“There’s a Community Hospital there. I went there to take a look.”
Qiu Yaokang’s back was facing Fang Heng.
He didn’t reply and continued sorting out the evolution crystal fragments on the test bench.
Qiu Yaokang was very serious. He held each evolution crystal fragment in his hand and looked at it carefully.
“Good god, I found a secret research room inside!”
Fang Heng seemed to say it unintentionally, but in fact, he had been observing Qiu Yaokang.
As expected, when he said the words “secret research room”, Qiu Yaokang paused.
“Pretending! You are just pretending to be calm!” Fang Heng thought.
Fang Heng grinned and continued, “It’s a secret research room set up by the Meteorite Company before the Zombie Apocalypse. Guess what I found in it?”
Qiu Yaokang turned his head abruptly.
“What?”
Fang Heng extended his right fist, then put his index and middle fingers together and rubbed his thumb.
He made a gesture that everyone understood.
Qiu Yaokang looked at Fang Heng for a few seconds and then turned his back.
“Our deal has been completed. You can leave now.”
“Hahaha, I was just joking with you and you took it seriously. Here, I specially brought this back for you.”
Fang Heng passed the research team’s notebook that he had collected from the secret research room to Qiu Yaokang.
“Come, take a look at this.”
Qiu Yaokang did not turn around and said directly, “I don’t want to look at it. You can leave now.”
Ha, he was quite stubborn!
Fang Heng did not care. He directly flipped open one of the pages of the team’s research notebook and read it aloud in the laboratory.
“Firstly, using the T-virus can infect normal plants and produce mutated lifeforms. In our research, we found that the T-virus and the corpse vine have the best combination. We have infected...”
Qiu Yaokang listened and his hand involuntarily stopped.
He turned around and looked at Fang Heng in a daze.
“Secondly, the corpse vine is different from normal plants. It has strong vitality and is extremely aggressive.”
Qiu Yaokang could not hold it in anymore. He quickly rushed in front of Fang Heng and grabbed the experiment notebook in Fang Heng’s hand.
Fang Heng didn’t dodge and let him take the team experiment notebook.
It was like fishing, he had to wait for it to bite the hook completely.
Qiu Yaokang looked like he had found a treasure. He lowered his head and read silently. He quickly turned the page with his right hand.
His eyes were full of concentration, excitement and surprise...
The fish had taken the bait!
Fang Heng was happy.
Alex’s live specimen was worth a lot of money.
He did not know what good stuff Qiu Yaokang could exchange for it.
Fang Heng muttered softly.
“I have to think of a way to empty his family fortune.”
Qiu Yaokang was completely focused on the notebook at hand. He could not hear Fang Heng’s muttering at all.
After quickly flipping through the entire experimental notebook, Qiu Yaokang took a deep breath.
He closed his eyes and pondered for a moment before flipping through the notebook again from the beginning.
This time, Qiu Yaokang read every word carefully, not letting go of any details in the notebook.
Fang Heng was not in a hurry. He yawned and waited for Qiu Yaokang to finish reading the entire notebook again.
“How is it? It’s still useful to you, right? Don’t say that I’m unkind. I even brought something back for you when I went this time.”
“What! You even brought something back?”
“Do you want to guess what I brought back for you?”
Qiu Yaokang stared at Fang Heng with a burning gaze.
“Tell me quickly!”
“Hehehe.”
Fang Heng pretended to be mysterious and chuckled.
“I got a live sample of Alex from the secret research room.”
“A live sample of Alex?!”
Qiu Yaokang was so excited that his pupils dilated several times. He immediately pounced on Fang Heng.
“Quick! Give it to me!”
“Don’t get excited, don’t get started...”
Fang Heng moved aside and said slowly, “It’s not that I can’t give it to you, but don’t you have to show your sincerity?”
Qiu Yaokang calmed down.
He looked at Fang Heng.
“What do you want?”
“Hmm... let me think...”
“Are there any new potions recently? The kind that can increase attributes?”
“The new gene potion is still under research. If you can provide me with a sample of Alex, I can greatly increase the progress of my research.”
Want to get it for free?
That was impossible!
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows vigilantly.
“Is that so? That’s a pity. If you do this, it’ll be very difficult for me. You should also know that Alex’s live sample is very rare. Many people are looking for me to purchase it.”
“Or think about it. What can you provide me?”
Qiu Yaokang sized up Fang Heng from head to toe.
He focused his mind and thought for a moment before narrowing his eyes.
“Your talent should be reaching a bottleneck soon, right?”
Fang Heng was surprised.
“Eh? Do you also have a high-level talent enhancement plan?”
Qiu Yaokang shook his head.
“I don’t, but I can help you make one.”
Fang Heng was stunned.
“Make? Do you know how to make an enhancement plan? What level type can you make?”
“To be precise, it’s fusion production. It requires three equal-level enhancement plans.. I can help you research on fusion production and make a higher-level enhancement plan.”

Where are my goods?”

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - Diversion of Trouble
paragraphs: “For example, three B-level talent enhancement plans can be fused into one A-level talent enhancement plan.”
Qiu Yaokang said as he crushed the few evolution crystal fragments in his hand.
“Bang!”
The red mist was quickly absorbed by Qiu Yaokang’s palm.
“After these few days of research on the evolution crystal fragments, I have also awakened my talent skill.”
There... there was such an operation!
You’re an NPC!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat, and he immediately asked.
“Then what about three S-level plans? Is it possible to fuse into a higher-level one?”
“This...”
Qiu Yaokang hesitated for a moment.
“Theoretically, it’s possible, but as far as I know, an A-level talent enhancement plan is already extremely rare. Are you sure you can find an S-level talent enhancement plan?”
“Of course, I can!”
Fang Heng was overjoyed!
He had already obtained one S-level talent enhancement plan from the Dark Knights. He had to think of a way to obtain one more from the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company to make two.
He was only missing the last one!
He had to think of another way. It was not impossible to obtain it.
Oh right!
“I can collect three A-level talent enhancement plans and fuse them into one S-level talent enhancement plan.”
Seeing Fang Heng’s delighted expression, Qiu Yaokang reminded him.
“Don’t be too happy. Let me remind you that the enhancement plan that has already been fused once cannot be fused again.”
“This...”
Fang Heng’s excitement was immediately reduced by more than half.

“In other words, don’t even think about using nine B-level enhancement plans to create an S-level enhancement plan. Moreover, the fusion materials also require evolution crystals as a medium. You will need to be responsible for this part.”
“That’s not a problem.”
“Also, using this talent will cause a lot of damage to my body. After one fusion, it will take at least a year for me to fully recover. I will take a live sample of Alex from you as payment.”
Qiu Yaokang looked at Fang Heng.
“I need you to provide me with a sample of Alex so that I can start a new research project. This is the premise of our cooperation. Do you think you can accept it?”
[Hint: Player mission triggered-cooperative research and development.]
Mission name: Cooperative research and development.

Mission description: Within 30 days, you can hand over three talent enhancement plans of the same level (the highest level is S-level) to Qiu Yaokang. He will help you fuse into a higher-level talent enhancement plan (the highest level is SSS-level).
Mission requirement: Alex live sample*1.
Time limit: 30 days.
Fang Heng carefully read the mission description.
It was indeed correct!
Just like his own talent attribute, there was a higher level, the SSS-level, hidden above the S-level.
However, to reach SSS-level, it required extremely harsh conditions to trigger it!
“Deal!”
Fang Heng had no reason to reject and immediately accepted the mission.
He handed over a sample of Alex’s research.
“I’ll find three enhancement plans as soon as possible and bring them back.”
“As soon as possible. You only have 30 days.”
[Hint: Your friendship with Qiu Yaokang has improved slightly.]
Where could he find the last S-level talent enhancement plan?
Driving the military truck out of the villa, Fang Heng had a slight headache.
A few major forces in the game might have it.
However, such a high-value enhancement plan would be fought over internally by the major guilds and would not be sold to the public at all.
If he really could not do it, he could only try his luck on the black market.
The black market was shady and illicit, and there were many scammers.
Being cheated of money was a small matter. Wasting time and delaying the development of the game was the worst loss.
Fang Heng did not want to go to the black market unless it was necessary.
It was better to take it one step at a time and get the enhancement plan of the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company first.
At the moment, he still needed to deal with the Dawn Game Guild first!
Back in the prison, two elite soldiers of the Dark Knights stood at the entrance of the prison and reported to Fang Heng.
“Sir! The elite soldiers of the Dark Knights reporting to you!”
Liao Bufan watched from the side and was extremely envious.
Heavens! They were from the Dark Knights!
They were the highest-level mercenaries that could be recruited in the game!
The number of mercenaries was extremely limited. If one died, there would be one less mercenary. Only large-scale forces like the federation would be able to get their hands on them.
Even if ordinary players could get their hands on them, they would not be able to afford them!
In the past, Liao Bufan had seen a few pictures in the forum. He did not expect to see the real thing with his own eyes today.
It was said that these highest-level NPC mercenaries had extremely high intelligence. If he got on good terms with them, he might even be able to learn some basic skills from them.
“I need you to enter the sentry tower and take turns to guard it 24 hours a day.”

“If strangers are lurking within the 20-meter area outside the prison, you are allowed to fire a warning shot. If they do not follow the warning and continue to intrude, you can directly shoot and kill them.”
“Yes, Sir!”
Fang Heng gave each of the two mercenaries a sniper rifle and told them to go to the sentry post.
“Fang Heng, I’ll go and take a look too.”
Liao Bufan was very envious. He followed them to the sentry post and wondered if he could learn some skills from them.
After watching Liao Bufan leave, Fang Heng glanced at the game log.
Soon.
There were only ten minutes left before the zombies resurrected.
Inside the residence remodelled by the Dawn Guild.
After the fierce battle last night, the morale of Prisoner Snake’s team was extremely low.
“Brother Snake, we sneaked a look outside the mine just now. Those zombies are still inside.”
“There’s also bad news. The residence that we built two days ago was demolished...”
The room was completely silent.
The temporary residence in the mine had been destroyed.
Two days of hard work had gone down the drain.
Even the smelting furnace and other items that the guild had spent a large sum of money on were still in the residence.
No one would feel good after hearing this news.
Prisoner Snake’s face turned even paler when he heard this.
It was over!
The Dawn Guild had invested a large amount of King of Gods’ points in the construction of the mine.
If he didn’t think of a way to regain the mine as soon as possible, the higher-ups of the guild would tear him apart when they heard the news!
“Bang!”
Prisoner Snake had nowhere to vent his anger, so he kicked the corner of the table.
“Da*n it!”
He couldn’t understand why the zombies were targetting him.
It was the same last time, and now it was happening again!
The attacks were getting stronger and stronger each time!
Why was his luck so bad?
Why was he the only one who was unlucky!
Then, he compared his predicament to the group of people in the prison. How could they occupy the prison so easily?!
Why didn’t the zombies look for them?
Suddenly, Prisoner Snake’s eyes lit up.
Got it!
Prison!
Weren’t those people very well-equipped? Weren’t the mutated zombies they encountered last night very strong?
What would happen if the two of them fought?!
As the saying goes, “If a snipe and a clam are locked in a fight, it is only to the advantage of the fisherman!”
With a single move, they would lure the mutated zombies to the prison!
The more Prisoner Snake thought about it, the more he felt that this plan was feasible!
When the time came, no matter who won or lost, he would not lose anything!
It would be best if both sides suffered losses, and he would reap the benefits by himself!
He would reap the benefits!
“Brothers, I have an idea.”
Prisoner Snake smiled sinisterly and briefly told everyone about his plan to lure the zombies to enter the prison.
When the players heard his plan, they were enlightened.
It was feasible!!
The vine zombies had high HP and strong close combat abilities, but their movement speed was still as slow as a normal zombie.
The risk of luring these zombies was not high!
“Alright, pack your equipment, and let’s set off now!”
Prisoner Snake was determined to make up for his mistakes.. He made a prompt decision and led the players back to the mine once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - Sending off
paragraphs: In the abandoned mine, a few zombies were continuously digging iron ores with pickaxes.
The remaining zombie was moving the iron ores from the mine back and forth, piling them up in a corner.
This scene puzzled Prisoner Snake and his people who were observing in the dark.
What was going on?
What were these zombies doing?
Were they working together to mine?
Since when did zombies have such high intelligence?
A player nudged Prisoner Snake who was in a daze.
“Brother Snake, what do you say?”
Prisoner Snake gritted his teeth.
“Go!”
The Dawn Guild was already very dissatisfied with him. This was his last chance!
Prisoner Snake carefully took out his wooden bow from his backpack and aimed at the zombies.
“Whoosh!”
Due to the distance, when the arrow landed on the vine zombie’s back, it had already lost most of its power and was repelled by the vine armour under its skin.
“Ka!”
Being attacked, the vine zombie paused and turned around to look at Prisoner Snake and the others.
“Shoot the arrows!”
Prisoner Snake waved his hand.
More than ten people raised their wooden bows at the same time.
“Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!”
Another round of arrows rained down.
The vine zombies who were carrying the iron ores turned around at the same time.
They threw down the pickaxes in their hands and rushed toward Prisoner Snake and the others while swaying.
It worked!
Seeing that the zombie clones were attracted over, Prisoner Snake was overjoyed.
“Quick! Lure them to the prison!”
Prisoner Snake immediately led the players out of the mine.
Luring zombies was not as easy as they had imagined.
They needed to master a certain degree of control.
Prisoner Snake found that these zombies seemed to have a special obsession with the mine.
When they were far away, the vine zombies would turn around and run back to the mine.
At this time, they needed to attack them again to attract their attention.
Prisoner Snake spent a lot of energy and more than an hour luring the zombies to the vicinity of the prison.
None of the eight mutated zombies escaped!
Seeing that the prison was just ahead, Prisoner Snake was excited.
He had confidence in these mutated zombies.
These mutated zombies could bring a lot of trouble to the people in the prison.
Maybe they could even directly break through the entire prison!
“We’re almost there! Brothers! Work harder! Take the opportunity to break through the prison!”
Prisoner Snake shouted to them to raise their spirits.
At this time, he suddenly noticed that the game log popped up several red warning boxes.
[Hint: You’ve received an emergency message from the survival radio.]
[Hint: You’ve received an emergency message from the survival radio.]
[Hint: You’ve received an emergency message from the survival radio.]
[Hint: You’ve received an emergency message from the survival...]
Prisoner Snake’s expression changed slightly, and an ominous feeling rose in his heart.
So urgent?
Could it be that something had happened to the residence?
Prisoner Snake quickly opened the survival radio to check.
The players who stayed in the shelter sent messages one after another.
Zhou Yu: “Brother Snake! Not good, the residence is being attacked by a zombie crowd!”
Zhou Yu: “It’s the same as last night, they’re all mutated zombies! We can’t stop them!”
Qian Feihong: “Zombies! There are so many zombies, 30 to 40 of them! Brother Snake, come back, we can’t hold them off with just a few of us here!”
Qian Feihong: “Brother Snake, we have escaped.”
Wang Zhen: “Brother Snake, the zombies are starting to demolish our shelter, we can’t do anything.”
Qian Feihong: “Brother Snake, come back quickly! If you don’t come back soon, our shelter will be torn down...”
Looking at the emergency messages that kept coming from the survival radio, Prisoner Snake broke out in cold sweat.
God! The zombies besieged his base?
They even started tearing down his shelter?
It was the same situation as last night when the abandoned mine was attacked!
Were these zombies crazy?
Who did he offend? Why did the game system keep targeting him?
If the shelter was demolished, how would he survive the night?
Should he go back to rescue, or should he continue?
Prisoner Snake was in a mess.
“Brother Snake, we’re almost at the prison. There seems to be someone in the watchtower over there.”
Prisoner Snake raised his head and looked at the watchtower in the prison.
The watchtower was still damaged when he came here a few days ago, but it had been repaired in the past two days.
“They should have noticed us already. Should we continue to charge?”
Prisoner Snake gritted his teeth.
He was going to give it his all!
His plan was about to be completed and the prison was right in front of him.
How could he give up now?
He only needed five minutes!
He just needed another five minutes!
Even zombies couldn’t demolish their residences so quickly.
Prisoner Snake comforted himself. He quickly sent a message to tell the team that they were on their way back, asking them to delay as much as possible.
“Let’s go! Let’s go!”
Prisoner Snake took the lead and quickly ran a few steps forward.
He knew that the area in front of him was the prison.
There were NPC mercenaries in the prison.
As long as he entered the prison’s detection area and made a provocative move to attack the prison, with the intelligence of those mercenaries, they would choose to shoot!
At that time, the gunshots would attract the group of mutated zombies behind him!
A perfect plan!
It was time to gamble his life!
At such a long distance, the lethality of the pistol would not be too high, and the accuracy would be greatly reduced.
As long as his luck was not too bad, his life would not be in danger!
“Brothers, charge with me!”
Prisoner Snake shouted loudly and together with his subordinates, they charged towards the prison.
“Kill!!”
“Kill them all!”

The players knew that this was the chance to fight with their lives on the line. They quickly ran and shouted as they charged towards the prison, using this to attract the attention of the NPC guards on the watchtower.
“Bang!”
There was a gunshot.
It was done!
The moment he heard the gunshot, Prisoner Snake’s heart calmed down.
However, the next moment, Prisoner Snake’s face turned pale.
He saw the head of a player who was running in front of him explode.
Prisoner Snake’s body was still moving forward, but his mind was blank.
“Bang!”
Another gunshot.
Blood splattered on Prisoner Snake’s right cheek.
Prisoner Snake subconsciously turned his head.
The head of one of his subordinates on his right exploded again, and his body swayed as he fell to the ground.
It was a sniper rifle!
It could cause such a wound from such a long distance.
Only sniper rifles could do such damage in the Zombie Apocalypse game.
They had sniper rifles?!
Not only did this group of people have sniper rifles, but some people could use them?
It was over! It was all over!
Run!
As many as possible!
Prisoner Snake turned his head and shouted at the players who were running towards the prison.
“Quick...”
Just as the words left his mouth.
“Bang!”
A gunshot sounded.
Prisoner Snake’s head exploded in front of the players.
“Bang! Bang!”
“Bang!”
On the tower, Liao Bufan stood beside the elite mercenary of the Dark Knights.
Every time he pulled the trigger, every gunshot would cause a player’s head to explode.
Strong!
He was too strong!
With such combat ability, why would he be afraid of the Dawn Guild?
As expected of the elite NPC of the Dark Knights.
Every shot was accurate!
From the looks of it, he should be at least a Level 10 gun mastery expert, right?
Liao Bufan was extremely envious!
“But the members of the Dawn Guild are so strange. Why are they rushing here to die?”
“And they’re still shouting. Are they afraid that we won’t know?”
Liao Bufan felt that it was strange. He stuck his head out and continued to look outside the prison.
He silently looked at the players of Dawn who were trying to escape outside. Every one of them was shot in the head by a sniper rifle.
“Sigh! If they want to send themselves to death, I can’t even stop them.”
Bang! Bang!
Bang!
Gunshots rang out one after another.
In less than two minutes, all the players that Prisoner Snake had brought along were shot in the head. None of them survived.
The zombies that were originally chasing after Prisoner Snake and the others paused when they saw that they were all dead.
They seemed to have understood something. They staggered back and continued to mine..
