chapters.title: Chapter 88 - Expansion Plan
paragraphs: [Hint: Your zombie group has completed the dismantling of the player’s shelter. You have obtained firewood*35,722, nails*145, rags*53, scrap metal*156, scrap plastic*27...]
[Hint: Through dismantling, you have obtained a skill-strengthen the body experience points +5,511.]
[Hint: Your skill-strengthen the body level has been upgraded to Level 4.]
The soundproof effect in the underground shelter was very good.
Fang Heng sat in front of the bonfire. He did not even know that a few hours ago, the prisoners outside had been completely wiped out by the elite mercenaries of the Dark Knights.
“Strange, the resistance in the base seems to be very weak. Logically speaking, Dawn Guild is not so weak.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
He felt as if he had punched cotton.
Could it be that Prisoner Snake and his gang were coincidentally not in the shelter?
Whatever!
In any case, the Dawn players’ residences had already been completely demolished. Their best option now was to find a new residence before nightfall.
Perhaps, Prisoner Snake was too hot-headed and he chose to risk his life to forcefully occupy the prison...
If that was the case, he would be sending himself to his death!
After solving the issues of the security upgrade of the shelter and the troublesome neighbour, Dawn Guild, Fang Heng began to carry out the next step of the shelter’s development plan.
First, he set a small goal.
To build the largest, strongest, most comfortable and most stable shelter in District 8 of the Zombie Apocalypse!
To become the strongest force in District 8 of the Zombie Apocalypse!
Fang Heng was fervently setting his goals.
During the apocalypse, there would be a “blood moon” every once in a while.
At that time, the zombies would go berserk and the perception abilities of the zombies would be greatly enhanced.
They would form groups and crazily attack the players’ residences and shelters.
That was what the players called the “zombie wave”!
At that time, once the defensive ability of the players’ residences and shelters could not keep up with the fall, they would completely die in the zombie wave.
As the game went on, the intensity of the zombie wave would increase more and more.
Now, Fang Heng’s prison shelter was guarded by two Dark Knights holding sniper rifles, and there were also powerful vine zombies...
Fang Heng believed that his prison could survive at least four or five rounds of “blood moon”!
While the other players were still building shelters, he had already completed the construction of a super-large shelter. He had even completed the safety upgrade of the shelter ahead of schedule.
Now, he could enter the third phase of the game, which was expansion and competition for resources.
With the prison as the starting point, he would gradually spread his influence to the surrounding area, occupying a large amount of territory and collecting large amounts of resources.
Fang Heng was already two steps ahead of all the players. He had a huge advantage!
“The forest environment has the most abundant wood resources.”
Fang Heng thought silently in his heart.
“With the free labour of the zombie clones, I can do this step more thoroughly. I can eliminate any future troubles.”
“I might as well just directly remove all the system shelters, residences and so on that were initially spawned in the forest area!”
Doing this could greatly reduce the probability of the King of Gods’ spawning new players nearby, preventing other players from entering the forest area.
After all, when the zombie clones encountered players, it was very easy to stir trouble.
Fang Heng was not timid, but he was very afraid of trouble.
Having made up his mind, he controlled the zombie clones to split into two groups.
The zombie clones in the smaller group held small stone hammers and explored the paths along the small paths in the forest. They began to search for the buildings hidden in the forest.
If they encountered small wooden buildings, they would immediately start tearing them down!
If they encountered higher-level brick houses, they would first mark them down. Then, they would ask Liao Bufan to bring a gasoline barrel and burn them down.
Then, they would tear it down!
“On the other hand, we need to stock up on available resources and continue to level up and expand the shelter.”
“The abandoned iron mine is a good thing...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
He controlled the remaining zombie clones to return to the abandoned iron mine and start mining.
Iron ore was an extremely important advanced material in the game.
With iron nuggets made from iron ore, players could use them to make higher-level equipment and tools.
For example, small hammers, shovels, pickaxes and so on.
The destructive power of small iron hammers was at least twice as strong as small stone hammers! It greatly increased the efficiency of the zombies demolishing the residences!
“The Dawn Guild is pretty good. They gave me a few furnaces and modules for free, so I don’t have to spend points to buy them at the merchant’s camp.”
“I estimate that the zombies’ first batch of tools will be completed very soon by night...”
After giving the instructions to the zombie clones, Fang Heng made a simple bed in the shelter and went offline immediately.
While the zombies were hacking, he could start to find a way to enhance his S-level talent.
After going offline, Fang Heng came out of the game cabin.
He then realized that he hadn’t been to the gaming company for two days.
He remembered that Shen Qing had told him three days ago that five rookies would join Team 12...
Oh no, could they still be waiting for him?
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
The newly established Team 12.
Pei Anan and a few rookies had been waiting for Fang Heng for two whole days.
They were anxious.
The few rookies were even more troubled.
The rookies who had been assigned to the other teams at the same time as them had already started working, but they were still sitting there foolishly.
They had just joined the company. If they failed the internship evaluation, they might be fired.
What should they do?
The team leader was still not coming. They were also very desperate...
Just as they were worried, Pei Anan stood up instantly.
“Team leader!”
The others also stood up and sized up the new team leader.
“Oh, oh, oh, we’re all rookies, right? There’s no need to be so formal. Come, take a seat.”
Fang Heng waved his hand and gestured for everyone to return to their seats.
The rookies sat upright as they listened to Fang Heng assign tasks.
Fang Heng had thought of asking President Qin directly.
Unfortunately, the other party’s voice notification indicated that she was in the game and could not be connected.
“Pei Anan, you know that our company has an S-level talent enhancement plan, right?”
“Ah?”
Pei Anan responded with an ‘Ah’. She hurriedly lowered her head and flipped through her notebook.
“Yes, we do. Please wait a moment, team leader.”
“Do you know?”
Fang Heng was a little surprised. He thought that the S-level talent enhancement plan was confidential within the company and that Pei Anan might not have known about it.

“Yeah, you didn’t attend yesterday’s team meeting about the Zombie Apocalypse game. I attended it on your behalf. During the meeting, we discussed the distribution of the S-level talent enhancement plan.”
“There were some problems in the Vampire Apocalypse game these days. President Qin personally brought people into the game to deal with them.”
“President Li is temporarily in charge of the Zombie Apocalypse game. The team leaders are not very satisfied with the allocation plan that President Li has set. They discussed it for a long time.”
Fang Heng frowned.
“Team leader Fang, are you interested in this mission?”
“Yes, tell me in detail. What qualifications do I need to get it?”

“In the end, President Li made the decision. According to the principle of fair competition, at the beginning of next month, a performance appraisal will be conducted for all the game teams of the company’s Zombie Apocalypse game in the first half of the year.”
“In the end, the team with the highest overall performance will obtain the allocation authority for the S-level talent enhancement plan.”

“Due to the difficulty and other reasons, there is a high probability that the mission of the enhancement plan will not be completed. Therefore, once the first-ranked team is unable to complete it within three days, it will automatically be handed over to the second-ranked team, and so on...”
Performance appraisal?
Fang Heng’s brows were tightly knitted together as he realized that the situation was not looking good.
“Pei Anan, how’s the performance of our team?”

“Uh... We’re a newly established department. Not long ago, team leader Fang completed a mission from the federation and obtained 5,000 performance points. Therefore, our total is 5,000 performance points, temporarily placing us in 12th place.”
Last place?

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - Pick Randomly
paragraphs: The meeting room was quiet.
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
He didn’t plan to stay in the company for long.
With the rapid increase in strength in the game, there was no need for him to stay in the gaming company.
It was the best choice for him to resign early and leave the company to focus on personal development.
He might as well take advantage of this opportunity.
Strive to perform as much as possible, and when he obtained the S-level talent enhancement plan, he could just resign and leave.
He had also contributed to the company in return for the enhancement plan.
Both sides took what they needed, and neither owed the other.
“At the beginning of next month, there are still five days left. I need to earn enough performance points...”
Having made up his mind, Fang Heng muttered softly and raised his head.
“Alright, then our team’s focus will be on performance. We’ll strive to get the first place within five days.”
The rookies raised their heads and looked at Fang Heng with a strange expression.
Was he sure about that?
Others used more than half a year to accumulate so much performance, yet he’s planning to use five days to surpass them?
Wouldn’t this be too farfetched?
The rookies were silent.
Fang Heng didn’t care. He turned to look at Pei Anan.
“Pei Anan, help me prepare a report for the S-level talent enhancement plan. After you’re done, submit it directly.”
“Okay, okay...”
“Also, what about the company’s performance acquisition method? Is there a detailed explanation?”
“Yes.”
Pei Anan took out a long-printed proposal and handed it to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng opened the document and looked at it carefully.
There were two types of performance in Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. The first type was basic performance.
The composition of basic performance was quite complicated and was based on the individual team’s performance.
For example, the resources that each team submitted to the company, the monthly income of the shelter within the territory, and so on.
If one completed more than the quota, they could receive additional performance points.
The second type was mission performance.
The company would release some missions from time to time.
Each team could apply for these missions. After completing them, they could obtain mission performance points.
Fang Heng’s gaze quickly swept across the A4 paper, looking for mission performances that could be completed.
Eh? Deep cooperation with the federation?
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company signed a deep cooperation agreement with the federation.
The federation would purchase some materials from the company.
Among them were familiar items such as food, wooden plank, coal, iron and so on.
The various working teams of the company only needed to collect the materials and hand them over to the federation to obtain the corresponding performance points.
Because it was a new district, the price offered by the federation was very high.
A piece of wooden plank could be directly exchanged for 1 performance point.
This was good!
Fang Heng did a quick estimation mentally.
The company’s Team 7 had achieved 17,000 performance points in the first half of the year.
In other words, just to be safe, he only needed to submit 150 million sets of wooden planks and he would be able to steadily obtain an S-level talent enhancement plan.
It was equivalent to using a batch of wood resources to exchange for an S-level talent enhancement plan.
It was not a loss.
“Then that’s it. From tomorrow onwards, we will send wooden planks to the federation.”
Fang Heng looked at the five rookies. “Leave your IDs and join the game in three hours. When that time comes, I will invite you all into my shelter.”
Wooden planks?
The rookies looked at each other when they heard that.
Logically speaking, shouldn’t the first step after entering the game be to gather resources, expand and reinforce the shelter’s defenses?
The wooden planks were difficult to synthesize and required energy points to produce.
If they didn’t even have enough for themselves, where would they get more wooden planks to give to the federation?
The King of Gods’ game server transfer requirements were very harsh.
Other than meeting the level requirement, after the server transfer, players would only retain King of Gods’ points and skills. All other equipment would be emptied.
In addition, the server transfer required one additional King of Gods’ point.
For the vast majority of ordinary players, they would never be able to obtain 1 King of Gods’ point.

Liu Wei and the other four rookies from Phoenix Sound Gaming Company were the same. They waited in the King of Gods’ space for a full three hours before they received Fang Heng’s invitation and officially entered the game.
“Sigh... This team leader doesn’t seem too reliable.”
After completing the server transformation, Liu Wei silently prayed in his heart, hoping that he could smoothly pass the company’s trial period.
When he opened his eyes, Liu Wei was a little surprised by what he saw.
This was...
The square?
The prison?
Why were they here?
Didn’t Leader Fang Heng say that he would invite them to his shelter?
What was going on here?
Could it be...
This was his shelter?
As Liu Wei was puzzled by the scene in front of him, the remaining rookies also appeared in the prison square.
“Ahem, welcome. You are all rookies from Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, right?”
Everyone turned their heads.
They saw a fat man in a short-sleeved shirt swaggering out of a house.

“Let me introduce myself. I am Liao Bufan. Fang Heng is currently busy with other matters. I will temporarily arrange your work schedules for the next few days. Let me first tell you about the rules here.”
Liao Bufan pointed at Building No. 3 behind him.
“Take a good look. This building is where you will be carrying out your activities. The rooms on the second floor are all empty. You can go in and rest in any room.”
“NPCs will arrange the meals for you every day. Meals will start at 8 am, 11 am and 7 pm on the dot. If you miss it, there will be nothing left.”

“Food and water are in Warehouse No. 2 on the first floor. If you miss the meal or need to eat, you can take them yourself. The prerequisite is that you are not allowed to take them out of the prison.”
“Oh right, be extra careful. You are not allowed to enter the locked basement. This is the rule set by boss Fang Heng. If anyone breaks the rule, don’t blame me for turning hostile.”
A single room for rest?
NPCs prepared three meals a day?
Food and water could be taken casually?
Liu Wei was confused like the other players.
Was he here for survival or a vacation?
Why was it different from the tough survival that was mentioned in the company’s internal training?
What happened to tough survival, desperately fighting zombies and overcoming difficulties in gathering materials to build a shelter?
Was there a mistake?
“Any other questions?”
“Um...” Liu Wei carefully raised his hand and asked, “Is this the shelter set up by Leader Fang Heng?”
“Yes, you’re lucky to be with Big Brother.”
Another rookie also raised his hand.
“Then what do we need to do?”
“Well, your mission for the next two days is very simple. You need to go outside and pick up logs.”
Liao Bufan walked in front of the crowd in a carefree manner.

“Don’t worry about the rest. Just go outside and pick up the logs. Remember to divide them after you pick them up. According to the grade of the logs, throw them all on the prison square. Also, put the honey you pick up in the food area. That’s about it.”
Go outside and pick up the logs?
What kind of operation was this?
Liu Wei became even more confused when he heard that.
Did he think that logs could be found all over the streets? That they could be picked up if they wanted to?
“Don’t just stand there, hurry up. We won’t go out after dark.”
Liao Bufan urged the rookies who were still in a state of confusion.
“Come, I’ll bring all of you out to familiarize yourselves with the terrain.”
Liu Wei was still in a state of confusion. Just like the others, he was inexplicably brought out of the prison by Liao Bufan.
Outside the prison, Liao Bufan pointed to the east side of the prison.
“See, there are logs all over the ground. You can just pick them up.”
Everyone looked in the direction that Liao Bufan pointed to, and all of them had shocked expressions on their faces.
They saw bits and pieces on the breach outside the prison and they were...
All logs.
“This...”
Liu Wei looked at his other companions.
What happened to this server?
Why was it different from what he had learned in the company’s training?
Why were there so many logs on the ground?
Do they just need to randomly pick them up?

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - Assembly Line
paragraphs: [Hint: During the period when you are offline, your zombie group has explored 4 residences and completed the demolition of 1 residence. You have obtained firewood*723, nails*13...]

[Hint: During the period when you are offline, your zombie group has completed 166 tree felling. You have obtained skill-strengthen the body experience points +882. You have obtained 4,992 logging experience points.]

[Hint: During the period when you are offline, your zombie group has collected iron ores*2,331. You have gained an additional gold ore*2. You have completed the production of iron ore*121. You have gained skill-Miner’s Wisdom experience points +2,033.]
[Hint: Your logging level has been upgraded to Level 10.]
[Hint: Your skill-Miner’s Wisdom level has been upgraded to Level 7.]
Inside the abandoned mine, Fang Heng checked the rewards from the hack.
Ordinary iron ores needed to be calcined by a furnace to form iron nuggets, which took a lot of time.
The hack had only obtained 121 iron nuggets for almost a whole day.
With iron nuggets, he could upgrade low-level tools to make iron tools.
“Good! We have officially entered the Iron Age!”
Fang Heng muttered to himself as an automatic channelling bar appeared above his head.
He created a small iron hammer!
[Hint: You have completed the creation of a small iron hammer. Your basic production experience points +11.]
After the production was completed, Fang Heng waved the newly created small iron hammer in his hands a few times.
Item: Small iron hammer.
Damage: 10-12.
Description: An advanced survival tool. It can be used to destroy and disassemble more efficiently.
Description: An advanced version of the ‘Hammer of God’. In theory, you can use it to break apart everything!
Fang Heng put away the iron hammer in satisfaction.
He could first craft an iron axe to increase his logging efficiency as much as possible and complete the federation’s delivery mission.
An iron axe for logging required two sets of iron nuggets.
The current amount of iron nuggets was enough to equip an entire zombie team.
As for making an iron hammer to demolish the surrounding area, he decided to put it aside for a few days.
Currently, due to the limited number of furnaces, a large portion of the iron ore had already been piled up and couldn’t be calcined in time.
Fang Heng simply left the last two zombie clones to control the furnace, bringing the zombie clones and the completed iron pieces back to the prison.
When they returned to the prison, batches of logs were already piled up in the prison square.
“This batch of toolmakers did a good job.”
Fang Heng murmured and walked to a pile of logs.
Item: Logs.
Quality: Level 2 (normal).
Description: The products of cutting down trees can be made into wooden planks, firewood and so on.
The quality of logs in the game was divided into five grades, from low to high.
Grade 1 was inferior, Grade 2 was ordinary, Grade 3 was better, Grade 4 was excellent and Grade 5 was perfect.
The higher the quality of the logs, the higher the quality of the wood made.
In the early stages, buildings made of high-quality wood could withstand higher damage.
In addition, in the later stages of the game, some high-level items would be limited to the use of high-level raw materials.
For example, in the middle stages of the game, commonly used materials: reinforced solid wooden planks.
Its synthetic materials were: wooden planks (Grade 4 or Grade 5)*5 + glue*2 + waste compound*2.
When the reinforced solid wooden planks were completed, they could provide three times the durability of ordinary wooden planks.
Currently, most of the logs piled up on the prison grounds were Grade 1-3, whereas Grade 4-5 was quite rare.
The wooden plank requirement list of the federation didn’t specify the quality of the logs. One set of logs was equal to one sum of money.
“There’s a loophole!”
Fang Heng rubbed his hands.
Since the price was the same, he would naturally hand over the low-quality logs to the federation first. He would keep the good ones for himself.
There was nothing wrong with that!
Fang Heng still controlled the zombie crowd and divided it into two groups.
One group of zombies used the newly made iron axes and continued to cut the trees in the east direction with the prison as the centre.
The other group of zombies stayed in the prison square and started to make wooden planks.
Without steel blocks, Fang Heng could not make a sawing table for the time being. He could only use the most basic manual method to make wooden planks.
For most ordinary players, making 10 wooden planks a day would consume all of their vitality points.
However, the zombie clones were different.
They had unlimited vitality points!
Four zombies were responsible for moving the logs back and forth, and three zombies were responsible for moving the finished wood planks and piling them up in the corner of the prison square.
The remaining zombie clones lined up in a row, and the assembly line began to make the wooden planks.
Fang Heng spent a full half an hour completing the single-threaded zombie planning, forming a perfect assembly line that adjusted the efficiency of the zombies to the highest.
“Good! The wooden plank production line is completed!” Fang Heng felt satisfied.
He wiped the sweat off his forehead and let out a huge sigh of relief as a sense of achievement rose in his heart.
According to this efficiency, it wouldn’t take five days at all. He estimated that he could complete 15,000 wooden planks at most within two days!
The next day.
Liu Wei and the few rookies entered Team 12 of the company to work.
They entered the game together and headed to the restaurant on the first floor to eat breakfast together.
They still wanted a free breakfast.
In the game, as long as the basic ingredients were prepared properly, even if it was a Level 1 cooking skill, the food prepared according to the recipe would still be very delicious.
While they were eating, the few rookies whispered to each other.
“That fatty is a liar.”
“Who says he isn’t? In the future, if anyone tells me that picking up logs is easy, I promise to slap them in the face!”
That’s right! That da*n fatty!
Liu Wei nodded in his heart.
He even said that picking up logs was easy.
What a joke!
After picking up logs for nearly an entire afternoon yesterday, everyone’s back was aching and their legs were cramping.
Liu Wei was even worse off. He didn’t sleep well last night and even carried logs in his dreams!
“But we should be able to take a break today.”
“That’s right. We’ve already picked up so many logs. If we continue, the entire prison square might not be able to hold them.”
“I was thinking that the task the team leader received was to transport the wooden planks. Why would he need so many logs? The federation doesn’t even accept them...”
“Don’t tell me he wants us to produce the wooden planks with our hands later?”
“Produce them with our hands? Are you kidding me? How many can we produce with our hands alone?”
“Let’s hear what the team leader has to say. The team leader should have a plan...”
While they were talking in low voices, they heard footsteps approaching from afar and they stopped talking at the same time.
“Hey, everyone is here. It must have been tough yesterday. Boss Fang said that you guys can have a share of the mission performance when we go back.”
Liao Bufan walked into the restaurant.
He was in a good mood.
He used to do the heavy work of moving wooden planks. Now that he had these toolmen, he could finally watch others do the work.
“We have to work hard today. After dinner, we’ll go downstairs and help load the goods.”
Load the goods?
The rookies looked confused.
Liu Wei murmured in his heart.
Sell the logs directly?
It’s not impossible...
But this server is a little strange, the world is full of randomly picked logs.
Are you sure these logs can be sold for money?

“Hey, everyone is here.
It must have been tough yesterday.
Boss Fang said that you guys can have a share of the mission performance when we go back.”
Liao Bufan walked into the restaurant.
He was in a good mood.
He used to do the heavy work of moving wooden planks.
Now that he had these toolmen, he could finally watch others do the work.
“We have to work hard today.
After dinner, we’ll go downstairs and help load the goods.”
Load the goods?
The rookies looked confused.
Liu Wei murmured in his heart.
Sell the logs directly?
It’s not impossible...
But this server is a little strange, the world is full of randomly picked logs.
Are you sure these logs can be sold for money?

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - I Did It
paragraphs: After breakfast, Liu Wei and the rookies returned to the prison square.
Liu Wei was stunned.
“Where are the logs?”
Where are the logs that were picked up yesterday?
What the hell!
Yesterday, there were piles of logs in the square, but why did they disappear overnight?
“Hey, look, over there.”
A rookie pointed to the right side of the square.
In the right corner of the square, pieces of wooden planks were piled up messily, accumulating into a few hills.
What was going on?
In just one night, all the logs collected yesterday had turned into wooden planks?
How did he do it?!
There was no such operation in the rookie training manual of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company!
While the rookies were bewildered, they saw a military truck coming from behind and stopping in front of a few piles of wooden planks in the corner.
Liao Bufan jumped out of the truck.
Looking at these rookies who were dumbfounded, Liao Bufan felt as though he was seeing his younger self.
There was a time when he was as ignorant as these people.
“Brothers, stop looking. The wooden planks were arranged by the boss. Quickly come and help. Load the wooden planks onto the truck.”
Liao Bufan shook his head.
Of course, he would not foolishly expose his boss’s secret.
“The boss said that these are to be delivered to the federation. When the time comes, they will all be counted as part of your work performance. Don’t slack off.”
These wooden planks were all handled by Leader Fang Heng alone?
Liu Wei and the others were all in a state of shock.
The boss used a cheat?
Immediately, everyone was ecstatic.
Performance!
They didn’t know how Leader Fang Heng turned so many logs into wooden planks in one night, nor did they know where the boss bought the cheat.
But they did know one thing.
There were at least a few thousand pieces of wooden planks piled up in that mountain...
One piece of the wooden plank was equivalent to one performance point.
That was a few thousand performance points!
With these few thousand team performance points, not to mention the internship period, just the company’s bonus alone would be enough to make their hands go weak!
The promotion and salary increment was right in front of their eyes!
Three hours later.
At the federation temporary warehouse resource point outside Hope Town.
A truck filled with wooden planks was parked at the back of the warehouse.
The federation players began to unload the wooden planks into the warehouse one after another.
Just by looking at the quantity, there were only 500 to 600 wooden planks in a truck. It was indeed not a lot.
However, in the early stages of the game, all kinds of resources were extremely scarce. Very few factions were able to produce so many wooden planks at once.
Chen Yu heard that Fang Heng had brought a batch of wood resources over, so he especially ran over to greet Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, I didn’t expect to see you so soon. Have you thought about what I suggested last time?”
“You mean join the federation? I’m sorry, I don’t like to be tied down.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yu didn’t have much hope.
On the contrary, he was curious about where Fang Heng got so many wooden planks.

“The federation is currently setting up shelters and resource collection points in various places. We are quite lacking in resources like wooden planks. This time, you have solved a pressing problem.”
“By the way, where did you get so many wooden planks?”
“Sigh! It’s a long story. It took us a lot of effort to get them. We were preparing them for our use.”
Fang Heng did not want to tell Chen Yu that he could pick up any wooden plank in his prison base.
This would cause the value of the wooden planks to depreciate rapidly.
He pretended to sigh, “I heard that the federation is short of resources and the company has given an order. Hence, I immediately sent it over to you guys.”
“That’s really... I’m really sorry.” Chen Yu scratched his head in embarrassment, “I’ll go talk to the commander and ask him to pay more money to your company.”
“No need, no need. However, I would like to ask you about something. Does your federation have an S-level talent enhancement plan?”
“This...”
Chen Yu hesitated for a moment.
He looked at Fang Heng and thought to himself, isn’t it a little too early to look for an S-level talent enhancement plan?
After all, Level 10 was still a long way off.
“There is, but we usually don’t give an S-level talent enhancement plan to outsiders.”
“Is that so...”
Fang Heng was a little disappointed.
Chen Yu took the opportunity to suggest, “If you’re willing to join the federation, I believe that the commander will definitely help you find a suitable enhancement plan.”
No, once anyone joined the federation, they would be bounded and lose their freedom. It was very troublesome.
Fang Heng had never planned to join the federation.
It seemed like he could only place his hopes on the black market for the final S-level talent enhancement plan.
He wanted to see if he could find any information related to high-level missions there.
Fang Heng was thinking in his heart.
“Oh right, there’s one more thing. Our Phoenix Sound Gaming Company has prepared a lot of wooden planks for the federation. It’s just that there’s a problem with the transportation.”
“It’s a long journey from the base to here. A round trip takes six hours. Can you think of a way to solve it?”
Chen Yu was stunned.
“What? Your company still has a lot of wooden planks?”
“Yes, there are at least 10,000 pieces of wood planks waiting to be transported over. We lack transportation tools. It takes too much time to transport them over and over again.”
Chen Yu was a little speechless for a moment.
He even thought that Fang Heng was bragging.
It had only been a little while since the game started. They wouldn’t be able to get so much even if they rubbed wooden planks day and night, right?
“Then why don’t I report this to the higher-ups later and ask the commander for his opinion...”
As Fang Heng was speaking to Chen Yu, a group of federation players walked out from the warehouse.
The members of the party were all fully armed.
They each took out four modified motorcycles from their backpacks and placed them on the road.
The two players immediately stepped onto the four-wheeled truck installed at the back of the modified motorcycles and sat down steadily.
Uh... wasn’t this considered overloading?
A federation player walked up to Chen Yu and saluted him.
“Captain Chen! The team has assembled! Please give us instructions!”
“Alright, let’s take a break. We’ll set off in ten minutes!”
“Yes!”
Fang Heng was a little curious. He looked at them a few more times and asked, “Where are you guys planning to go? Is there a new situation in Hope Town?”
“Not really. I just heard that something happened in the forest area. The captain received an emergency order last night. He asked me to bring a team over to check out the situation.”
Forest area?!
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched when he heard that.
He thought with alarm, “Oh my god! It can’t be that they’re referring to me!”
“What is it? Is it a secret?” Fang Heng asked Chen Yu.
Chen Yu shook his head and asked, “Have you heard of the Dawn Guild?”
Dawn?!
Fang Heng’s uneasiness grew stronger.
“Yes, those people often rob ordinary players in the game. I personally hate them, but what they do does not violate the law, and the federation cannot punish them.”
Fang Heng nodded.
“What happened to them?”
“Yesterday, their team was wiped out in the game.”
As he spoke, Chen Yu’s expression became serious.
“Last night, we received news that Dawn’s 40-man team was wiped out, and their shelter was demolished. According to them, someone has already occupied Prison No. 507 in the forest area.”
Fang Heng was silent.
“We conducted an internal evaluation. Under normal circumstances, players at this stage of the game are unable to clear and occupy Prison No. 507.”
“In addition, the prison side has the ability to wipe out the Dawn Guild.”
Chen Yu rubbed his chin and lowered his head to analyze seriously.
“Also, according to Dawn’s explanation, the prison side also has a high-level sniper rifle.”
“Moreover, there’s a relatively special mission involved in the prison. The federation is more concerned about this...”

“In short, the higher-ups of the federation are worried that the people occupying the prison are members of an extremely dangerous anti-federation organization. This morning, the leader asked me to go over and investigate the situation there.”
“This mission isn’t simple...”
Fang Heng silently reached out his hand and placed it on Chen Yu’s shoulder.
“Hey, Chen Yu...”
Chen Yu, who was deep in thought, raised his head. “Eh? What?”
Fang Heng took a deep breath.
“I confess. I did it.”
Chen Yu looked at him with a puzzled expression.
“The prison is mine.”
Chen Yu: !!!

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - Cooperation
paragraphs: Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
In the office, Li Ru rested her chin on one hand as she read through the emails she had received recently.
Suddenly, Li Ru let out a sneer.
“Tsk, wishful thinking.”
“What’s so funny?”
“Zombie Apocalypse Team 12, applying for an S-level talent enhancement plan.”
The middle-aged man sitting in the opposite chair frowned.
He was the team leader of Zombie Apocalypse Team 7, Dai Zhe.
“Team 12? The new team that was established not long ago?”
“Yes, that’s the one. The leader is Fang Heng.”
Hearing Fang Heng’s name, Dai Zhe’s heart skipped a beat.
It was him?
The ruthless man who had completed the federation’s mission not long ago.
“You approved it?”
“They applied through normal channels. I have no reason to reject it.”
Li Ru turned to look at Dai Zhe.
“Are you afraid?”
“No, I’m just a little uneasy.”

“In the past half a year, I’ve provided so many resources to Team 7 in the game, both openly and secretly, and they are ahead of the others by half a year in terms of performance. If you still can’t get the S-level enhancement plan this time, you can resign and leave.”
“That’s right. I’m already ahead of them by so much.”
Dai Zhe calmed his mind.
“I got it. I’ve completed another big deal in the past two days. When the time comes, I’ll be able to gather a total of 20,000 performance points. We have to obtain the enhancement plan this time.”
“Yes, we have to ensure that nothing goes wrong.”
On the flat road, Fang Heng drove the military truck back to the prison.
Behind him, the federation’s five motorcycles were accompanying him.
At this moment, there were eight fully armed federation players sitting at the place where the truck was originally loaded.
Fang Heng sat in the driver’s seat and glanced sideways at Chen Yu.
Originally, Fang Heng wasn’t willing to bring so many federation players back to the prison for a ‘tour’.
However, Chen Yu said that the federation was willing to provide him with mission information regarding the S-level talent enhancement plan.
The condition was to go to the prison to take a look and confirm that no dangerous anti-federation hostile forces were invading.
What was the difference between this and getting a free lunch?
Fang Heng immediately agreed!
In the passenger’s seat, Chen Yu had been communicating through the survival radio.
After a long while, he put away the survival radio with a serious expression, as if he had received a big mission.
“What did they say?”
“The higher-ups agreed to our cooperation plan after discussing it.”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“We will provide you with a game mission that will reward you with an S-level talent enhancement plan. We will also try our best to provide you with assistance during the mission.”
“But there are two conditions.”
Fang Heng suppressed the excitement in his heart and asked in a deep voice, “What conditions?”
Chen Yu was very sincere.
“Firstly, we want to stay in the prison for a few days to ensure that the prison is not invaded by some anti-federation forces with ulterior motives.”
“We understand that you are disgusted by this request, but it is very important to us. I hope you can understand.”
“Sure, let them have a tour of the prison!” Fang Heng thought.
There was nothing that needed to be kept secret in the prison anyway. It was normal for them to just casually pass by a few vine zombies, right?
It wouldn’t be a problem for them to pile up some logs in the prison square.
It was common for them to grow flowers and plants in the basement to improve the environment, right?
Fang Heng thought for a moment and agreed to the suggestion.
“No problem. What about the second condition?”

“The second condition is related to the mission of the S-level talent enhancement plan. After the mission is completed, our federation would like to retrieve the samples of high-level mutated zombies from the mission.”
“Eh? Only corpses?”
“Yes, we only want corpses. Everything else, including the mission reward, is in your control.”
“That’s not a problem! Deal!”
Fang Heng admitted that even if he wanted corpses, they would be useless.
“Now, can we talk about the details?”
“Alright, Fang Heng.”
Chen Yu took out a notebook from his backpack and explained seriously.
“First of all, the King of God’s Zombie Apocalypse game is divided into multiple servers.”
“Every server world is randomly generated.”
“For example, we have met Alex before.”
“In our server, he appeared in the underground secret research room of Hope Town’s Hospital.”
“But in District 6, there is no Hope Town on the world map at all. The secret research room and Alex will appear in another place.”
“Yes, I understand that.”
“However, there are a few that will appear on a fixed basis, just like Prison No. 507, which is where you are currently based in.”

“Prison No. 507 exists on other servers as well. However, its location will appear randomly. It might appear in a small town, or at the beach. Within this server, it appeared at the periphery of the forest region, and it is currently occupied by you.”

“What I want to say is that in the previous servers, the process of triggering a mission was the same. From the information that our federation obtained, the final mission reward is an S-level talent enhancement plan.”
Fang Heng was stunned. He had a keen perception of something.
“You can’t be trying to tell me that the information about the S-level talent enhancement mission provided by the federation is from Prison No. 507?!”
It turned out that after searching for a long time, the final S-level talent enhancement plan was in his own prison!
F*ck!
He had been bought by the federation for nothing!
Chen Yu noticed Fang Heng’s expression. His skin was thin, and he scratched his head in embarrassment. His voice had become much softer.
“Captain is right. As expected, I can’t hide it from you.”
He was careless!
Who would have thought that Chen Yu, this seemingly simple and honest single, would be able to lie to others?
Fang Heng felt that he had been deceived.
Previously, he had already felt that something was amiss.
The fact that the federation was willing to provide an S-level talent enhancement plan to an outsider was not reasonable in itself.
Unless the mission itself had already been triggered by him!

“Eh... Fang Heng, the process of this mission is very difficult. Conservatively speaking, it will take at least one to two months to complete it. During this period of time, our federation will also fully cooperate with you to complete the mission.”
They still wanted to stay in prison for one to two months?
Fang Heng admitted that he couldn’t wait that long!
He had to complete the mission within five days and obtain the S-level talent enhancement plan!
After calming down and thinking about it, at least now he had the goal of obtaining the S-level talent enhancement plan, as well as the support of Chen Yu and the other toolmen.
Their understanding of the prison mission was much clearer.
It was not a loss.
After a brief calculation, Fang Heng said, “Alright, tell me about the mission flow of Prison No. 507.”
“According to what we know, Prison No. 507 is one of the testing grounds of the Meteorite Company. The prison director once used prisoners to carry out unstable T-virus mutation experiments.”
“The difficulty of the mission is the highest level, the SSS-level. There are a large number of Tier 1 mutated zombies and a small number of Tier 2 mutated zombies in the prison.”
“The most troublesome one is the giant zombie, Erita. It’s an enhanced T-virus variant that has higher intelligence compared to ordinary zombies.”
“However, it’s still under the control of the bloodlust. In terms of strength, it’s a Tier 4 mutated zombie.”
“Due to some special reasons, we need to obtain Erita’s corpse and obtain a part of the sample from the corpse.”
It was another Tier 4 mutated zombie!
Hearing Chen Yu’s words, Fang Heng couldn’t help but feel a headache.
Last time, relying on the vine zombies’ fear of fire, they dug a hole to forcefully finish it off.
What should they do this time?
Continue digging a hole in the prison?
It wasn’t easy...
Fang Heng thought for a while and asked, “Does your federation have a battle plan?”
“No.”
Chen Yu shook his head repeatedly, his answer clear.
“The battle plan you used against Alex in Hope Town has proven that you have an outstanding command ability.”
“According to the higher-ups, unless there’s an emergency, under normal circumstances, we will listen to your orders.”
It sounded like flattery.
However, Chen Yu had the self-awareness of a toolman.
Fang Heng rubbed his chin and started thinking about how to deal with a Tier 4 mutated zombie.

“Now, can we talk about the details?”
“Alright, Fang Heng.”
Chen Yu took out a notebook from his backpack and explained seriously.
“First of all, the King of God’s Zombie Apocalypse game is divided into multiple servers.”
“Every server world is randomly generated.”
“For example, we have met Alex before.”
“In our server, he appeared in the underground secret research room of Hope Town’s Hospital.”
“But in District 6, there is no Hope Town on the world map at all.
The secret research room and Alex will appear in another place.”
“Yes, I understand that.”
“However, there are a few that will appear on a fixed basis, just like Prison No.
507, which is where you are currently based in.”
“Prison No.
507 exists on other servers as well.
However, its location will appear randomly.
It might appear in a small town, or at the beach.
Within this server, it appeared at the periphery of the forest region, and it is currently occupied by you.”
“What I want to say is that in the previous servers, the process of triggering a mission was the same.
From the information that our federation obtained, the final mission reward is an S-level talent enhancement plan.”
Fang Heng was stunned.
He had a keen perception of something.
“You can’t be trying to tell me that the information about the S-level talent enhancement mission provided by the federation is from Prison No.
It turned out that after searching for a long time, the final S-level talent enhancement plan was in his own prison!
F*ck!
He had been bought by the federation for nothing!
Chen Yu noticed Fang Heng’s expression.
His skin was thin, and he scratched his head in embarrassment.
His voice had become much softer.
“Captain is right.
As expected, I can’t hide it from you.”
He was careless!
Who would have thought that Chen Yu, this seemingly simple and honest single, would be able to lie to others?
Fang Heng felt that he had been deceived.
Previously, he had already felt that something was amiss.
The fact that the federation was willing to provide an S-level talent enhancement plan to an outsider was not reasonable in itself.
Unless the mission itself had already been triggered by him!
Fang Heng, the process of this mission is very difficult.
Conservatively speaking, it will take at least one to two months to complete it.
During this period of time, our federation will also fully cooperate with you to complete the mission.”
They still wanted to stay in prison for one to two months?
Fang Heng admitted that he couldn’t wait that long!
He had to complete the mission within five days and obtain the S-level talent enhancement plan!
After calming down and thinking about it, at least now he had the goal of obtaining the S-level talent enhancement plan, as well as the support of Chen Yu and the other toolmen.
Their understanding of the prison mission was much clearer.
It was not a loss.
After a brief calculation, Fang Heng said, “Alright, tell me about the mission flow of Prison No.
“According to what we know, Prison No.
507 is one of the testing grounds of the Meteorite Company.
The prison director once used prisoners to carry out unstable T-virus mutation experiments.”
“The difficulty of the mission is the highest level, the SSS-level.
There are a large number of Tier 1 mutated zombies and a small number of Tier 2 mutated zombies in the prison.”
“The most troublesome one is the giant zombie, Erita.
It’s an enhanced T-virus variant that has higher intelligence compared to ordinary zombies.”
“However, it’s still under the control of the bloodlust.
In terms of strength, it’s a Tier 4 mutated zombie.”
“Due to some special reasons, we need to obtain Erita’s corpse and obtain a part of the sample from the corpse.”
It was another Tier 4 mutated zombie!
Hearing Chen Yu’s words, Fang Heng couldn’t help but feel a headache.
Last time, relying on the vine zombies’ fear of fire, they dug a hole to forcefully finish it off.
What should they do this time?
Continue digging a hole in the prison?
It wasn’t easy...
Fang Heng thought for a while and asked, “Does your federation have a battle plan?”
“No.”
Chen Yu shook his head repeatedly, his answer clear.
“The battle plan you used against Alex in Hope Town has proven that you have an outstanding command ability.”
“According to the higher-ups, unless there’s an emergency, under normal circumstances, we will listen to your orders.”
It sounded like flattery.
However, Chen Yu had the self-awareness of a toolman.
Fang Heng rubbed his chin and started thinking about how to deal with a Tier 4 mutated zombie.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - ultivating Ones Character
paragraphs: In the afternoon, the prison’s door opened.
The truck struggled to bypass the layers of logs in the prison square and finally stopped in front of Building No. 3.
After opening the door, Chen Yu jumped out of the truck.
He had already seen the mountain of logs in the prison.
There was nothing he could do. The entire prison square was filled with logs. It was hard not to see them!
Chen Yu even saw a few players carrying logs to the prison square.
No way! Must it be so exaggerated?
Chen Yu muttered to himself and turned around silently.
He looked at Fang Heng in the driver’s seat with a strange expression.
Was this Prison No. 507?
Why did he feel like he was in a large logging base?
He thought, “Also, didn’t you say that it was difficult to obtain wood resources?”
“Why do I feel that your logs are just like free wood?”
“How on earth did you do it?”
Liu Wei, who had worked hard for an entire day and had moved logs for an entire day, similarly looked at Fang Heng and the federation players with a puzzled gaze.
What was the situation with leader Fang Heng?
Why were there so many people from the federation all of a sudden?
Could it be that... They were also here to help pick up logs?

“It’s alright, Brother. These are all friends from the federation who are here to help. You guys can continue with your work. I’ll give all of you a day off tomorrow and rest for a day. We’ll continue the day after tomorrow!”
Fang Heng called out to Liu Wei. As he spoke, he extended his hand and patted Chen Yu on the shoulder, bringing him to a corner at the side.
Only then did Chen Yu realize that there was actually a huge pile of wooden planks in the corner of the prison.
The number was around seven to eight thousand.
If it was in the past, Chen Yu would have been shocked by the number of wooden planks.
But now, he felt that it was within reason.
After all, the entire prison square was filled with logs.
It would be abnormal if there were no wooden planks.
“I’m not lying to you, right? All the wooden planks that we made are here.”

“The wooden planks are too heavy, and it’s too troublesome to transport them. If it’s convenient, it’s best if your federation sends someone to collect them personally. At most, it’ll cost a little less. What do you think?”
Chen Yu scratched his head. “Alright, I’ll contact my superior.”
“Hahaha, then I’ll leave this matter to you. Come, I’ll show you around the prison.”
Fang Heng led Chen Yu’s team to take a detailed tour of the prison’s Building No. 3.
Including Chen Yu, the entire team was shocked.
A single room, three luxurious meals and a food buffet.
NPCs were responsible for cleaning the building all day long, and there was even electricity supply every night!
What kind of treatment was this?
Even for the powerful federation, they were still struggling to maintain their daily food and clothing.
They were often faced with a shortage of resources and needed to personally go out to collect food.
Like his other teammates, Chen Yu was extremely shocked.
Looking at the prison as a whole, the only thing that was lacking was its defense.
Chen Yu noticed it when he arrived.
In comparison, the prison’s defense was not strong.
There was only one NPC guarding the prison’s sentry tower.
If it was the federation, they would definitely send a small team to guard the sentry tower 24 hours a day and lay a circle of wooden traps around the perimeter.
After all, the other party was only a player with the support of the company.
To be able to do this was already very impressive.
Chen Yu secretly calculated in his heart.
He decided that after he returned, he must seriously report this matter to his superiors.
He must properly rope in Phoenix Sound Gaming Company and Fang Heng!
After going around in circles, Fang Heng brought everyone back to the basement.
Chen Yu was alerted when he saw a “Do Not Enter” sign on a reinforced wooden door.
“Fang Heng, what’s in this room?”
“Oh, it’s a warehouse I opened for storage.”
“Can we go in and take a look?”
“But, I suggest you take a look at the door. Don’t get too close.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he pushed open the shelter’s wooden door.
Chen Yu was confused.
He stood at the door and looked into the room.
The room was very spacious.
He immediately saw the potted plants in the corner.
“This...”
Chen Yu’s face turned pale. He turned his head and looked at Fang Heng in shock.
“What is this?”
“Ha, I’m sorry. It’s a hobby. I like to plant flowers and plants when I have nothing to do to cultivate my character.”
This was called flowers and plants?!
This was clearly a corpse vine!
Chen Yu had seen Alex’s mission report before, so of course, he knew what a corpse vine was!
Alex was a monster created by the corpse vine!
Fang Heng actually used some unknown method to move the corpse vine from the Meteorite’s secret laboratory to this place!
Was he crazy!
He hid such a dangerous thing under the base!
What was he trying to do?!
If he wasn’t careful and something happened to the corpse vine...
“Haha, I’m just joking with you. I’m just doing some research.”
Fang Heng noticed Chen Yu’s expression and put away his joking attitude.
“I received a mission related to the corpse vine. Because the corpse vine is extremely dangerous, I kept them here for research. Normally, no one would come in here.”
“I see.”
Chen Yu was scared half to death.
Good lord, who would plant the corpse vines in the basement to cultivate one’s character?
After walking around the prison, Chen Yu did not find any signs of anti-federation forces.
The only thing that made him feel a little strange was the corpse vines planted in the basement.
It made sense if they were used for research.
As for whether there were any hidden anti-federation forces infiltrating the prison, he still needed to observe for a few more days.

Apart from the internal investigation of the prison, the federation would also conduct a thorough investigation of the other party outside of the game, including background checks, financial transactions, interpersonal relationships and so on.
After years of training by the federation, if there really were anti-federation forces lurking inside the prison, Chen Yu believed that he would not be able to hide it from the federation’s eyes.
In the end, a few of them came to the three iron gates at the end of the underground passage.

Chen Yu explained to Fang Heng, “The information the federation has collected is not much. We only know that beyond these three iron gates is the second basement of the prison. The giant zombie Erita is locked inside.”
“The magnetic card to open the other two iron gates can be found inside Prison No. 1 and Prison No. 2 respectively.”
Chen Yu took two steps back as he spoke, pointing at the iron gate at the fork of the passage.
“This passage leads to the basement of Prison No. 2. You should have the magnetic card to open the gate.”
“Be careful, there are a large number of Tier 1 mutated spider zombies and poisonous zombies inside Prison No. 2. They are very difficult to deal with.”
“After cleaning up Prison No. 2, you can find the key and the magnetic card to the gate of Prison No. 1.”
“As for the situation inside Prison No. 1, we have no other information yet.”
Fang Heng listened carefully to Chen Yu’s words and nodded solemnly.
“The estimated number of zombies in Prison No. 2 is between 3,000 to 5,000, and the number of Tier 1 mutated zombies is over 10%.”

“Based on the efficiency of our federal team alone, we estimate that it will take at least 10-15 days to clean up all the zombies. If there are any accidents during this period, it might be a little slower.”
Fang Heng looked at the passage on the right that led to Prison No. 2, deep in thought.
3,000 to 5,000 low-level zombies?
Great! Another large sum of points could be added to his account!
With this amount of points, the remaining zombies could basically complete the transformation into vine zombies...
“After all, the final reward for this mission is the S-level talent enhancement plan. The process won’t be that simple. Although it’s very difficult, we can still complete the mission slowly.”
Chen Yu looked at Fang Heng, who was deep in thought, and patted his shoulder to show his encouragement.
“Take your time. The federation will provide you with support and help you clean up the zombies.”
Fang Heng raised his head and said, “Alright, thank you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - Exploring Building No. 2
paragraphs: [Third stage mission: Exploring the second basement of the prison.]
[Mission name: Exploring the second basement of the prison.]

[Mission description: You have discovered an unknown area that is not marked on the map in the basement of the prison. It leads to the second basement. Please try to enter the second basement without damaging the main building of the prison.]
Mission reward: Survival points.
In the evening, Fang Heng deliberately brought Chen Yu and the others to drink with Liao Bufan.
Chen Yu was usually very simple and honest, but he was even more forthright when he drank.
After a round of heavy drinking, Chen Yu and the others could not hold on any longer. They took a hot bath and then went offline to rest.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, Fang Heng returned to the basement alone.
Behind him, fifty zombie clones blocked the narrow passage.
It would take at least ten days to clean up Prison No. 2?
‘Are you kidding me? That’s too long.’.
Fang Heng believed that he didn’t have that much time to waste.
He walked to the iron gate leading to Prison No. 2 and took out a magnetic card.
“Beep, Beep, Beep! Verification successful!”
“Ka, Ka, Ka...”
The iron gate rose again.
Fang Heng raised his flashlight and scanned the inside of the passage of Prison No. 2.
He went in to check the situation!
Fang Heng strode forward.
The inside of the passage was very dark.
Relying on the light of the flashlight, Fang Heng carefully walked into the passage with a shotgun in one hand.
Soon, he passed a corner of the underground passage and heard faint footsteps in front of him.
The zombies that were lingering in Prison No. 2 smelled the scent of humans.
They walked unsteadily from the front of the passage.
There was a dense group of about a dozen of them.
Trouble was coming. It was the poisonous zombie!
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
He immediately recognized the poisonous zombie that was mixed among the ordinary zombies.
Tier 1 mutated zombie-poisonous zombie.
The poisonous zombie was very famous among the players.
Its attributes were average, but its HP was higher than ordinary zombies.
However, it had an air sac filled with viruses inside its body.
Once the poisonous zombie died, the air sac inside its body would explode, and the surrounding area would be filled with poisonous gas.
Fang Heng took half a step back.
Behind him, five vine zombies held wooden spears and staggered forward.
They stood side by side and blocked the narrow passage.
When the zombies got closer, the clones raised their wooden spears and attacked.
“Crack!”
The spears pierced into the rotten flesh of the zombie.
The poisonous zombie mixed with the ordinary zombies was attacked, so it waved its arms and counterattacked.
Such a normal attack dealt almost zero damage to the vine zombies!
On the other hand, when the vine zombies were attacked, vines of all sizes shot out from their bodies.
The vines quickly wrapped around the poisonous zombie, trapping it on the spot.
In just a moment, the poisonous zombie was stabbed into sieves by the zombie clones and fell to the ground.
“Boom!”
After the poisonous zombie died, the gas bag in its body exploded.
The air was immediately covered by a layer of pale purple mist.
Seeing the poisonous mist, Fang Heng took a few steps back, frowning.
This kind of poisonous gas was very scary. Once a human inhaled it, they would enter a mild ‘poisoning’ state.
If they didn’t leave in time and inhaled more poisonous gas, the poisoning state would quickly turn into ‘infection’.
In the early stage, players couldn’t make effective anti-infection potions.
Infection was equivalent to death.
The most troublesome thing was that the poisonous gas left behind by the poisonous zombies after death would take three to five hours to slowly dissipate.
To ordinary players, the poisonous zombies were not strong, but they were extremely disgusting!
Chen Yu was not wrong. With such disgusting zombies, it would indeed take them ten days to half a month to slowly clean them up.
Fang Heng didn’t dare to go near them.
However, he was different from ordinary players. He had his zombie clones.
To zombies, the poisonous gas was useless.
The zombie clones stood in the poisonous gas and were unharmed.
“The safety level of killing monsters has been verified.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
It seemed that it wouldn’t be a problem to use the vine zombie clones to clean up the entire Prison No. 2.
Just as he was about to leave, Fang Heng stopped again.
From the tunnel in front of him came a few more sounds of friction against the wall.
Fang Heng immediately raised his flashlight and shone it at the wall.
Two or three black shadows quickly climbed along the wall.
Spider zombies!
They were old friends!
Fang Heng took two steps back and hid behind two zombie clones, then raised his shotgun.
The spider zombies pressed against the wall to attack.
They wanted to attack Fang Heng but were blocked by the vine zombies at the intersection.
Helplessly, the two spider zombies at the front flew up and attacked the vine zombies with their sharp claws.
“Chi!”
The spider zombie’s sharp claws cut two long and thin wounds on the vine zombies.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!”
In the blink of an eye, several vines shot out from the wounds on the zombie’s body.
The vines went straight for the spider zombie.
The spider zombie only hesitated for a moment before its arm was entangled.
It couldn’t break free for a moment. In the next second, more and more vines rushed toward it.
The vines wrapped the spider zombie tightly, trapping it on the spot.
Then, the remaining zombie clones in the tunnel rushed forward.
They raised their wooden spears.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!”
Soon, the spider zombies covered in vines were stabbed into sieves by the zombie clones.
Seeing that, Fang Heng put down the shotgun in his hand.
“Hu! Impressive!”
Fang Heng now had a new understanding of the combat ability of the vine zombie clones.
Once the number of vine zombies reached a certain level, these Tier 1 mutated zombies wouldn’t be able to threaten them at all!
With the vine zombies under him, it wouldn’t be a problem to clear out the entire Prison No. 2!
With a wave of his hand, he controlled the remaining 30 zombies behind him to swarm into the tunnel.
Fang Heng turned around and left the passage of Prison No. 2.
He used the magnetic card again to close the iron gate.
After returning to the shelter in the basement, Fang Heng lit a bonfire.
He opened the game log and rows of notifications popped up.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed an ordinary zombie. You have received 3 survival points. You have received skill-basic strength training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed an ordinary zombie. You have gained 2 survival points. You have gained skill-basic strength training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a Tier 1 mutated zombie-poisonous zombie. You have gained 6 survival points. You have gained skill-basic strength training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed...]
“It should be enough to hack for one night. I’ll clean up Prison No. 2 first. I’ll think of a way to deal with Prison No. 1 tomorrow.”
“The target is to complete the mission within three days. After four days, I’ll obtain three S-level talent enhancement plans...”
Fang Heng left a simple bed on the ground.
He went offline and went to sleep

Such a normal attack dealt almost zero damage to the vine zombies!
On the other hand, when the vine zombies were attacked, vines of all sizes shot out from their bodies.
The vines quickly wrapped around the poisonous zombie, trapping it on the spot.
In just a moment, the poisonous zombie was stabbed into sieves by the zombie clones and fell to the ground.
“Boom!”
After the poisonous zombie died, the gas bag in its body exploded.
The air was immediately covered by a layer of pale purple mist.
Seeing the poisonous mist, Fang Heng took a few steps back, frowning.
This kind of poisonous gas was very scary.
Once a human inhaled it, they would enter a mild ‘poisoning’ state.
If they didn’t leave in time and inhaled more poisonous gas, the poisoning state would quickly turn into ‘infection’.
In the early stage, players couldn’t make effective anti-infection potions.
Infection was equivalent to death.
The most troublesome thing was that the poisonous gas left behind by the poisonous zombies after death would take three to five hours to slowly dissipate.
To ordinary players, the poisonous zombies were not strong, but they were extremely disgusting!
Chen Yu was not wrong.
With such disgusting zombies, it would indeed take them ten days to half a month to slowly clean them up.
Fang Heng didn’t dare to go near them.
However, he was different from ordinary players.
He had his zombie clones.
To zombies, the poisonous gas was useless.
The zombie clones stood in the poisonous gas and were unharmed.
“The safety level of killing monsters has been verified.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
It seemed that it wouldn’t be a problem to use the vine zombie clones to clean up the entire Prison No.
Just as he was about to leave, Fang Heng stopped again.
From the tunnel in front of him came a few more sounds of friction against the wall.
Fang Heng immediately raised his flashlight and shone it at the wall.
Two or three black shadows quickly climbed along the wall.
Spider zombies!
They were old friends!
Fang Heng took two steps back and hid behind two zombie clones, then raised his shotgun.
The spider zombies pressed against the wall to attack.
They wanted to attack Fang Heng but were blocked by the vine zombies at the intersection.
Helplessly, the two spider zombies at the front flew up and attacked the vine zombies with their sharp claws.
“Chi!”
The spider zombie’s sharp claws cut two long and thin wounds on the vine zombies.
“Chi!
Chi!
Chi!”
In the blink of an eye, several vines shot out from the wounds on the zombie’s body.
The vines went straight for the spider zombie.
The spider zombie only hesitated for a moment before its arm was entangled.
It couldn’t break free for a moment.
In the next second, more and more vines rushed toward it.
The vines wrapped the spider zombie tightly, trapping it on the spot.
Then, the remaining zombie clones in the tunnel rushed forward.
They raised their wooden spears.
“Chi!
Chi!
Chi!”
Soon, the spider zombies covered in vines were stabbed into sieves by the zombie clones.
Seeing that, Fang Heng put down the shotgun in his hand.
“Hu!
Impressive!”
Fang Heng now had a new understanding of the combat ability of the vine zombie clones.
Once the number of vine zombies reached a certain level, these Tier 1 mutated zombies wouldn’t be able to threaten them at all!
With the vine zombies under him, it wouldn’t be a problem to clear out the entire Prison No.
With a wave of his hand, he controlled the remaining 30 zombies behind him to swarm into the tunnel.
Fang Heng turned around and left the passage of Prison No.
He used the magnetic card again to close the iron gate.
After returning to the shelter in the basement, Fang Heng lit a bonfire.
He opened the game log and rows of notifications popped up.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed an ordinary zombie.
You have received 3 survival points.
You have received skill-basic strength training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed an ordinary zombie.
You have gained 2 survival points.
You have gained skill-basic strength training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a Tier 1 mutated zombie-poisonous zombie.
You have gained 6 survival points.
You have gained skill-basic strength training experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed...]
“It should be enough to hack for one night.
I’ll clean up Prison No.
2 first.
I’ll think of a way to deal with Prison No.
1 tomorrow.”
“The target is to complete the mission within three days.
After four days, I’ll obtain three S-level talent enhancement plans...”
Fang Heng left a simple bed on the ground.
He went offline and went to sleep

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - Blueprint-small Sentry Post
paragraphs: Fang Heng drank a little last night, and he slept late. He slept until 10 o’clock.
Fang Heng couldn’t be bothered to go to the gaming company, so he logged into the game cabin in the villa.
After entering the game, Fang Heng opened the game log to observe.
[Hint: During the time you are offline, your zombie group has completed the mission of clearing Prison Block No. 2. Your zombie group is on standby.]

[Hint: During the period when you are offline, your zombie group has killed ordinary zombies*3512, spider zombies*233, poisonous zombies*566, obtained 11,992 survival points, evolution crystal fragment*677, complete evolution crystal*199.]

[Hint: You have acquired skill-strengthen the body experience points +5432, you have acquired skill-physique basic training experience points +67811, you have acquired skill-strength basic training experience points +81271, you have acquired skill-agility basic training experience points +22419.]

[Hint: Your physique basic training has been upgraded to Level 10, your strength basic training has been upgraded to Level 10, your agility basic training has been upgraded to Level 10 and your strengthen the body skill has been upgraded to Level 10.]
[Hint: Your skill has reached the upper limit of your current character’s level. You are unable to continue acquiring experience points. Please upgrade your character’s level as soon as possible.]
“12,000 survival points, and four more zombie clones. Unfortunately, the points are still not enough...”
Fang Heng muttered softly.
He put away the bonfire and the makeshift bed and returned to the passage.
“Verified!”
Opening the iron gate between Prison No. 2 and Prison No. 3, the vine zombies returned to the underground shelter one by one.
Whenever they passed by Fang Heng, they would throw the materials that dropped after killing the monsters in front of him.
Fang Heng began to check the gains from last night’s ‘hack’.
[Hint: You have obtained scrap*21, rags*77, broken wrench, damaged engine parts, scrap metal*33...]
Fang Heng threw the items that the zombies collected into his backpack and focused on reading the skill book.
“Recipe, fragrant fried potato cake.”
“Recipe, home-cooked braised pork ribs.”
“Recipe, home-cooked eggplant.”
“Hehe, it’s still a recipe, home-cooked stir-fried meat. Looks like today is a home-cooked series.”
As Fang Heng was speaking, his eyes suddenly lit up.
[Hint: You have obtained blueprint-small sentry tower.]
“Eh?”
“Finally obtained something good?”
Blueprint: Small sentry tower.
Description: After use, you can control the construction of the sentry tower.

Sentry tower’s attributes: The small sentry tower can accommodate up to five people at the same time. Players (including NPC mercenaries) in the sentry tower can have an additional 1,500 field of vision and an additional 30% long-range weapon attack hit rate, an additional 50% long-range weapon attack critical rate, an additional 10% long-range weapon attack speed and an additional 20% long-range weapon effective attack range.
Blueprint learning condition: Basic construction (Level 10).
Sentry towers were a good thing!
In reality, in the game, even if players did not have blueprints, they could simulate the construction of sentry towers and attack zombies from a high position.
However, players could not enjoy the additional attributes of the completed building.
Moreover, the completed building was very fragile, and could not be considered as a whole by the King of Gods. Its durability was lower and it was easier to be destroyed by zombies.
Prison No. 507 already had two middle-grade sentry towers.
When he had some free time in the next few days, he would build a circle of sentry towers around the prison and recruit more elite Dark Knight NPCs to greatly increase the prison’s defense.
When that time came, he would not be afraid even if there were more than ten blood moons!
Fang Heng thought happily as he patted the skill book he had collected on his head.
[Hint: You have learned the recipe-fragrant fried potato cake, braised pork ribs, eggplant, stir-fried pork. Your cooking skill + 13.]
[Hint: You have learned the construction of a small sentry tower.]
After counting the rewards, Fang Heng gave the order to search Prison No. 2 to the zombie clones. Then, he personally led ten zombie clones into Prison No. 2 to explore.
Prison No. 2 had been massacred by the zombies once.
However, because the zombies lacked intelligence, they wouldn’t force their way into locked rooms.
Fang Heng didn’t have time to search carefully, so he went straight to the management room on the first floor.
He had heard Chen Yu mention that the magnetic card for Prison No. 2 could be found in the management room on the first floor of the prison.
He followed the underground passage to the first floor, then walked along the corridor and passed by the prison area. Soon, he found the locked management room.
Fang Heng waved his hand.
Several zombie clones behind him raised their small iron hammers and knocked on the door lock.
“Bang!”
After a few rounds of knocking, the door lock was broken.
Fang Heng pushed open the iron gate.
The zombies in the room slowly turned around and faced Fang Heng.
Before they were ready to attack, the zombie clones had already pounced on them and stabbed them with wooden spears.
After confirming that there was no danger, Fang Heng entered the room to investigate.
The management room was in a mess.
The monitoring platform had lost its function due to the power failure. The screen was pitch black.
Fang Heng immediately saw a blood-stained book beside the table.
[Hint: You have obtained the prison management duty log.]
Fang Heng opened the duty log and read.
Nothing happened.
Nothing happened.
Nothing happened.
There was an accident in the second basement of Prison No. 2. The magnetic card had failed and had been reported for repair.

Please note that the magnetic card with the highest authority is stored in the safe of the gun room on the second floor of Prison No. 1. It can be used in emergencies. The small password of the safe is 2391.
Nothing happened.
Nothing happened...
Fang Heng closed the book and frowned slightly.
“Strange.”
The magnetic card was stored in the gun room on the second floor of Prison No. 1?
Could the highest authority magnetic card open all the door locks directly?
Why was it different from what Chen Yu said before.
There was probably a mistake with his mission information.
Fang Heng thought as he picked up the key chain hanging on the wall of the management room.
Chen Yu was full of energy.
He and his team had never had such a comfortable life in the apocalypse game.
Last night, they had their first full meal in the game, and drank several bottles of cold beer along the way.
They even took a hot shower before going to bed!
What made Chen Yu even happier was that he did not find any signs of anti-federation infiltration in the prison.
The news that came from the federation today also proved Fang Heng’s innocence.
The federation confirmed that Fang Heng had completely cut off contact with his dangerous ex-girlfriend for more than a year.
The only thing that made Chen Yu slightly wary was the logs piled up in the square.
Fang Heng seemed to have an efficient way of gathering wood.
It could be a talent skill.
Chen Yu felt that these were not within his scope of investigation.
Many people did not want to expose their talent skills in the game.
Chen Yu understood this very well.
Moreover, he felt that with the help of Fang Heng’s large number of materials, the federation could build a larger shelter and protect more people.
Chen Yu felt that this was a great thing.
After spending a day in prison for nothing, Chen Yu felt a little embarrassed.
He was already prepared to do his best to help Fang Heng complete the prison mission and help him obtain an S-level talent enhancement plan as soon as possible.
However, the strange thing was that he couldn’t find Fang Heng even after walking around the prison.
[Hint: Your survival radio has received an emergency message.]
Chen Yu turned on the survival radio.
Fang Heng: Bring the team to Prison No. 1 in ten minutes. I’ll be waiting for you.
Chen Yu: Roger that.
Chen Yu scratched his head.
“Prison No. 1? Strange, why isn’t it Prison No.. 2?”
