chapters.title: Chapter 96 - Exploring Prison No. 1
paragraphs: After receiving the news from Fang Heng, Chen Yu gathered his team and waited for orders in front of Prison No. 1.
Not long after, Fang Heng came over with a key.
“Did you get used to staying here last night?”
“Of course, the environment here is much better than the federation warehouse resource point.”
If he had a choice, Chen Yu hoped that he could stay here forever.
“Fang Heng, why did you arrange to meet here? Are you planning to attack Prison No. 1 first?”
“You guessed right.”
Chen Yu felt strange. Normally, shouldn’t they start with a simple plan?
They had agreed that Fang Heng would be in charge of the prison operation, so Chen Yu didn’t ask any questions. He just waved his hand, indicating for the federal team to cooperate.
“From the information we got, there are Tier 2 mutated zombies in Prison No. 1. It’s very difficult to deal with them. We need to be fully prepared.”
“Okay. This time, we’ll go in and explore, and check out the type and number of Tier 2 mutated zombies inside.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng took out the key and walked to the gate that was tightly bound by the iron chain.
“Click!”
Using the key to open the iron lock on the chain, Fang Heng used all his strength to pull off the chain.
The federal team stood behind Fang Heng separately and gathered together in a vigilant posture.
“Bang!”
The heavy iron chain was removed and thrown to the ground.
Fang Heng pulled out his machete and carefully pushed open the gate of Prison No. 1.
The inside of the prison building was completely silent.
It was a chaotic scene. All kinds of tables were overturned on the ground and paper was scattered all over the ground.
Dried blood stains could be seen everywhere.
It was certain that there had been riots here before.
Strangely, the entire prison building was extremely quiet.
Fang Heng turned his head and looked at Chen Yu.
“Is there something wrong?”
“Yes.”
Chen Yu also felt that something was wrong, so he explained in a low voice.
“I’m not too sure about the specifics either. Prison No. 507’s mission was obtained by the federation from other sources.”
“We know the least about this part of the mission in Prison No. 1. We only know that we can find a magnetic card here that corresponds to the electronic lock that can open the underground passage.”
“There’s a serious lack of information about this part of the mission process. There’s also the possibility of errors in the before and after mission lines.”
“The intelligence department believes that these differences may be caused by subtle changes between the various servers.”
Fang Heng nodded to show that he understood.
“Let’s go in and take a look.”
Chen Yu became more and more alert. He gestured to his team members behind him.
The 20-man federal team covered each other as they entered the prison together.
Soon, they arrived at a fork in the hallway.
One led to the prison area, and the other led to the isolation infirmary in the management area.
Chen Yu looked at Fang Heng and asked, “Are we going to the infirmary first?”
“No, we’re going to the second floor first.”
“The second floor?”
“Yes, I received news that there’s a safe in the firearms room on the second floor. The magnetic card is stored in the safe.”
“Alright, then let’s go to the second floor to investigate first.”
Chen Yu raised his eyebrows.
He was a little curious as to where Fang Heng got the news from.
Now was not the time to discuss this issue. He waved his hand and the federal team began to move. They began to explore the stairs on the right side one after another.
The team carefully went up to the corridor on the second floor and slowly moved forward along the corridor leading to the management area on the second floor.
Fang Heng and Chen Yu were at the front of the team.
They didn’t encounter any zombies along the way.
Chen Yu said in a low voice, “It’s so quiet all the way. There must be something strange.”
“Yeah.”
Fang Heng had the same thought.
While they were exploring, Fang Heng suddenly felt goosebumps all over his body.
He suddenly felt a sense of danger approaching.
The sense of danger came from the right.
Fang Heng suddenly turned his head around.
On the right was a glass window of a meeting room. The shutters were tightly shut, so he could not see what was inside the room.
“Chi! Chi Chi!!”
Fang Heng’s sharp senses could hear something rapidly moving against the wall.
The sound was also coming from behind the glass window.
And it was getting closer!
“Be careful!!!”
Chen Yu was stunned.
“Bang!”
The glass window exploded with a “bang”.
A red shadow dashed out from the broken window and pounced on Chen Yu.
Sharp white claws were sticking out.
Fang Heng shouted.
“Get down!”
Chen Yu’s reaction speed was extremely fast. Out of Fang Heng’s trust, the moment he heard Fang Heng’s shout, he immediately took the safest position to protect himself.
He turned his body sideways and rolled on the ground.
Fang Heng, who was standing behind Chen Yu, raised his shotgun.
The muzzle of the shotgun was aimed at the approaching dark red creature.
“Bang!”
Fang Heng pulled the trigger.
The shotgun hit the target accurately!
The red creature flew backwards.
“It’s the Licker!”
Someone immediately cried out in alarm.
The Licker!
It was the most difficult creature to deal with among the Tier 2 zombies.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.
His mind was immediately flooded with memories about the Licker.
The Licker was different from ordinary zombies. It was an unstable experimental product created by injecting the T-virus directly into a living body.
It was specially cultivated and manufactured by Meteorite Company. During the cultivation stage, Meteorite Company researchers would directly feed it with live DNA.
After the living test subject absorbed enough nutrients, the T-virus continued to manifest, causing the test subject’s skin to fall off and the muscle tissue to grow abnormally.
After the skin fell off, the subject gradually lost the function and purpose of the human “hand”, and the forelimbs mutated into claws.
Due to the change in shape, Meteorite Company named it-the Licker.
They are better at hunting than humans!
Lickers are good at moving and hunting in places such as ceilings, walls and so on.
Their weakness is their head and exposed heart!
Most Lickers were in a crouching position, which made it easier to protect the heart.
Heart!
Brain!
Fang Heng’s gaze focused on the two fatal points of the Licker.
The Licker was hit by a shotgun at close range, and the huge sound wave and impact sent the Licker back into a short-term stun state.
The Licker revealed its heart in the reclining state!
Fang Heng pulled out his machete.
Ever since the end of his trip to Hope Town, after a period of hacking, Fang Heng’s A-level skill, strengthen the body, had been upgraded to Level 10!
Level 10 skills increased Fang Heng’s basic strength and physique attributes by an additional 7 points!
He had also finished the gene enhancer that Qiu Yaokang had given him. All three of his basic attributes had been increased to a maximum of 5 points.
With the addition of his basic strength training, Fang Heng’s strength had now reached 19 points!
It was almost four times the strength of an ordinary player!
Grabbing the Licker’s stiff back, Fang Heng took a quick step forward, brandished his machete and slashed forward with all his strength!
“Chi!”
The machete slashed downwards from top to bottom and left a huge gash on the Licker’s body.
The slash directly cut the exposed heart in half.
“Plop!”
The Licker fell to the ground.
It struggled on the ground for a moment, and its body gradually became stiff. Its limbs showed strange distortions, and it curled up into a ball.
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 2 mutated zombie-the Licker. You have obtained a complete evolution crystal.. You have obtained 20 survival points.]

One led to the prison area, and the other led to the isolation infirmary in the management area.
Chen Yu looked at Fang Heng and asked, “Are we going to the infirmary first?”
“No, we’re going to the second floor first.”
“The second floor?”
“Yes, I received news that there’s a safe in the firearms room on the second floor.
The magnetic card is stored in the safe.”
“Alright, then let’s go to the second floor to investigate first.”
Chen Yu raised his eyebrows.
He was a little curious as to where Fang Heng got the news from.
Now was not the time to discuss this issue.
He waved his hand and the federal team began to move.
They began to explore the stairs on the right side one after another.
The team carefully went up to the corridor on the second floor and slowly moved forward along the corridor leading to the management area on the second floor.
Fang Heng and Chen Yu were at the front of the team.
They didn’t encounter any zombies along the way.
Chen Yu said in a low voice, “It’s so quiet all the way.
There must be something strange.”
“Yeah.”
Fang Heng had the same thought.
While they were exploring, Fang Heng suddenly felt goosebumps all over his body.
He suddenly felt a sense of danger approaching.
The sense of danger came from the right.
Fang Heng suddenly turned his head around.
On the right was a glass window of a meeting room.
The shutters were tightly shut, so he could not see what was inside the room.
“Chi!
Chi Chi!!”
Fang Heng’s sharp senses could hear something rapidly moving against the wall.
The sound was also coming from behind the glass window.
And it was getting closer!
“Be careful!!!”
Chen Yu was stunned.
“Bang!”
The glass window exploded with a “bang”.
A red shadow dashed out from the broken window and pounced on Chen Yu.
Sharp white claws were sticking out.
Fang Heng shouted.
“Get down!”
Chen Yu’s reaction speed was extremely fast.
Out of Fang Heng’s trust, the moment he heard Fang Heng’s shout, he immediately took the safest position to protect himself.
He turned his body sideways and rolled on the ground.
Fang Heng, who was standing behind Chen Yu, raised his shotgun.
The muzzle of the shotgun was aimed at the approaching dark red creature.
“Bang!”
Fang Heng pulled the trigger.
The shotgun hit the target accurately!
The red creature flew backwards.
“It’s the Licker!”
Someone immediately cried out in alarm.
The Licker!
It was the most difficult creature to deal with among the Tier 2 zombies.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.
His mind was immediately flooded with memories about the Licker.
The Licker was different from ordinary zombies.
It was an unstable experimental product created by injecting the T-virus directly into a living body.
It was specially cultivated and manufactured by Meteorite Company.
During the cultivation stage, Meteorite Company researchers would directly feed it with live DNA.
After the living test subject absorbed enough nutrients, the T-virus continued to manifest, causing the test subject’s skin to fall off and the muscle tissue to grow abnormally.
After the skin fell off, the subject gradually lost the function and purpose of the human “hand”, and the forelimbs mutated into claws.
Due to the change in shape, Meteorite Company named it-the Licker.
They are better at hunting than humans!
Lickers are good at moving and hunting in places such as ceilings, walls and so on.
Their weakness is their head and exposed heart!
Most Lickers were in a crouching position, which made it easier to protect the heart.
Heart!
Brain!
Fang Heng’s gaze focused on the two fatal points of the Licker.
The Licker was hit by a shotgun at close range, and the huge sound wave and impact sent the Licker back into a short-term stun state.
The Licker revealed its heart in the reclining state!
Fang Heng pulled out his machete.
Ever since the end of his trip to Hope Town, after a period of hacking, Fang Heng’s A-level skill, strengthen the body, had been upgraded to Level 10!
Level 10 skills increased Fang Heng’s basic strength and physique attributes by an additional 7 points!
He had also finished the gene enhancer that Qiu Yaokang had given him.
All three of his basic attributes had been increased to a maximum of 5 points.
With the addition of his basic strength training, Fang Heng’s strength had now reached 19 points!
It was almost four times the strength of an ordinary player!
Grabbing the Licker’s stiff back, Fang Heng took a quick step forward, brandished his machete and slashed forward with all his strength!
“Chi!”
The machete slashed downwards from top to bottom and left a huge gash on the Licker’s body.
The slash directly cut the exposed heart in half.
“Plop!”
The Licker fell to the ground.
It struggled on the ground for a moment, and its body gradually became stiff.
Its limbs showed strange distortions, and it curled up into a ball.
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 2 mutated zombie-the Licker.
You have obtained a complete evolution crystal..
You have obtained 20 survival points.]

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - Flashbang
paragraphs: “This is troublesome!”
“I didn’t expect it to be a Licker.”
Fang Heng thought to himself. He finally understood.
No wonder there were no ordinary zombies here.
Lickers would eat ordinary zombies when they were hungry to obtain nutrients.
Fang Heng turned his head and looked at Chen Yu, who had just stood up.
Chen Yu was still scared, so he nodded at Fang Heng.
The two of them tacitly did not speak.
For some reason, after the Lickers had completed their evolution, their visual nerves had completely degenerated and lost their function.
However, correspondingly, the Lickers’ tactile and auditory nerves far surpassed that of ordinary animals.
They were extremely sensitive to sound!
The gunshot just now should have attracted many Lickers over.
They couldn’t stay here for long, they had to evacuate as soon as possible!
Chen Yu pointed at the entrance that led to the prison area not far away, then quickly made a few gestures to the team members.
He signalled the team to try not to make a sound, then quickly retreat!
Survival was more important, quickly retreat!
Fang Heng also didn’t dare to stay any longer.
Dealing with one Licker was already scary enough. If two or three Lickers were to appear at the same time, their entire team would probably have to die here.
The team carefully retreated to the first floor.
What they were afraid of came true. From upstairs, the sound of friction could be heard rapidly approaching.
Fang Heng’s passive perception once again gave him a premonition of extreme danger!
“Quick! Run!”
Fang Heng shouted.
He was sure that a large number of Lickers upstairs had caught up to him.
There was no point in continuing to remain silent!
When the team members heard Fang Heng’s shout, they immediately sprinted along the road they had come from!
Behind them, the sounds of friction coming from the pursuers were getting closer and closer.
Fang Heng’s agility attribute was twice that of an ordinary player, and his running speed was also slightly faster than the other team members.
He was far ahead of the other players and was the first to run to the prison’s entrance. He turned his head and looked behind him.
Nearly a dozen red Lickers were sticking close to the wall and quickly chasing after the federation players.
Fang Heng switched pistols and aimed at the Lickers, trying to slow them down.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
The Lickers were extremely agile. They relied on their high-speed movement to dodge the bullets.
Fang Heng finished firing a round of bullets, and 60-70% of them missed.
Seeing that the last federation player at the rear was about to be caught up, Chen Yu turned his head and threw a blue flashbang backwards.
“Buzz...”
Ear-piercing ringing sounds accompanied by intense flashes of light exploded within the group of Lickers.
Fang Heng practically lowered his head and closed his eyes.
The flashbang model that Chen Yu threw quickly appeared in his mind.
GNT-200 flashbang!
Manufacturer-Meteorite Company!
When detonated, it could not only emit a strong light, but also release high frequency sound waves.
The sound waves would affect the Lickers’ hearing for some time.
Rich federation!
Just this flashbang alone cost 75 King of Gods’ points to purchase.
Affected by the high frequency sound waves of the flashbang, the Lickers stood rooted to the spot.
Taking advantage of the Lickers’ inability to move, the federal team quickly left the warehouse.
“Bang!”
The door was tightly shut. A few federal team members rushed up and cooperated to once again wrap the door with iron chains.
“Bang! Bang Bang! Bang!”
The Lickers were still unwilling to give up. From within the prison, the continuous sound of the door knocking could be heard.
The members of the federal team had cold sweat all over their foreheads. One after another, they raised their pistols and aimed at the door.
Fortunately, the prison door was hard enough.
After a while, the banging sound finally faded away.
“Phew!”
The members of the team let out a sigh of relief. They put down their pistols and relaxed for the time being.
Fang Heng still had a frown on his face.
He didn’t expect the difficulty of this mission to be so high.
The Tier 2 mutated zombies were already very difficult to deal with, but the Lickers they encountered were the most difficult to deal with!
Fang Heng didn’t remember to count carefully just now. He roughly estimated that there were at least ten Lickers!
“Our mission is going to be troublesome. The Lickers are too powerful. It’s too difficult to deal with them at this stage.”
Chen Yu panted heavily and walked over to discuss with Fang Heng.
Even now, his heart was still pounding furiously.
“Their movement speed is too fast. Not to mention using a crossbow, even if we use a gun, our accuracy is very low. If we want to complete the mission, we have to think of another way.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng leaned against the wall and fell into deep thought.
Of course, he understood what Chen Yu was saying.
He had just personally experienced using a pistol to attack the Licker.
Even if he had 15 points of high perception, he could only hit 5 out of 15 bullets.
Moreover, the damage dealt by the pistol to the Licker wasn’t high. A few simple attacks wouldn’t be able to deal fatal damage to it.
Against the Licker, the vine zombie was no match for it.
The Licker’s powerful strength attribute allowed it to directly use the vine zombie’s entanglement skill.
Fang Heng closed his eyes and quickly recalled the Licker’s weakness.
Chen Yu also felt a headache coming on. The difficulty of this mission was much more difficult than what was recorded in the original information of the federation!
At this stage, it was impossible for a player to deal with so many Lickers.
It was the same for the federation.
How could he persuade Fang Heng to give up this mission?
Chen Yu thought for a moment and persuaded, “Fang Heng, why don’t we give up? After some time, when our weapons and equipment are ready...”
Fang Heng suddenly opened his eyes.
“The Lickers’ visual nerves have deteriorated. They rely on their strong hearing to determine their location. We can think of a way to make use of this.”
“Oh?”
Chen Yu was stunned again.
He thought along with Fang Heng’s words and his eyes lit up.
“I understand. Are you saying that we should try our best not to make any noise and sneak into the gun room on the second floor to get the magnetic card without being discovered by the Lickers?”
Fang Heng waved his hand.
“Don’t even think about it. It’s the game’s usual routine. The door to the second floor gun room is most likely locked from the inside.”
“If we want to go in, we will have to break the door. The sound of breaking the door will attract the lickers. This is a dead end.”
Chen Yu was at a loss for words.
He felt that what Fang Heng said made a lot of sense.
“Unfortunately, the higher-ups only have one flashbang for emergency use. We just used it up. Why don’t I go back and request for two more from the higher-ups?”
“We can take advantage of the short-term stun caused by the flashbang to buy time and take the magnetic card from the gun room on the second floor.”
Chen Yu felt that this was the most likely way to complete the mission.
He did not expect Fang Heng to decisively reject it once again.

“No, it will take too long to apply to the federation. It will take at least two to three days to go back and forth. Moreover, whether the federation approves it or not is another matter. The effects of the two flashbangs are limited and the risk is too great.”
Hearing what Fang Heng said, Chen Yu was a little speechless.
Even if he knew that there were a large number of Lickers in Prison No. 1, would he still think that two to three days was too slow?
Two to three days? He would be thankful if he could complete the mission!
The members of the federal team who were listening to the conversation between the two big shots at the side all had the same thoughts.
They could not figure out Fang Heng’s train of thought.
Fang Heng stroked his chin as if there was no one else around, thinking carefully.
He slowly took a few steps back and turned his head to look at the ‘hills’ of logs in the prison square.
A plan gradually formed in Fang Heng’s mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - Hiring
paragraphs: Fang Heng raised his head and asked Chen Yu.
“The federation’s elite teams are all equipped with pistols, right?”
“Uh, not all of them. Pistols are still very rare in the game at this stage. We only have 12 people equipped with them, and each person only has 15 bullets.”
“That’s enough. I have a plan. I’ll have to trouble your team to do something for me this afternoon.”
What? A plan?
A plan to get the magnetic card?
Fang Heng leaned over and whispered into Chen Yu’s ear, “Help me move the logs later.”
Move the logs?
Chen Yu looked at Fang Heng with a baffled expression.
What did the plan to kill the Lickers and move the logs have in common?
He felt that Fang Heng’s train of thought was a little too out of the ordinary.
“Yes, move the logs first. Also, you’ll need a little bit of skill when you move them.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he took out a pen and paper and quickly drew a sketch on the paper in front of Chen Yu.
“How about this? Try to see if you can arrange the logs into such a shape. Then, use your imagination to think about it. Make sure that these few positions are as empty as possible.”
Looking at the rough sketch that Fang Heng drew on the paper, Chen Yu was even more confused.
“Boss, are you...”
“Building a maze to play in?”
“Chen Yu.” Fang Heng patted Chen Yu’s shoulder to show his encouragement. “I believe in your ability. You can definitely do it.”
Lickers were the strongest among the Tier 2 mutated zombies!
They were the strongest!
Their agility attribute was extremely high, their dodging ability was extremely strong and their physical defense was abnormally tough.
The most troublesome thing was that they also liked to appear in groups!
Even in the later stages of the game, when players encountered Lickers, they would run as fast as they could.
If they really couldn’t run away, they would use their powerful long-range firepower to suppress them.
In order to completely destroy the Lickers in Prison No. 1, Fang Heng felt that the best way was probably to burn the building or directly blow it up.
However, if he did that, the magnetic card in the building would be destroyed and the mission would fail.
Therefore, he had to change his tactics.
Relying on the federation’s toolmen alone wasn’t enough.
Fang Heng already had a rough plan.
While Chen Yu was leading the federal team to move logs on the empty ground of the prison, he drove his truck to the camp of the Dark Knights next to a valley.
A wooden hut was built at the foot of the valley.
There was a sign hanging outside the wooden hut.
“Apocalypse Bar”
Although it was said to be a camp, it was actually just a wooden hut that had been converted into a bar.
Fang Heng walked into the wooden hut.
Inside the wooden hut, two or three NPC survivors were sitting around a table and discussing something in a low voice.
When they saw Fang Heng enter, they stopped in unison.
Behind the bar stood a tall, scantily dressed young woman.
Her exposed tan skin and curvy figure made Fang Heng look at her twice.
“Fang Heng? You’re the newcomer who’s been in the limelight recently.”
Katarina took the initiative to wave at Fang Heng.
She poured a glass of wine and pushed it towards Fang Heng.
“Nice to meet you. I’m the person-in-charge here, Katarina. This is to celebrate our first meeting. This glass is on me.”
“Thank you.”
Fang Heng walked to the bar counter.
“Let me guess, you’re here to receive a mission?”
Katarina moved her face in front of Fang Heng and winked at him.
“I have a lot of busy missions here. I was ranked bottom for the assessment for the previous two months. You should be able to help me, right?”
“Show me your mission. If it’s convenient...”
Katarina waved her hand, and a list of missions appeared in front of Fang Heng.
Mission 1: Clear The Tier 2 zombies.
Difficulty: SS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ honor points.
Mission 2: Explore the Meteorite Company’s branch in the city.
Difficulty: SSS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Mission 3: Search for clues related to the Meteorite Company’s ‘biological weapons’ project (which can trigger subsequent missions).
Difficulty: SSS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Mission 4: Protect important members of the Dark Knights.
Difficulty: SSS
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Mission 4: Search for dangerous personnel-head of security of Meteorite Company.
Difficulty: SSS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Task 5: Analysis of Alex’s live samples...
Fang Heng looked at the densely packed mission pane and was greatly surprised.
The Dark Knights’ missions and the apocalypse merchant camp’s missions were of two extremes.
The lowest difficulty of the Dark Knights’ mission was already SS-level.
No wonder the Dark Knights’ entry criterion was so difficult.
Fang Heng thought to himself.
Katarina’s beautiful eyes looked at Fang Heng. “How is it? Is there a mission that you’re interested in?”
“What a coincidence. I’m going to kill the Licker later.”
Fang Heng conveniently received the mission to collect the Tier 2 zombie samples and the Licker research mission.
[Hint: You’ve accepted the mission-clear the Tier 2 zombies.]
[Hint: You’ve accepted the mission-Licker research.]
Mission name: Clear out the Tier 2 zombies.
Difficulty: SS.
Mission requirements: Clear out at least 100 Tier 2 mutated zombies.
Mission time limit: 72 hours.
Mission name: Licker research.
Difficulty: SSS.
Mission requirements: Obtain samples of the Licker within the stipulated time limit (able to exceed mission completion.)
Mission time limit: 72 hours.
“You have 72 hours to complete the mission, good luck.”
“There’s one more thing, my survival camp is in trouble, I need to temporarily recruit a Dark Knights’ helper.”
“Of course you can, your current honor level is Level 7, you can use honor points to temporarily recruit.”
“In addition, a Dark Knight elite mercenary can provide you with 24-hour help, if they unfortunately die in the process of the mission you will pay a large amount of compensation.”
Fang Heng looked at the price list given by Katarina.
Temporarily recruiting a Dark Knight elite mercenary for 24 hours requires 300 honor points.
If it was equipped with a full set of weapons, it would cost a full 1000 honor points!
Moreover, during the temporary recruitment process, the mercenaries’ weapons and ammunition consumption would further deplete the player’s survival points.
The money for the ammunition was also on Fang Heng.
What a waste of money!
Fang Heng calculated for a moment. He had previously completed the related missions in Hope Town by an additional 41 times, and only then did he obtain 41,000 honor points.
“I need to recruit 20 fully armed Dark Knights’ elites.”
“Oh? Looks like you’re preparing to do a big deal. I wish you good luck.”
Katarina was surprised, and then her smile became even brighter.
[Hint: Your friendship with Katarina has increased.]
“Handsome, you have brought me a big deal. I will give you an extra discount for the damage of weapons...”
“When do you want them to gather at your shelter? We need some time to communicate, so we need at least three hours to gather.”
“You can also set up other gathering points. If they are too far away, the gathering time will become normal.”
“No need. Tomorrow morning, at eight o’clock.”
“No problem.. They will report to your shelter on time.”

Relying on the federation’s toolmen alone wasn’t enough.
Fang Heng already had a rough plan.
While Chen Yu was leading the federal team to move logs on the empty ground of the prison, he drove his truck to the camp of the Dark Knights next to a valley.
A wooden hut was built at the foot of the valley.
There was a sign hanging outside the wooden hut.
“Apocalypse Bar”
Although it was said to be a camp, it was actually just a wooden hut that had been converted into a bar.
Fang Heng walked into the wooden hut.
Inside the wooden hut, two or three NPC survivors were sitting around a table and discussing something in a low voice.
When they saw Fang Heng enter, they stopped in unison.
Behind the bar stood a tall, scantily dressed young woman.
Her exposed tan skin and curvy figure made Fang Heng look at her twice.
“Fang Heng?
You’re the newcomer who’s been in the limelight recently.”
Katarina took the initiative to wave at Fang Heng.
She poured a glass of wine and pushed it towards Fang Heng.
“Nice to meet you.
I’m the person-in-charge here, Katarina.
This is to celebrate our first meeting.
This glass is on me.”
“Thank you.”
Fang Heng walked to the bar counter.
“Let me guess, you’re here to receive a mission?”
Katarina moved her face in front of Fang Heng and winked at him.
“I have a lot of busy missions here.
I was ranked bottom for the assessment for the previous two months.
You should be able to help me, right?”
“Show me your mission.
If it’s convenient...”
Katarina waved her hand, and a list of missions appeared in front of Fang Heng.
Mission 1: Clear The Tier 2 zombies.
Difficulty: SS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ honor points.
Mission 2: Explore the Meteorite Company’s branch in the city.
Difficulty: SSS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Mission 3: Search for clues related to the Meteorite Company’s ‘biological weapons’ project (which can trigger subsequent missions).
Difficulty: SSS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Mission 4: Protect important members of the Dark Knights.
Difficulty: SSS
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Mission 4: Search for dangerous personnel-head of security of Meteorite Company.
Difficulty: SSS.
Reward: Dark Knights’ merit points.
Task 5: Analysis of Alex’s live samples...
Fang Heng looked at the densely packed mission pane and was greatly surprised.
The Dark Knights’ missions and the apocalypse merchant camp’s missions were of two extremes.
The lowest difficulty of the Dark Knights’ mission was already SS-level.
No wonder the Dark Knights’ entry criterion was so difficult.
Fang Heng thought to himself.
Katarina’s beautiful eyes looked at Fang Heng.
“How is it?
Is there a mission that you’re interested in?”
“What a coincidence.
I’m going to kill the Licker later.”
Fang Heng conveniently received the mission to collect the Tier 2 zombie samples and the Licker research mission.
[Hint: You’ve accepted the mission-clear the Tier 2 zombies.]
[Hint: You’ve accepted the mission-Licker research.]
Mission name: Clear out the Tier 2 zombies.
Difficulty: SS.
Mission requirements: Clear out at least 100 Tier 2 mutated zombies.
Mission time limit: 72 hours.
Mission name: Licker research.
Difficulty: SSS.
Mission requirements: Obtain samples of the Licker within the stipulated time limit (able to exceed mission completion.)
Mission time limit: 72 hours.
“You have 72 hours to complete the mission, good luck.”
“There’s one more thing, my survival camp is in trouble, I need to temporarily recruit a Dark Knights’ helper.”
“Of course you can, your current honor level is Level 7, you can use honor points to temporarily recruit.”
“In addition, a Dark Knight elite mercenary can provide you with 24-hour help, if they unfortunately die in the process of the mission you will pay a large amount of compensation.”
Fang Heng looked at the price list given by Katarina.
Temporarily recruiting a Dark Knight elite mercenary for 24 hours requires 300 honor points.
If it was equipped with a full set of weapons, it would cost a full 1000 honor points!
Moreover, during the temporary recruitment process, the mercenaries’ weapons and ammunition consumption would further deplete the player’s survival points.
The money for the ammunition was also on Fang Heng.
What a waste of money!
Fang Heng calculated for a moment.
He had previously completed the related missions in Hope Town by an additional 41 times, and only then did he obtain 41,000 honor points.
“I need to recruit 20 fully armed Dark Knights’ elites.”
“Oh?
Looks like you’re preparing to do a big deal.
I wish you good luck.”
Katarina was surprised, and then her smile became even brighter.
[Hint: Your friendship with Katarina has increased.]
“Handsome, you have brought me a big deal.
I will give you an extra discount for the damage of weapons...”
“When do you want them to gather at your shelter?
We need some time to communicate, so we need at least three hours to gather.”
“You can also set up other gathering points.
If they are too far away, the gathering time will become normal.”
“No need.
Tomorrow morning, at eight o’clock.”
“No problem..
They will report to your shelter on time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - Maze
paragraphs: Chen Yu had no idea what Fang Heng was planning.
However, unlike the other federation players, he had confidence in Fang Heng.
Chen Yu would never forget that time he saw a zombie pit in Hope Town.
He had never seen such a monster grinding operation even in a federation textbook.
It only existed in the players’ verbal attacks’ on the forums.
Chen Yu brought the federal team back and forth to move logs for an entire afternoon.
They finally managed to follow Fang Heng’s rough layout before the sun set. After a lot of imagination, they finally managed to come up with such a maze-like layout.
It was really too tiring!
Even the elite recruits of the federation who had undergone strict training in school were somewhat unable to endure it.
After eating dinner and taking a shower, they quickly went offline to rest.
Chen Yu also felt his back ache.
He wanted to say hello to Fang Heng before going offline, but strangely, that kid disappeared again.
“I hope nothing unexpected happens.”
Chen Yu muttered and quickly went offline as well.
He still had to report the mission to his leaders.
Not long after Chen Yu and the others went offline, the zombie clones completed their exploration of Prison No. 2.
Materials and more materials were piled up messily in the basement shelter.

[Hint: Your zombie group has completed the exploration of Prison No. 2. You have found leek cans*27, instant noodles*43, stimulants*3, homemade knives*1, bandages*23, pistol bullets*4669, pistol (Beretta 92FS)*6, medical alcohol* 2...]
Fang Heng roughly glanced at the mission log.
Good stuff!
Guns! Bullets!
The team currently lacked these!
Fang Heng did not have the time to sort out the items collected. He only hurriedly stuffed the pistols and bullets into his backpack.
With a wave of his hand, he left the basement with his zombie clones.
After leaving the Dark Knights’ camp during the day, he first went to the apocalypse merchant camp to buy a lot of nails and mechanical lubricants.
Then, he took a detour back to the abandoned mine and collected the iron nuggets that he had forged during this period of time.
When he returned to the prison square and saw the ‘maze’ that was formed by a large number of logs, Fang Heng chuckled.
“Chen Yu and the others are reliable.”
Such a complicated maze building was impossible for the zombie clones to build.
Fang Heng looked around.
There were still a large number of logs left in the square.
He controlled the zombies to walk to another area of the square and began to do the next step.
“Next, I need to set up a trap. I need to rely on zombies to make it. I need to rebuild the assembly line to speed up the efficiency.”
Fang Heng cheered up. He divided the zombie clones into three assembly lines.
One group of zombies made wooden spikes.
The other group of zombies started making wooden frames.
The last group of zombies made hemp ropes...
The next day, Chen Yu and the others finished their daily training outside the game and went online on time as usual.
They led the team to the canteen on the first floor of the prison. Chen Yu saw Fang Heng enjoying his breakfast.
“Fang Heng, we’ve finished building the passage.”
Chen Yu sat cross-legged across from Fang Heng with his food.
“I ran into some problems during the actual operation. I couldn’t find you yesterday, so I made some changes on my own.”
“I saw it last night. It was perfect. You’re amazing! I think you’re a genius in architecture!”
“Would you like some chocolate milk?”
Fang Heng gave Chen Yu a thumbs up in his heart and handed him a packet of chocolate milk.
After seeing the building that Chen Yu had constructed, he even had the thought of poaching him.
To be able to expand and perfect the maze building that he had casually drawn, Chen Yu had a knack for architecture.
He was a talent!
Fang Heng winked at Chen Yu. “If you don’t work for the federation anymore, you can consider coming to my place. I’ll give you double the salary.”
Chen Yu was momentarily at a loss for words. He remembered that the mission his commander had given him was to recruit Fang Heng. Why did it seem like it was the other way now?
“Haha, I’m just joking.”

Fang Heng took a sip of chocolate milk. “I’ll make some more arrangements. After we finish eating, we’ll start the battle plan. You assemble the federal team and come to the prison square. We’ll eliminate that group of Lickers in one fell swoop and take back Prison No. 1.”
“Okay!”
Chen Yu’s expression turned serious.
He realized that Fang Heng wasn’t joking.
Fang Heng was very confident.
However, how was he going to kill the zombies with a maze that looked like a joke?
Could it be that..
He was going to trap them in the maze and starve them to death?
Chen Yu scratched his head and threw this unrealistic idea out of his mind.
He would know when the time came!
He still chose to believe in Fang Heng’s plan.
After dinner, Chen Yu brought the federal team to the prison square.
“This...”
Upon stepping into the prison square, Chen Yu was dumbfounded.
Not only was Chen Yu dumbfounded, but the federation soldiers behind him were also dumbfounded.
The prison square was completely different from the time they left last night!
What was with all those sentry towers that stood in the square?
Heavens!
Sentry towers!?
How did he build so many sentry towers in one night?
Chen Yu was extremely shocked.
Unlike the initial shelter, when building a building like a sentry tower, players would need to consume vitality points to build it, in addition to preparing sufficient construction materials.
Well, maybe materials were not an issue, based on the prison’s stock of materials, perhaps Fang Heng really did not lack them.
But what about the construction period?
For a building like this, it would take four to five days for two players to complete the construction.
How did so many sentry towers appear in just one night?
Confused, Chen Yu looked up at the top of the sentry tower.
He immediately saw the NPC mercenaries guarding the sentry towers.
There were mercenaries?
Were they also recruited by Fang Heng?
“Chen Yu, you’re here. Sorry to keep you waiting.”
Chen Yu swallowed his saliva and turned his head to look at Fang Heng and Liao Bufan, who had jumped down from the pile of logs.
Liao Bufan was holding an empty oil barrel in his hand and casually threw it to the side.
“Fang Heng, did you set up all these sentry towers?”
As soon as he said this, Chen Yu immediately felt that this question was very stupid.
If it wasn’t Fang Heng who set them up, could it be that he was the one who created a bug to set them?
“Yeah, I used a little trick.”
Fang Heng answered vaguely.
The players from the federal team looked at Fang Heng as if they had seen a ghost.
“Don’t mind these details. Let’s talk about the plan to deal with the Lickers first.”
Fang Heng was serious. He pointed at the few sentry towers around the maze.
“To put it simply, I will first think of a way to lure the Lickers out of Prison No. 1. When they enter the sentry towers’ attack range, listen to my command and we will destroy them completely.”
Chen Yu fell into deep thought.
He carefully considered the battle plan that Fang Heng had mentioned.
There were so many sentry towers...
It seemed feasible.
But...
Chen Yu couldn’t help but look up at the few sentry towers.
How did Fang Heng manage to create so many sentry towers in one night?

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - Luring the Enemies
paragraphs: “Since Lickers have high agility, it’s not easy to hit them. So, wait until all of you enter the inner part of the sentry towers.”
Fang Heng continued to explain the battle plan to Chen Yu and his team.

“By relying on the advantage of the sentry towers being high in the air, coupled with the additional long-range attack range and the drop rate of hits from the sentry towers, we should be able to deal with the Lickers trapped in the maze.”
“Any other questions?”
A federation soldier raised his hand and asked, “Mr Fang Heng! I have a question!”
“Please speak.”
“We don’t have enough guns and ammunition. We can’t guarantee our output.”
“The prison will provide you with a portion of pistols and ammunition.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he gave Liao Bufan a look.
Liao Bufan was already prepared. He ran to the side and pushed the wooden box in the corner over.
Opening the wooden box, there were more than ten pistols and a box full of pistol bullets.
These guns and bullets were all collected from Prison No. 2 and Prison No. 3.
“So many bullets?”
The members of the federal team were dazzled by this box of bullets.
They had once again witnessed the abundance of the prison.
The elite team of the federation had a 60% pistol equipped rate, but each of them only had 15 bullets.
Before coming here, they had thought that such equipment could be considered top-notch in the game.
After arriving at the prison, they realized that the bullets here could be used at will...
Chen Yu came back to his senses.
He looked at the sentry towers, then at the maze which he built yesterday, and finally at the bullets all over the ground.
Was this plan feasible?
Did he want to use the maze to trap the Lickers for a while longer?
Then, he could use the advantage of the sentry tower’s high position to shoot from above?
In theory, it seemed feasible.
But...
Chen Yu had never seen anyone play in such a way in the apocalypse game.
“Chen Yu, what do you think of the plan?”
“It’s... It’s okay...”
Chen Yu was a little confused by Fang Heng’s wild thinking.
“But, Fang Heng, this maze might be useful for ordinary zombies, but Lickers are good at climbing. If they encounter such terrain, they should be able to climb over it directly, right?”
Fang Heng nodded.
“That’s right. So, I made some special arrangements. You’ll find out later.”
“Alright.”
Chen Yu thought for a moment. If Fang Heng had already considered this...
Theoretically speaking, there shouldn’t be any loopholes in this plan.
However, it was still weird.
“How about... We give it a try first?”
“Alright, let’s give it a try first.”
Fang Heng was very confident in his plan, but Chen Yu was right.
This was the first time they were using this tactic, so they had to give it a try for safety reasons.
They had to try to lure a few Lickers out first, so that even if something unexpected happened to their plan, they would be able to remedy it in time.
According to the plan, Chen Yu and the federal team members were divided into five groups and they each climbed up the sentry tower.
They took out their pistols and aimed at the exit of Prison No. 1.
A member of the federal team noticed something and pointed at the top of the ‘maze’.
“Captain, look up.”
“Hiss...”
Chen Yu sucked in a breath of cold air.
What the heck!
On the top of the log pile, there was a layer of wood and a layer of spike trap was added to the wood.
It was obvious that this was Fang Heng’s doing!
Chen Yu secretly nodded in his heart.
A layer of wooden spike trap could indeed prevent the Licker from directly jumping over the obstacles from above.
However, it was not certain how effective it would be.
After all, that was a Licker!
Fang Heng and Liao Bufan walked to the iron gate of Prison No. 1 together, and he gestured to Chen Yu who was high up.
Chen Yu also gestured with his hand.
“Raise your spirits and get ready for battle.”
“Yes! Leader!”
Fang Heng put down his hand and pushed open the iron gate.
The next task was to lure the enemies.
This task was a little difficult.
Fang Heng thought about it for a long time. He realized that the task of luring the Lickers could only be done by him.
Among all the players, he was the one with the highest agility!
In addition to his 15 points of perceptive ability and danger warning ability, he could buy as much time as possible to escape in advance.
If it were anyone else who went to lure the Licker, they would probably die on the way before they could even lure it out.
Opening the door of the passage, Liao Bufan quickly dodged to the side.
Fang Heng stood where he was. He glanced at the inner part of the prison and took out a bottle of drink from his pocket.
Item: Gatorade 2021 commemorative edition.
Description: After drinking it, you can increase your maximum movement speed by 20% and your vitality recovery speed by 20% within 20 minutes (you can only use it once within 48 hours).
Fang Heng gulped down the drink.
He had tested it when he met the Licker yesterday. He ran at full speed but was slightly slower than the Licker.
Now with this 20% increase in speed, the Licker should not be able to catch up with him.
Fang Heng held the shotgun in his hand and slowly moved forward.
He walked along the passage that he had previously walked through until he reached the entrance to the second floor.
Fang Heng was not in a hurry to go upstairs. Instead, he took out a yellow rubber duckling toy from his backpack.
He reached out and grabbed the rubber duckling’s stomach.
He squeezed it lightly.
“Squeak!”
The toy duckling let out an ear-piercing screech.
“Squeak! Squeak squeak squeak!!”
After pressing it several times, Fang Heng kept the duckling.
Lickers relied on sound to track their targets. At close range, they could even hear the heartbeat of their prey.
Therefore, if they directly used the sound source to attract the Lickers, they would be seen through very quickly.
They had taken the bait!
A moment later, Fang Heng heard the faint sound of friction coming from upstairs. At the same time, a sense of danger arose in his heart.
He turned around and ran!
Fang Heng ran forward with all his might.
His vitality points began to drop rapidly.
Fang Heng was very sure that the Lickers that were behind him were still chasing him.
The sense of danger behind him did not disappear. Instead, it became more and more intense!
“Chi Chi Chi!!”
The sound of the Lickers crawling against the wall behind him became more and more frequent!
Listening to the sounds, the number of Lickers chasing him this time was even more than the last time.
“This is troublesome.”
The rubber ducking’s cry was not controlled well.
It attracted too many Lickers at once!
Fang Heng had no choice. He didn’t even turn his head and continued to run forward with all his might.
He finally reached the exit!
Fang Heng leapt out of the prison gate and immediately hid in the reserved maze gap on the right.
Liao Bufan quickly blocked the gap on the side, and the two continued to run into the distance.
After running for a few seconds, the first Licker came out of the prison building.
The Licker could pinpoint its location using sound and senses.
It moved extremely fast and immediately climbed up the wall made of logs after breaking out of the building.
Chen Yu followed Fang Heng’s instructions and did not give the order to shoot before receiving his hand signal.
He was unusually nervous, and his finger pressed on the trigger of the pistol while staring intensely at the Licker.
Now it was time to find out if the maze worked!

On the top of the log pile, there was a layer of wood and a layer of spike trap was added to the wood.
It was obvious that this was Fang Heng’s doing!
Chen Yu secretly nodded in his heart.
A layer of wooden spike trap could indeed prevent the Licker from directly jumping over the obstacles from above.
However, it was not certain how effective it would be.
After all, that was a Licker!
Fang Heng and Liao Bufan walked to the iron gate of Prison No.
1 together, and he gestured to Chen Yu who was high up.
Chen Yu also gestured with his hand.
“Raise your spirits and get ready for battle.”
“Yes!
Leader!”
Fang Heng put down his hand and pushed open the iron gate.
The next task was to lure the enemies.
This task was a little difficult.
Fang Heng thought about it for a long time.
He realized that the task of luring the Lickers could only be done by him.
Among all the players, he was the one with the highest agility!
In addition to his 15 points of perceptive ability and danger warning ability, he could buy as much time as possible to escape in advance.
If it were anyone else who went to lure the Licker, they would probably die on the way before they could even lure it out.
Opening the door of the passage, Liao Bufan quickly dodged to the side.
Fang Heng stood where he was.
He glanced at the inner part of the prison and took out a bottle of drink from his pocket.
Item: Gatorade 2021 commemorative edition.
Description: After drinking it, you can increase your maximum movement speed by 20% and your vitality recovery speed by 20% within 20 minutes (you can only use it once within 48 hours).
Fang Heng gulped down the drink.
He had tested it when he met the Licker yesterday.
He ran at full speed but was slightly slower than the Licker.
Now with this 20% increase in speed, the Licker should not be able to catch up with him.
Fang Heng held the shotgun in his hand and slowly moved forward.
He walked along the passage that he had previously walked through until he reached the entrance to the second floor.
Fang Heng was not in a hurry to go upstairs.
Instead, he took out a yellow rubber duckling toy from his backpack.
He reached out and grabbed the rubber duckling’s stomach.
He squeezed it lightly.
“Squeak!”
The toy duckling let out an ear-piercing screech.
“Squeak!
Squeak squeak squeak!!”
After pressing it several times, Fang Heng kept the duckling.
Lickers relied on sound to track their targets.
At close range, they could even hear the heartbeat of their prey.
Therefore, if they directly used the sound source to attract the Lickers, they would be seen through very quickly.
They had taken the bait!
A moment later, Fang Heng heard the faint sound of friction coming from upstairs.
At the same time, a sense of danger arose in his heart.
He turned around and ran!
Fang Heng ran forward with all his might.
His vitality points began to drop rapidly.
Fang Heng was very sure that the Lickers that were behind him were still chasing him.
The sense of danger behind him did not disappear.
Instead, it became more and more intense!
“Chi Chi Chi!!”
The sound of the Lickers crawling against the wall behind him became more and more frequent!
Listening to the sounds, the number of Lickers chasing him this time was even more than the last time.
“This is troublesome.”
The rubber ducking’s cry was not controlled well.
It attracted too many Lickers at once!
Fang Heng had no choice.
He didn’t even turn his head and continued to run forward with all his might.
He finally reached the exit!
Fang Heng leapt out of the prison gate and immediately hid in the reserved maze gap on the right.
Liao Bufan quickly blocked the gap on the side, and the two continued to run into the distance.
After running for a few seconds, the first Licker came out of the prison building.
The Licker could pinpoint its location using sound and senses.
It moved extremely fast and immediately climbed up the wall made of logs after breaking out of the building.
Chen Yu followed Fang Heng’s instructions and did not give the order to shoot before receiving his hand signal.
He was unusually nervous, and his finger pressed on the trigger of the pistol while staring intensely at the Licker.
Now it was time to find out if the maze worked!
